jobs.title: Legal Counsel / Contracts Specialist for ETH Zurich | Space
jobs.description:
ETH Zurich is one of the world’s leading universities in the fields of science and engineering. Through its strategic initiative, ETH Zurich │ Space is systematically expanding its activities in space research and technology. A unique environment for innovation is being created through the recruitment of high-calibre researchers of international standing and the expansion of collaborations with leading partners from academia, space agencies and industry.

Within the Vice-Presidency for Knowledge Transfer and Corporate Relations, the Research Contracts Group supports researchers in ensuring that their projects with national and international partners are built on a solid legal foundation.

To strengthen our team, we are seeking, with immediate effect or by agreement, a committed, solution-oriented and strong negotiator to take on the role of Legal Counsel for ETH Zurich │ Space.
Job description

Your role at the interface between space research and law

In this role, you will be the key legal point of contact for the research activities of ETH Zurich │ Space and ETH Swiss GeoLab. You will be part of a strong team of around 20 legal professionals in the Research Contracts Group, where you will benefit from their broad expertise and mutual exchange of ideas. Your personal focus will be on independently managing the space-related portfolio. Against the backdrop of a steadily growing number of collaborations, you will facilitate and promote the conclusion of contracts between ETH researchers and space-related organisations – ranging from industrial companies and start-ups to international space agencies, as well as academic and public institutions. You will advise researchers and management on the drafting and negotiation of complex research contracts and help to ensure that innovative research projects are implemented in a legally sound and efficient manner. This encompasses both traditional space technologies (e.g. hardware) and Earth observation, the processing of geo-information and the use of space data on Earth. In doing so, you also act as a bridge to Swiss stakeholders in government bodies and the business sector.

You will support scientists with their projects from the initial idea for collaboration right through to the conclusion of a contract and lay the legal foundations for world-class international research in a highly dynamic environment.

Your key responsibilities

- You will independently review, draft and negotiate complex national and international research and development contracts, in particular Research Collaboration Agreements, Consortium Agreements, Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) and other research and cooperation agreements.
- You will manage projects with international space agencies, research institutions and industry partners, particularly within the context of the European Space Agency (ESA), NASA, the Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) and other international space and research partners.
- You will advise researchers and project managers on legal issues relating to international research collaborations, intellectual property, liability matters and other contractual risks.
- You will provide support on matters relating to export controls and dual-use goods, working closely with the relevant compliance units at ETH Zurich.
- You will provide proactive and solution-oriented advice to researchers and project managers throughout the entire project lifecycle – from project initiation to successful completion.
- You will further develop contract templates, guidelines and standard processes for the efficient and legally compliant management of space and research projects.
- You will work closely with ETH transfer, compliance units and other internal and external stakeholders.
- You will make a significant contribution to ensuring that international research collaborations are legally sound, whilst at the same time safeguarding the research community’s ability to act.

Profile
We are looking for someone who can quickly grasp complex issues, develop pragmatic solutions and takes pleasure in supporting researchers in a world-class international research environment.

- Education: You hold a university degree in law (or equivalent legal qualification) combined with a strong understanding of technical contexts.
- Experience: You have at least 5 years’ relevant professional experience in international contract law or research management – ideally gained in an international organisation, a company in the tech/space sector, a space-related authority or at a university. Experience with contracts from space agencies (e.g. ESA) or space companies is a strong advantage.
- Expertise: You have in-depth knowledge of Swiss and international contract law. Experience in intellectual property law, technology transfer or research law is an advantage.
- Space law: Knowledge of international space law, regulatory issues relating to the space sector, and the science policy context of international research collaborations would be an advantage.
- Export control & regulation: Experience in export control law (particularly ITAR/EAR), in dealing with dual-use goods or in comparable regulatory environments is particularly welcome. Knowledge of ESA or NASA-related regulatory frameworks is an additional advantage.
- Skills: You possess excellent analytical and conceptual skills, strong negotiation skills, and the ability to address legal risks in a pragmatic and solution-oriented manner.
- Languages: You communicate and negotiate fluently in German and English (both spoken and written). Business-level English is essential.
- Mindset & working style: You are characterised by a strong service orientation and a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach to your work. You are a talented communicator and are confident in your interactions with researchers, industry representatives and regulatory authorities.

By drafting clear and balanced contractual provisions, you lay the foundations for successful international collaborations. You can manage a demanding portfolio independently and conduct complex contract negotiations efficiently and in a goal-oriented manner.

If, in addition, you have an interest in the space sector, cutting-edge technology and international research collaborations, and are passionate about scientific innovation, you are ideally suited for this role.

We offer
- The opportunity to play an active role in shaping the establishment and further development of ETH Zurich│Space
- An exciting international working environment at the interface of research, technology and innovation
- The chance to collaborate with leading researchers and renowned partner organisations worldwide
- Challenging and varied tasks with a high degree of personal responsibility and creative freedom
- Flexible working arrangements and attractive terms of employment at ETH Zurich
- Benefits, such as public transport season tickets and car-sharing schemes, a wide range of sports activities organised by the ASVZ, childcare, and attractive pension schemes

We value diversity and sustainability
In line with our values, ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future.

Curious? So are we.
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:
- Cover letter
- CV
- Employment references and diplomas

Further information about ETH's Research Contracts Group and on ETH Zurich │ Space can be found on our website. Questions may be addressed to Andreas Klöti, Head Research Contracts Group, andreas.kloeti@sl.ethz.ch (no applications).

Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.

jobs.title: Research Software Engineer for Computational Mass Spectrometry
jobs.description:
The Functional Genomics Center Zurich (FGCZ) is a joint state-of-the-art research and training facility of the ETH Zurich and the University of Zurich. With the latest technologies and key expertise for omics research, the FGCZ provides research services and project support to the Zurich life science research community.

We are looking for a Research Software Engineer at Functional Genomics Center Zurich as soon as possible or upon agreement.
Project background

This position is centered on mass spectrometry data, with a primary focus on bioinformatics analysis and interpretation in support of researchers at the FGCZ. Within that field, the team covers raw data processing, high-performance computing, statistical evaluation, interpretation, and integrated analysis. The unit maintains a portfolio of commercial and open-source applications operating on our infrastructure and establishes novel data processing and analysis pipelines.  An integral part of the work is integrating the data into our data management system and ensuring the reproducibility of the analysis.

Job description
- You will support the FGCZ proteomics and metabolomics user community by maintaining existing and developing new mass spectrometric data processing and analysis pipelines
- In this role, you will apply your expertise in informatics and data science to ensure the reproducibility of the data analysis performed
- As a member of the FGCZ bioinformatics group, you will have back-office and user-desk tasks to support our collaborators at ETH and the University of Zurich with data interpretation and bioinformatics projects

Profile
Required Skills and Experiences:
- Team player - working closely with wet-lab scientists and translating their needs into analysis
- Academic degree in any of the relevant areas, including (but not limited to) computer science, statistics, or biology
- A master’s degree in a relevant field; candidates with a Ph.D. are equally welcome to apply
- Proficiency in Microsoft Windows and Linux operating systems, including command-line interfaces
- Practical knowledge of at least one programming language (C++, C#, Java, Python) and tools such as Git
- Responsible and informed use of AI-assisted tools in a scientific context

Preferred Skills and Experiences:
- Familiarity with the management and analysis of large-scale datasets, in particular omics-related data
- Background in bioinformatics, ideally in mass spectrometry
- Experience in imaging, spatial, or cross-omics disciplines
- Proven track record of writing and maintaining code
- Experience in R/Bioconductor and client-side web programming
- Experience with UI/UX design, particularly the development of web-based or desktop interfaces for scientific data visualization
- Experience with virtualization tools, e.g., Docker, Apptainer
- Experience with resource managment software, e.g., Slurm

The ability to work independently is a prerequisite, as is the ability to interact effectively with the center's research and technical staff and external research groups in a team-oriented manner Advanced knowledge of English is essential, as this is the working language of the center.

We particularly encourage applications from early-career candidates eager to develop their skills in a stimulating research environment.

We offer
A highly interesting position at the intersection of technology and life science research. Employment conditions are according to the regulations of ETH Zurich and the University of Zurich. Working at the FGCZ allows collaboration with our international, multicultural group in a motivating, friendly, and flexible atmosphere. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future.

Further information about FGCZ  can be found on our Website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Christian Panse, cp@fgcz.ethz.ch (no applications).

jobs.description:
About Infinity Motion Services:

Infinity Motion Services (IMS) is a Swiss high-performance figure skating organisation dedicated to developing athletes through a comprehensive and scientifically based coaching methodology.
Our mission is to provide long-term athlete development by combining technical excellence, evidence-based coaching, physical preparation and international competitive exposure. We work with competitive skaters of different ages and levels, supporting their progression from foundational skills to national and international competition.
To support the continued expansion of our activities, we are seeking an exceptionally experienced Senior Figure Skating Technical Director & High Performance Coach who will lead the technical direction of our skating programmes and contribute to the long-term development of our athletes and coaching philosophy.

Position Summary:

The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing and supervising the technical development pathway of competitive figure skaters while ensuring the highest coaching standards throughout all stages of athlete development.
This position combines high-level technical coaching, programme development, coach mentoring and athlete support during domestic and international competitions.
The role requires an individual capable of integrating modern sports science with proven figure skating coaching methodologies to maximise athlete performance over the long term.

Key Responsibilities:

•    Design and implement long-term technical development programmes for competitive figure skaters.
•    Deliver elite-level coaching in skating skills, edge quality, jump technique, spin development and overall technical progression.
•    Develop individual annual and multi-year athlete development plans.
•    Design structured technical progression systems tailored to athletes of different ages and competitive levels.
•    Monitor athlete progress through continuous technical evaluation and performance analysis.
•    Integrate on-ice technical development with off-ice conditioning programmes, including strength, flexibility, coordination, rotational training and injury prevention.
•    Collaborate with choreographers, off-ice trainers, physiotherapists, sports scientists and other specialists to ensure holistic athlete development.
•    Mentor and support junior coaches through technical education and knowledge transfer.
•    Develop coaching guidelines and technical documentation supporting organisational coaching standards.
•    Organise and conduct international figure skating camps and technical seminars.
•    Participate in talent identification and athlete selection.
•    Support parents through regular communication regarding athlete development plans.
•    Maintain the highest safeguarding, ethical and professional coaching standards.
•    Accompany athletes throughout the competitive season, including domestic and international competitions, training camps and development programmes, ensuring continuous technical supervision before, during and after performances. Responsibilities include competition planning, technical briefings, rink-side coaching, performance evaluation, coordination with event organisers and continuous communication with athletes and their families to support long-term athletic development.

Required Qualifications:

The successful candidate must demonstrate all of the following qualifications:
•    Master's Degree (or equivalent higher education qualification) in Sport Sciences, Physical Education or a closely related discipline.
•    Minimum 20 years of professional coaching experience in competitive figure skating.
•    Demonstrated experience coaching athletes from beginner level through advanced competitive levels.
•    Proven experience designing long-term athlete development programmes.
•    Extensive knowledge of skating skills, edge quality, jump mechanics, spin development and competition preparation.
•    Strong understanding of biomechanics and evidence-based coaching methodologies.
•    Demonstrated ability to integrate sports science principles into daily coaching activities.
•    Experience coordinating both on-ice and off-ice athlete development.
•    Experience organising and leading international figure skating camps.
•    Experience working with athletes across multiple age categories.
•    Strong communication skills with athletes, parents and multidisciplinary coaching teams.
•    Excellent organisational and planning abilities.
•    Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within an international coaching environment.
•    Fluency in English (written and spoken).

Preferred Qualifications:

Candidates possessing one or more of the following qualifications will be considered particularly suitable:
•    Experience working with athletes who have achieved success at national or international level.
•    Previous collaboration with Olympic-level or World Championship coaching teams.
•    Proven experience within internationally recognised Russian figure skating technical schools or coaching systems is considered a strong asset.
•    Strong understanding of the methodologies traditionally associated with the Russian school of figure skating, particularly in technical skill development, jump progression and long-term athlete development.
•    Experience mentoring elite coaches.
•    Advanced knowledge of off-ice conditioning specifically developed for figure skating athletes.
•    Experience designing integrated technical development pathways for competitive clubs and high-performance programmes.
•    International coaching experience across Europe.
•    Ability to develop evidence-based coaching systems that can be transferred across different athlete profiles.
•    Knowledge of athlete monitoring methodologies and performance evaluation systems.

International Competition & Travel Requirements:

The successful candidate must be willing and able to work in Switzerland while maintaining a highly flexible international travel schedule.
The role requires frequent travel throughout Europe and, when necessary, internationally to accompany athletes during competitions, training camps, technical seminars and other high-performance events.
Availability to travel on weekends, public holidays and during school holiday periods is essential, as athletes regularly compete and participate in training camps outside standard working days.
The successful candidate will be expected to provide on-site technical coaching throughout the entire duration of competitions and training camps, including official practice sessions, warm-ups, competition preparation, rink-side coaching during performances, post-performance technical analysis and athlete supervision.
Candidates should also demonstrate proven experience accompanying athletes to national and international competitions while coordinating effectively with event organisers, technical officials, coaching teams and athletes' families.

Personal Profile:

We are looking for an individual who demonstrates:
•    Outstanding technical expertise.
•    Exceptional attention to detail.
•    Passion for athlete development.
•    Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities.
•    Calm and confident decision-making under competitive pressure.
•    Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
•    Ability to motivate athletes while maintaining high technical standards.
•    High ethical standards and professional integrity.
•    Commitment to continuous professional development.
•    Strong organisational and planning capabilities.
•    Collaborative mindset within multidisciplinary coaching environments.

What We Offer:

•    Permanent employment within an ambitious Swiss high-performance figure skating organisation.
•    Opportunity to shape the long-term technical direction of a growing international programme.
•    International coaching environment.
•    Professional autonomy.
•    Competitive salary package commensurate with qualifications and experience.
•    Continuous professional development opportunities.
•    Opportunity to contribute to the development of athletes competing nationally and internationally.

Application Process:

Applicants should submit:
•    Detailed Curriculum Vitae.
•    Copies of academic qualifications.
•    Summary of coaching achievements.
•    Relevant coaching certifications.
•    Professional references.

Only candidates whose qualifications and professional experience closely match the requirements outlined above will be contacted for the next stage of the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Tiiminvetäjä – Ota seuraava askel myyntiurallasi
jobs.description:
**Haluatko siirtyä myyjästä valmentajaksi ja rakentaa omaa tiimiäsi?**

Etsimme tavoitteellista ja yrittäjähenkistä tiiminvetäjää johtamaan kasvavaa B2C-asiakashankintatiimiämme.

Tämä voi olla ensimmäinen esihenkilöroolisi – aikaisempaa kokemusta tiiminvetäjänä ei välttämättä tarvita. Tärkeintä on, että sinulla on halu kehittyä, innostaa muita onnistumaan ja rakentaa uraasi myynnin parissa.

Jos olet valmistumassa tai olet jo kartuttanut kokemusta myyntityöstä ja etsit seuraavaa askelta urallasi, tämä tehtävä voi olla juuri sinua varten.

**Mitä tiiminvetäjä tekee?**

Vastaat noin 10 hengen B2C-asiakashankintatiimin arjen onnistumisesta.

Tehtäväsi sisältää muun muassa:

- uusien tiimiläisten perehdyttämisen ja kouluttamisen


- tiimin päivittäisen valmentamisen ja motivoinnin


- myyntitulosten seuraamisen ja tavoitteiden saavuttamisen tukemisen


- hyvän tiimihengen rakentamisen


- uusien toimintatapojen kehittämisen yhdessä myynninjohdon kanssa


Tiiminvetäjän työ on käytännönläheistä. Noin puolet työajastasi työskentelet myös itse uusasiakashankinnan parissa. Näin pysyt mukana arjen tekemisessä, kehität omaa osaamistasi ja johdat tiimiä esimerkillä.

**Et jää yksin**

Saat tehtävääsi vahvan tuen kokeneelta myynninjohdolta.

Perehdytämme sinut tehtävään ja autamme sinua onnistumaan niin myynnissä kuin tiimin johtamisessakin. Tavoitteemme on auttaa sinua kasvamaan myynnin seuraavan tason ammattilaiseksi.

**Kenelle tehtävä sopii?**

Voit olla esimerkiksi:

- myyntityössä jo kokemusta kartuttanut tekijä, joka haluaa seuraavan urastepin


- AMK-opiskelija tai vastavalmistunut liiketalouden, myynnin tai muun soveltuvan alan koulutuksesta


- kunnianhimoinen henkilö, joka haluaa oppia johtamaan ihmisiä käytännössä


Aikaisempi kokemus esihenkilötehtävistä ei ole välttämätöntä.

**Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen esimerkiksi:**

- puhelinmyynnistä


- B2C-myynnistä


- asiakashankinnasta


- tavoitteellisesta myyntityöstä


**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Toivomme, että olet:

- tavoitteellinen ja yrittäjähenkinen


- innostava ja helposti lähestyttävä


- valmis ottamaan vastuuta


- kiinnostunut ihmisten valmentamisesta


- motivoitunut kehittämään sekä itseäsi että tiimiäsi


Haluamme rakentaa pitkäjänteisesti kasvavaa tiimiä, joten arvostamme sitoutumista ja halua tehdä asioita yhdessä.

**Ansainta**

Tehtävä on tulosperusteinen ja yrittäjähenkinen.

Ansiosi muodostuvat sekä:

- omasta myyntityöstäsi


- oman tiimisi onnistumisista


Alkuvaiheessa tyypillinen ansiotaso on noin **2 000–4 000 €/kk**, ja osaamisen sekä tiimin kehittyessä ansaintamahdollisuudet kasvavat merkittävästi.

**Rakenna urasi meidän kanssamme**

Tämä tehtävä on erinomainen ponnahduslauta myynnin johtamiseen.

Onnistumisten myötä sinulla on mahdollisuus edetä esimerkiksi:

- suurempien myyntitiimien vetäjäksi


- B2B-myynnin vaativiin asiantuntijatehtäviin


- asiakkuuksien kehittämiseen


- myynninjohdon ja liiketoiminnan kehitystehtäviin


Me uskomme siihen, että parhaat johtajat kasvavat tekemisen kautta.

**Työskentelymalli**

Tehtävä toteutetaan yrittäjähenkisellä mallilla työsuhteessa tai voit toimia esimerkiksi kevytyrittäjänä tai oman yrityksesi kautta laskuttaen. Käymme yhteistyömallin läpi yhdessä valitun henkilön kanssa.

Haluatko rakentaa seuraavan askeleesi myyntiuralla?

Etsimme ennen kaikkea hyvää tyyppiä – henkilöä, jonka kanssa voimme rakentaa kasvua pitkäjänteisesti.

Jos haluat päästä vaikuttamaan, oppimaan ja johtamaan omaa tiimiäsi, lähetä hakemuksesi jo tänään.

Kerro meille, kuka olet, millaista kokemusta sinulla on ja miksi juuri sinä haluaisit ottaa seuraavan askeleen urallasi.

Olemme yhteydessä sopivimpiin hakijoihin ja kerromme mielellämme lisää tehtävästä sekä mahdollisuuksista kasvaa yhdessä kanssamme.

Jätä hakemuksesi osoitteessa: https://www.intensive.fi/tyopaikat/

jobs.title: Autonasentaja
jobs.description:
Meille autonasentajaksi?

Haemme vakituiseen työsuhteeseen ammattitaitoista ja ahkeraa autonasentajaa, jolla on hyvä työasenne. Pystyt huoltamaan ja korjaamaan itsenäisesti henkilö- ja pakettiautoja. Sinulta onnistuu vianhaku, diagnosointi sekä haastavammatkin huolto- ja korjaustyöt.

Mitä toivomme hakijalta?

- autoalan koulutusta ja vähintään 1 vuoden työkokemusta alalta
- omatoimisuutta, huolellisuutta sekä tehokasta otetta työntekoon
- hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja joustavuutta
- Autofutur-ohjelmiston käyttökokemus on eduksi

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

- monipuolisen työn, jossa pääset kehittämään ammattitaitoasi
- mukavan ja rennon työporukan, jossa on helppo pyytää työkaverilta tarvittaessa apua
- kilpailukykyisen ja oikeudenmukaisen palkan (2 550 - 3000 euroa/kk)
- säännöllisen työajan ma-pe klo 8.00-16.30
- kattavan tapaturmavakuutuksen koskien myös vapaa-aikana sattuvia vahinkoja
- mahdollisuuden halutessasi korjata ja fiksata omia autojasi tiloissamme viikonloppuisin

Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian!

Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi, jossa kerrot itsestäsi sekä aiemmasta työkokemuksestasi ja osaamisestasi. Lähetäthän hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, sillä työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa toimitusjohtaja Eero Eloranta p. 045 872 3934, sähköposti: eero.eloranta@tampereenautolasipalvelu.fi.

Keitä me olemme?

Olemme paikallinen perheyritys. Meille on tärkeintä työntekijöidemme hyvä viihtyvyys sekä erinomainen asiakaspalvelu laadukkaan työnjäljen lisäksi. Kuulumme valtakunnallisiin Autofit ja First Stop -ketjuihin, jotka takaavat mahdollisuudet esim. lisäkoulutuksiin työntekijöiden oman kiinnostuksen mukaan. Työllistämme tällä hetkellä neljä autonasentajaa, kaksi työnjohtajaa ja kaksi tuulilasiasentajaa. Yrityksen virallinen nimi on Tampereen Autolasipalvelu Oy, joka on toiminut jo vuodesta 1993 alkaen. Yrittäjinä ovat toimineet vuodesta 2011 alkaen ylöjärveläiset Eero ja Katri Eloranta.

jobs.title: Butikssäljare & Kundmottagare
jobs.description:
Vill du vara med från start när vi öppnar vår nya butik i Pajala? Vi söker en serviceinriktad butikssäljare och kundmottagare som blir ansiktet utåt för vår nya verksamhet.

Om TEED Group

TEED Maintenance & Tires AB är en del av koncernen TEED Group.

TEED Group är en växande koncern i norra Norrbotten med verksamhet inom fordonsbranschen. Vår verksamhet vilar på fyra ben: biluthyrning, försäljning av begagnade fordon, verkstad samt detaljhandel med reservdelar, tillbehör och förbrukningsvaror. Vi fokuserar på person- och transportbilar och erbjuder därmed en helhet för både privatpersoner och företag – från hyrbil och fordonsköp till service, reparation och bilvård.

Biluthyrningen, som är vår största verksamhetsgren, finns idag i både Kiruna och Gällivare.

Fordonsförsäljningen och verkstaden utgår från Kiruna, och under 2026 tar vi nästa steg genom att etablera butik och kundmottagning i Pajala. Inom en snar framtid öppnar vi dessutom ytterligare en location i Norrbotten.

Idag är vi cirka 20 anställda – mekaniker, säljare, butiks- och kundmottagningspersonal samt dedikerade verksamhetsutvecklare och utesäljare, som alla brinner för fordon och nöjda kunder.

Hos oss möts du av kunnig personal, korta beslutsvägar och en genuin vilja att hjälpa. Vi har kollektivavtal och arbetar långsiktigt med både medarbetare och kundrelationer.

Om tjänsten

Vi öppnar en ny butik i Pajala med försäljning av reservdelar, tillbehör och förbrukningsvaror till bilar och övriga fordonstyper, bland annat extraljus, däck och fälg. Butiken fungerar också som kundmottagning för vår verkstad.

Rollen är bred och passar dig som gillar mötet med kunder och att ha många bollar i luften.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:

•     Försäljning och rådgivning i butik – reservdelar, tillbehör, extraljus, däck och fälg m.m.

•     Kundmottagning för verkstaden – boka in kunder, ta emot nycklar och lämna ut fordon

•     Planera dagens verkstadsjobb och fördela arbeten till mekanikerna

•     Kassahantering och betalning

•     Löpande kundkontakt – telefon, återkoppling och offertförfrågningar

•     Beställningar, varumottagning och att hålla butiken säljande och välorganiserad

Vem är du?

Du är serviceinriktad, strukturerad och trivs i en roll där du självständigt får ta ansvar för både butik och kundmottagning. Du har lätt för att samarbeta och kommunicera – med kunder, mekaniker och kollegor.

Krav:

•     B-körkort

•     Flytande svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift

Meriterande:

•     Kunskaper i finska

•     Erfarenhet från serviceyrke, gärna inom fordonsbranschen

•     Fordonsintresse och kunskap om reservdelar, däck och tillbehör

•     Vana vid kassasystem och datorbaserade bokningssystem

Vi erbjuder

•     Heltid, 40 timmar/vecka, måndag–fredag med dagtidsarbete

•     Kollektivavtal – Motorbranschens avtal

•     En nyckelroll i en ny etablering med stora möjligheter att påverka och växa

•     Stöd och samarbete med vårt etablerade team i Kiruna

Anställningsvillkor

•     Omfattning: Heltid, 100 %

•     Arbetstider: Måndag–fredag

•     Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning som inleds med provanställning

•     Tillträde: Snarast, enligt överenskommelse

•     Placering: Pajala

Ansökan

Skicka ditt CV och några rader om dig själv till jobb@tprab.se senast 2026-08-16.

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag, vänta därför inte med din ansökan.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Dina uppgifter

Som arbetsledare för skiduthyrning och logistik så både ansvarar du för och är med i den dagliga driften. Din chef har yttersta ansvaret för budget, men du löser alla funderingar som uppstår under dagen och håller alltid koll någon dag framåt på personal och arbetsuppgifter, så att alla hinner med det som ska göras.

Du planerar och genomför bland annat:

    

Planering av det som ska levereras till boendena.

    

Enklare schemaläggning.

    

Ser till att all personal vet vart de ska vara och vad de ska göra (stora dagar kan det vara ca 20-30 personer som jobbar ungefär samtidigt inne hos oss.)

    

Skruvar ihop utrustning som gäster bokat.

    

Hjälper när medarbetare och gäster har frågor och funderingar.

    

Peppar och stöttar medarbetare samt tar utvecklande samtal.

    

Arbetstiden är varierande, både dagtid, kvällstid och helger.

Vi erbjuder…

En inspirerande arbetsplats med en härlig sammanhållning där du får chansen att uppleva en vinter som du sent kommer att glömma.

    

Gratis säsongshyra av skidutrustning på nybörjarnivå

    

Rabatt på boende för familj och vänner

    

Förmånliga priser i skiduthyrning, butiker & restauranger.

Vem är du?

Du är en person som gillar att samarbeta, är självgående och är öppen för förändringar, du vågar ta snabba beslut och hitta lösningar på dagliga utmaningar som dyker upp. Vi jobbar i ett team med flera ledare som samarbetar dagligen, så ärlighet och öppenhet är något vi strävar efter hela tiden. Vi ser även att du har ett intresse för utförsåkning och tycker om att arbeta med människor – både vuxna och barn. Du är flexibel, stresstålig, ställer upp när det behövs och gillar att arbeta över avdelningsgränserna. Att du är glad, positiv och serviceinriktad ser vi som en självklarhet. I Kungsberget tror vi att glada medarbetare leder till glada gäster.

Rollen passar dig som trivs i ett högt arbetstempo och gillar att vara där det händer. Arbetet är fysiskt och innebär att du är i rörelse större delen av arbetsdagen, samtidigt som det förekommer tunga lyft. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början – vi tror på att lära genom att göra. Därför är det viktigt att du är nyfiken, vågar ställa frågor och ser varje arbetsdag som en möjlighet att utvecklas.

Krav

    

Du ska vara bekväm med både engelska och svenska språket.

    

B-körkort och tillgång till bil.

    

Kunna arbeta både dag- och kvällstid under vardagar och helger.

Erfarenhet av arbetsledarroll från tidigare jobb.

jobs.title: Job i Barcelona - Vil du videre fra Telemarketing og arbejde som Google Ads Sales and Onboarding Specialist?
jobs.description:
Vi søger en Google Ads Sales and Onboarding Specialist til vores internationale kontor i Barcelona. 

Har du arbejdet med salg eller Telemarketing i mere end et år, og er du klar til det næste skridt i den karriere? Eller brænder du for digital markedsføring og er du kreativ og vil gerne blive certificeret rådgiver der kan hjælpe andre med at lave succesfulde digitale kampagner? Hvis du er teknisk, kreativ og udadvendt og kan få tingene gjort i et tempofyldt, hurtigt skiftende miljø, har vi måske det perfekte job til dig!

Hvad laver en Google Ads Sales and Onboarding Specialist?

Du arbejder tæt sammen med ambitiøse virksomheder, der skal onboardes til digital vækst. Du rådgiver om Pay-Per-Click-kampagner (PPC), identificerer vækstmuligheder og skaber langsigtet værdi. Med forståelse for markedsdynamik og strategisk tænkning styrker du system integrering og kundeloyalitet — med effekt og relation i centrum.

Skaber vækst og digitale resultater

Du udvikler og optimerer kampagner, opsøger kunder via telefon og video, og identificerer løsninger, der matcher deres unikke behov. Du opbygger tillid og sikrer, at dine kunder får det fulde udbytte af deres digitale investeringer — både på kort og lang sigt.

Styrker kunderejser og partnerskaber

Du håndterer et højt volumen af kunder og rådgiver i komplekse kontekster. Du arbejder med strategier, der øger ROI og kampagnespend, og bistår med integration på tværs af platforme. Du bruger AI-værktøjer i din dagligdag og kommunikerer effektivt med forskellige interessenter — altid med respekt for datasikkerhed og GDPR.

Du bliver en del af et globalt team i hjertet af Barcelona, hvor teknologi og marketing mødes. 

Engelsktalende arbejdsmiljø er standard, og du får fuldt betalt oplæring, personlige coaches og adgang til certificeringer. Stillingen åbner døre til intern karriereudvikling og spændende projekter inden for digital markedsføring.

Dit ansvar:

  • Onboarding af kunder og opbygning af langsigtede relationer over telefon og videomøder

  • Udvikling af performance-drevne PPC-strategier

  • Proaktivt salg og kampagneoptimering

  • Opdatering og vedligeholdelse af kundedata

  • Rådgivning om digital positionering og annoncering

  • Forståelse for ROI og integration med andre platforme

  • Support og strategisk planlægning på nordisk niveau

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Dansk og engelsk på minimum C1

  • Bachelorgrad eller relevant erfaring i marketing/salg/Telemarketing

  • Kendskab til Google Ads, CRM og datastyring

  • Proaktiv og strategisk tilgang til kundeopgaver

  • Evne til at navigere i komplekse stakeholder-miljøer

  • Passion for digital markedsføring og forretningsudvikling

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav — hvis rollen vækker din interesse, opfordrer vi dig stadig til at søge!

Benefits:

  • Fast fuldtidsstilling (39 timer/uge) med hybridmodel i Barcelona

  • Flyttepakke med flybillet og indkvartering i privat studie

  • Privat sygeforsikring og sundhedsfokus

  • Bonus for at anbefale en ven

  • Certificeringer og løbende kompetenceudvikling

  • Arbejdsmiljø med sociale aktiviteter og teambuilding

  • Kontor med havudsigt i World Trade Center, Barcelona

Hvad får du ud af at tage afsted?

Barcelona byder på solrige dage, strandliv og kreativ energi. Her kan du nyde tapas ved havet, arbejde med banebrydende teknologi og udvikle dig både personligt og professionelt i et byliv, der aldrig står stille. Derudover får du:

  • Lavere leveomkostninger end Danmark

  • Kunst, musik, tech og kultur i dynamisk samspil

  • Fokus på trivsel og diversitet

  • Internationale brands og karrieremuligheder

  • Åben og inkluderende atmosfære

Professionel udvikling:

  • Indsigt i digital markedsføring og internationale arbejdskulturer

  • Specialiseret viden om Google Ads og online strategi

  • Fuld oplæring og adgang til certificeringer

  • Karriereveje inden for tech, salg og rådgivning

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med kunder fra hele Europa

Personlig vækst og karriere:

Forestil dig at starte dagen med café con leche, arbejde med digitale strategier under palmerne og slutte af med live-musik ved stranden. Hos TP får du ikke bare et job — du får muligheden for at bygge en karriere, forme fremtiden og leve livet fuldt ud.

Barcelona er stedet, hvor arbejde og livskvalitet går op i en højere enhed.

jobs.title: Service Locator
jobs.description:
Building a sustainable tomorrow

KierBAM are a Joint Venture (JV) partnership between Kier and BAM UK & Ireland - BAM UK & Ireland's infrastructure segment is currently delivering the redevelopment project at a Royal Navy site located in Plymouth and we are seeking an experienced Service Locator.


The Service Locator will carry out the physical check and survey of all of the underground services within the area that is being investigated, the Service Locator will have the following responsibilities. You will use various geophysical techniques to locate the service, once they have been found, the services will be marked/spray painted onto the ground in the appropriate colour, defining the type and depth of the service. You will also maintain the contents of the permits on site, making sure the workforce remains compliant with conditions and processes outlined within the permits.

Due to the site being a high-security military naval base, additional security checks will be required a BPSS level of security clearance is necessary. These checks can take up to 8 weeks to process. Only candidates holding EU, NATO, 5 Eyes, or MISWG member passports and who have been UK residents for the last 5 years can be considered for this role.

Your team
  • Location: Devonport Dockyard, Plymouth
  • Contract: Permanent, 42.5 hours a week
Making Possible

In this role as Service Locator, you will be working in a live MOD facility. Your day-to-day tasks will include:

  • Authorise Permit to Break Surface
  • Ensure compliance with and enforcement of the project permit for the Break Ground procedure
  • Review method statements tailored to specific tasks
  • Mark all services within the work boundaries to protect colour standards
  • Provide teams with an overview of the services within their designated work boundaries and discuss methods for working around those affected services.
  • Implement an 8-point checklist during work gang briefings
  • Enforce any designated exclusion zones surrounding affected services
  • Obtain the required signatures for permit approval from the works team and the Project Engineer
  • Notify the BOSC of any discrepancies in the records
  • Investigate uncharted services as directed by the BOSC
  • Inform the BOSC of any services that have been removed from the work area, ensuring the service drawings are updated accordingly
  • Attach the most current SMD CAD drawing to the permit-to-dig
  • Ensure that no work gang operates under an expired permit for breaking ground or in an area lacking a permit.
  • Maintain service markings for the duration of the permit as well as incremental scans as excavations progress
  • This profile is not exhaustive. From time to time, you may be required by the Company to perform other tasks, which are not included in the above description, but are within your capabilities and, where necessary, training, and full support will be given
What do you bring to the role?

Essential:

  • We are seeking a candidate who can handle multiple tasks, show flexibility, and become a key contributor to our team
  • A CSCS Card is required (this must be obtained before commencing work)
  • Familiarity with Electromagnetic location and ground penetrating radar is essential
  • A solid understanding of industry practices and standards related to utility detection, including PAS 128 and TSA, is important
  • Candidates should have a proficient working knowledge of surveying equipment, such as GPR, CAT, and Genny utility detection tools
  • The ability to collaborate and communicate effectively within a team and interact with clients on-site is required
  • Knowledge of HSG-47 and GS-6

Desirable

  • Experience in the Nuclear environment would be considered beneficial
  • QCF Level 3 or Level 5 certification in utility mapping is preferred
  • Applicants should possess a minimum of 2-3 years of utility surveying experience
Whats in it for you?
  • Competitive salary
  • A wide range of family-friendly policies
  • Company car/car allowance/travel allowance
  • 8 % matched pension contributions
  • Private healthcare
  • Life assurance
  • 26 days holiday
  • 2 wellbeing days
  • 1 volunteering day
  • Personal and professional development
About BAM

Building a sustainable tomorrow. Thats our mission and our promise at BAM. Its how we engineer vital infrastructure and construct high-quality buildings as one of the largest construction companies in Europe.

We strive to create an environment where everybody feels welcome and valued. Were on an exciting journey to employ the best talent to join us regardless of social background, race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability or other characteristics.

jobs.title: Údržbáře - mechanika - seřizovače stáčecích kelímkovacích strojů, Obsluha strojů a zařízení na výrobu a zpracování papíru
jobs.description:
Společnost EKOBAL ROŽNOV s.r.o. hledá údržbáře - mechanika - seřizovače stáčecích kelímkovacích strojů
Jsme stabilní a rostoucí výrobní společnost s dlouholetou tradicí na trhu. Zakládáme si na kvalitě našich produktů a efektivitě výrobních procesů. Přidejte se k týmu, který udržuje naše klíčové výrobní linky v chodu.
Jsi zručný mechanik s technickým myšlením a složité stroje ti nejsou cizí? Máte rád, když věci šlapou jako hodinky a umíte je rychle najít a opravit, když se něco zadrhne? Pak hledáme přesně Vás!

Co bude Vaše hlavní náplň práce?
•    Preventivní a operativní údržba a opravy poloautomatizovaných kelímkvacích strojů (mechanická, pneumatická, elektrická část). Budete mozek a ruce našich poloautomatických kelímkovacích stroje.
•    Přestavba a seřizování kelímkovacích strojů při přechodu na jiný typ a velikost kelímku. Preciznost je klíč.
•    Diagnostika a odstraňování závad kelímkovacích strojů a  periférních zařízení. Vedení evidence oprav a údržby v SW Klid
•    Zajištění plynulého chodu výroby a minimalizace prostojů. Starat se o to, aby naše stroje jely nonstop a bez poruch (servis, mazání, kontrola – prostě prevence).
•    Spolupráce s oddělením výroby, technologie a kvality. Žádné stereotypy, každý den je jiný problém k vyřešení!
•    Drobné zámečnické práce a práce s nástroji. Výběr a udržování pohotovostního skladu náhradních dílů. Úzká spolupráce s externími firmami při zajišťování speciálních dílů a dalších prací.
Co od Vás očekáváme?
•    Minimálně SŠ/SOU v oboru mechanik, provozní zámečník, elektrikář, mechatronik nebo jiném relevantním technickém oboru.
•    Praxe na obdobné pozici (údržba/seřizování výrobních nebo balicích linek) je velkou výhodou a Vaše eso v rukávu.
•    Znalost elektrotechniky, mechaniky, pneumatiky/hydrauliky.
•    Platná vyhláška 50/1978 Sb.
•    Schopnost číst technickou dokumentaci a výkresy.
•    Samostatnost, spolehlivost a ochota pracovat ve směnném provozu.
Co Vám nabízíme?
•    Stabilní zaměstnání na hlavní pracovní poměr ve firmě s pevnou pozicí na trhu.
•    Motivační finanční ohodnocení a systém prémií dle dosažených výsledků
•    4 týdny dovolené a zaměstnanecké benefity (stravenkový paušál/ příspěvek na penzijní připojištění, firemní akce).
•    Možnost profesního rozvoje a odborných školení.
•    Moderní pracovní prostředí a technické vybavení.

jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer
jobs.description:
Description

The Chief Operating Officer (COO) is the senior operational leader of U.S. Hunger, responsible for translating enterprise strategy into daily execution. This role owns P&L performance across all business lines â Full Cart, Hunger Projects, and the Data/Intelligence engine â ensuring the organization's earned-income model (97%+ of total revenue) operates with precision, accountability, and scalability.

The COO must bring the instincts of an entrepreneur and the discipline of a corporate operator: connecting dots others miss, asking tough questions that drive clarity, and building the systems that allow talented leaders to perform at their highest level. Operational excellence and mission-aligned impact are not in tension here â they are the same thing.

Enterprise Operations & P&L Execution

  • Own P&L execution across all business lines â each engine must meet its margin, revenue, and impact targets.
  • Establish and drive the operating cadence â monthly reviews, quarterly business performance reporting, and clear accountability across departments.
  • Make resource allocation decisions across competing priorities â deploying people, capital, and attention against the highest-value opportunities.
  • Present operational performance, capacity, and growth execution to the Board of Directors.
  • Partner with the CEO on scenario planning, structural growth strategies, and enterprise-wide decision-making.

Program Leadership â Full Cart & Hunger Projects

  • Provide executive oversight of Full Cart and Hunger Projects â ensuring delivery excellence, measurable outcomes, and scalability.
  • Partner with program directors to evaluate, evolve, and scale programs in response to partner needs, market opportunities, and operational realities.
  • Drive integration between program design, data infrastructure, and client-facing delivery â ensuring mission impact and revenue execution are operationally connected.
  • Oversee supply chain and logistics operations to ensure consistent, high-quality program delivery at scale.

Revenue Growth & Partner Execution

  • Own enterprise revenue execution across health plan partnerships, corporate engagement, and strategic growth opportunities â ensuring acquisition and retention targets are consistently met.
  • Drive strategies that deepen existing partner relationships and expand engagement across multiple service lines, maximizing long-term value and organizational sustainability.
  • Represent U.S. Hunger externally with payors, partners, and stakeholders â translating operational insight into compelling value propositions that differentiate USH in the market.
  • Leverage buyer-side CSR experience and existing relationships across the corporate social impact and food access ecosystem to accelerate partner acquisition and deepen engagement.

Cross-Functional Alignment & Executive Leadership

  • Partner with the Chief Technology Officer to define business requirements, program design priorities, and operational needs that shape the technology and data roadmap â ensuring platform delivery enables execution across all business lines.
  • Manage the VP of Finance & Enterprise KPIs and VP of People & Culture â two executives who maintain direct visibility to the CEO through their seat at the executive table â ensuring fiscal discipline, enterprise analytics, and workforce strategy are aligned with operational goals.
  • Actively contribute to organizational governance, strategy, and enterprise-wide decision-making as the CEO's primary operational counterpart.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing operational leadership team â setting clear expectations, driving accountability, and coaching leaders who are growing into executive-level roles.
  • Develop performance metrics and accountability systems that connect individual and team outcomes to enterprise financial and impact objectives.
  • Promote a culture of rigorous inquiry, collaboration, and continuous improvement â where leaders are expected to think critically, challenge assumptions, and own their outcomes.
  • Foster an environment where staff understand both the business drivers of USH's earned-income model and the transformative impact of their work on the communities served.

These essential job functions are not to be construed as a complete statement of all duties performed. Employees will be required to perform other duties as required.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership in operations, business management, or revenue execution â with direct P&L ownership.
  • Experience building, running, or scaling a business â including sales growth, client retention, and financial performance accountability.
  • Proven ability to lead and develop directors and VPs â coaching strong operators into executive-level leaders while holding them accountable to outcomes.
  • Demonstrated pattern of connecting dots across functions â seeing how operational, financial, people, and program decisions impact each other.
  • Experience at the board level â presenting performance, defending strategy, and engaging C-suite stakeholders directly.
  • Experience in mission-driven, earned-income environments where market discipline and social impact must coexist.
  • Strong communication across corporate, nonprofit, healthcare, and community sectors â direct, polished, and confident.
  • High emotional intelligence, with the courage to ask tough questions, the polish to challenge constructively, and the vision to see what's possible before it's obvious.
  • Background check is required for this role

Essential Physical Skills

  • Repetitive finger motion as used in computer use.
  • Extensive work with computer screens
  • Everyday requirements of bending, grabbing, holding, and lifting light objects
  • Work on Hunger Projects requires heavy lifting (up to 50 lbs), moving objects, pushing, and pulling, bending and kneeling
  • Up to 50% travel time

The successful candidate will be highly organized, service-oriented, comfortable using technology, and committed to maintaining the confidentiality and accuracy of employee information.

Core Responsibilities

Recruitment & Talent Coordination

  • Support candidate communications using approved templates
  • Track candidate status and documentation in the applicant tracking system
  • Assist with pre-employment requirements
  • Maintain accurate recruiting records and candidate files
  • Support job fairs, community outreach, internship activities, and recruiting events
  • Provide a professional, timely, and welcoming candidate experience

Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Coordinate pre-employment and onboarding activities after an offer has been accepted
  • Send new-hire forms, instructions, orientation schedules, and required notices
  • Track completion of pre-employment requirements, background checks, employment documents, and onboarding tasks
  • Coordinate the timely completion and retention of Form I-9 documentation in accordance with established procedures
  • Coordinate with hiring managers, Payroll, Information Technology, Learning and Development, and other departments to support new-hire readiness
  • Confirm that new employees receive appropriate system access, equipment information, schedules, and introductory materials
  • Support new-hire orientation logistics and attendance tracking
  • Follow up on incomplete forms or onboarding requirements
  • Initiate separation checklists after receiving appropriate authorization
  • Schedule exit interviews or distribute exit questionnaires

HR Compliance & Documentation

  • Assist with personnel-file, I-9, benefits, training, and HR data audits
  • Track required documents, acknowledgments, certifications, and renewal dates
  • Assist with preparing records for internal and external audits
  • Follow established HR policies, procedures, record-retention requirements, and confidentiality standards
  • Escalate incomplete, inconsistent, or potentially noncompliant documentation
  • Maintain current versions of approved HR forms, templates, notices, and resources
  • Support the distribution and tracking of required employee notices

Benefits & Employee Support

  • Route plan interpretation and eligibility questions to the HR Generalist or appropriate team member
  • Support annual Open Enrollment communications, scheduling, and administrative preparation
  • Assist with routine employee reminders and documentation follow-up
  • Maintain confidentiality of medical and benefits information
  • Support benefits and leave audits as requested

HR Operations & Administrative Support

  • Provide general administrative support for the HR team, including scheduling meetings, tracking training completion, and preparing reports
  • Assist with HR initiatives such as employee engagement events, training programs, and performance review cycles
  • Maintain organized HR documentation and assist with reporting needs as requested by leadership

Success Measures

  • Accurate and timely recruitment coordination and onboarding completion
  • Compliance with California labor laws and HR documentation standards
  • High responsiveness and professionalism in employee communication
  • Well-maintained, audit-ready personnel records
  • Efficient support of HR initiatives and department operations

Skills That Set You Apart

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • One year of administrative, customer service, office, recruiting, payroll, healthcare, or Human Resources support experience preferred
  • An associate degree, bachelor's degree, Human Resources coursework, internship, or relevant professional training may substitute for some experience
  • Entry-level candidates with strong administrative and customer-service capabilities are encouraged to apply
  • High level of professionalism, discretion, and ability to handle confidential information
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Slides)
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a remote team

Benefits

Time Off & Leave

  • Paid Time Off
  • Holidays
  • Volunteer time
  • Bereavement

Health & Wellness

  • Medical coverage
  • FSAs or other wellness benefits
  • Disability and EAP

Financial & Professional

  • 401(k)
  • Stipends
  • Professional development

Culture & Perks

  • Employee discounts
  • Team events
  • Growth opportunities

Equal Opportunity Employer

Pacific Health Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable workplace where all individuals are treated with dignity and respect. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), age (40 and over), marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, or status as a victim of domestic violence, assault, or stalking. We value diversity in all forms and encourage individuals from historically underrepresented communities to apply.

Job Application & Offer Disclaimer

Pacific Health Group is committed to maintaining a transparent, lawful, and secure hiring process in compliance with California labor laws and employment standards. Employment offers are contingent upon meeting role qualifications and successfully completing all required recruitment steps, which may include:

  • Submission of an internal application
  • Recruiter pre-screen
  • Skills assessment if applicable
  • Final interview with hiring leadership
  • Formal verbal offer from authorized hiring representatives

Important Notice: Any communication claiming to represent Pacific Health Group that bypasses this process is not authorized.

AI & Human Interaction in Recruitment

Pacific Health Group uses AI tools to assist with resume matching based on qualifications, skills, and location. All qualified applications are reviewed by our recruiting and HR team to ensure fair, equitable, and human-centered hiring decisions.

a) montaż lub naprawa zamków,
b) wymiana przepalonych żarówek, naprawa i wymiana gniazdek,
c) naprawa urządzeń sanitarnych,
d) montaż regałów,

a) pomoc w rozładunku i załadunku towarów,
b) układaniu towaru w magazynach, ustawianiu mebli itp.
4.Opieka nad bezpieczeństwem budynku i całością sprzętu, narzędzi oraz nad urządzeniami wykorzystywanymi do wykonywania obowiązków.
5.Zabezpieczanie urządzeń kanalizacyjnych, wodociągowych  utrzymanie drożności instalacji wodno  kanalizacyjnej.
6.Drobne naprawy sprzętu i wyposażenia pomieszczeń.
7.Dbałość o czystość w budynku wewnątrz i na zewnątrz.
8.Pomoc przy dekoracji pomieszczeń budynku.

jobs.title: Behandlingsasssistent till Adelsö
jobs.description:
2 plats(er).


Vill du ha en bred och utmanande tjänst med möjlighet att utveckla din förmåga att arbeta lågaffektivt, stöttande och motiverande? Välkommen att söka tjänst som behandlingsassistent hos oss på Adelsö!

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Som behandlingsassistent kommer du att arbeta motivationsfrämjande tillsammans med klienterna och ge stöd inom olika livsområden som beroende, psykisk ohälsa, boende, familj, ekonomi och att finna en meningsfull fritid. I arbetet ingår samarbete med andra yrkesgrupper, samt dokumentation, rapportering och uppföljning av ärenden. Du kommer att ha rollen som kontaktperson och ta ansvar för de arbetsuppgifter som följer med denna funktion. Du kommer även att ha delegering för medicindelning, samt utföra andra hälso- och sjukvårdsrelaterade arbetsuppgifter.

För att kunna ge ett effektivt stöd till målgruppen är det viktigt att du har ett relationsskapande och stabilt förhållningssätt. Du ser möjligheter även i komplexa livssituationer och är beslutsam och tydlig när det behövs. Du bör också ha förmågan att hantera utmanande beteenden.

Arbetstiden är heltid, med ett schema som inkluderar kvällar och helger.

Din kompetens

Du har en YH/KY utbildning som behandlingsassistent/socialpedagog eller utbildning som undersköterska med inriktning mot psykiatri eller liknande som arbetsgivaren finner relevant för tjänsten. Vi ser att du har tidigare erfarenhet av arbete med beroende eller psykisk funktionsnedsättning och goda digitala kunskaper med en vana att dokumentera. Du har goda kunskaper i svenska tal och skrift då en stor del av arbetet innebär dokumentation.

Vi söker dig som har ett lösningsfokuserat förhållningssätt och som motiveras av att möta personer med motivationsbehov. Du är stabil och trygg i din roll och kan skilja på det personliga och det professionella i relation med våra klienter. Du är lugn och kontrollerad och har förmågan att behålla ditt fokus på rätt saker vid pressade situationer. Du är också flexibel och har lätt för att anpassa dig till nya och oväntade omständigheter

Då bilkörning ingår i tjänsten är B-körkort ett krav. Du har även en god förståelse för och delar de värderingar som ligger till grund för kommunens verksamhet.

Vi erbjuder

Adelsö är ett av 8 boenden inom Enheten för stöd och boende, under individ och familjeförvaltningen i Västerås stad. Adelsö erbjuder 15 permanenta platser för personer med skadligt bruk och beroende och samsjuklighet. På Adelsö får du ge stöd och hjälp till klienter som har stödbehov i sin vardag. Klienternas stödbehov kan skilja sig åt beroende på psykisk eller fysisk ohälsa eller andra sociala svårigheter men med klienten i fokus så arbetar vi alltid för bästa möjliga möte. Här får du chansen att utveckla dina förmågor att hantera kommunikativa och relationella utmaningar med klienter, arbeta strukturerat i klienters vårdplaner och att driva verksamheten framåt.

Här blir du en del av något större! Med värme och respekt visar vi handlingskraft i det stora och det lilla. Vi lever vår värdegrund i mötet med varandra och de vi är till för. Varje dag, året runt ser vi till att Västerås fungerar. Tillsammans med dina ca 11 500 kollegor runt om i staden får du Sveriges viktigaste jobb.

Läs mer om möjligheter, karriärvägar och om vårt erbjudande här:
https://www.vasteras.se/jobbochkarriär (https://www.vasteras.se/jobbochkarriär)  

Övrig information

I samband med intervju behöver du styrka ditt medborgarskap. Det kan du göra med pass alternativt personbevis tillsammans med ID-handling. Om du inte är medborgare i Sverige, EU, EES eller Schweiz måste du uppvisa att du har ett giltigt arbetstillstånd eller är undantagen från skyldigheten att ha arbetstillstånd. Anställning kan ske först efter kontroll av arbetstillstånd, vilket krävs enligt utlänningsförordningen.

Alla erbjudanden om rekryterings- och annonseringshjälp undanbedes.

jobs.title: Senior Credit Structurer - Large Corporates (M/F)
jobs.description:
Description de tâches:

Founded in 1856, Banque Internationale à Luxembourg is the oldest multi-business bank in the Grand Duchy. From its foundation, the BIL has always played an active role in the development of the Luxembourg economy. It currently operates in retail, private and corporate banking, as well as on major capital markets. Employing more than 2 000 people, BIL is present in the financial hotspots that are Luxembourg, Switzerland, and China.

As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

Your next challenge:

The Senior Credit Structurer is responsible for assessing and evaluating the feasibility of credit request and providing structuring solutions within acceptable credit /risk parameters, while developing the Bank's lending portfolio in line with the Bank's strategy and risk appetite

Your will:

• Analyze complex credit requests (Large Corporates) and develop solutions within acceptable credit/risk parameters.
• Provide the credit rating for requests.
• Ensure credit structuring/granting is aligned with Bank's Risk appetite, limits, Policy, and Procedures.
• Within the Delegation Authority Framework, decide on credit files.
• Responsible for business development and revenues growth remaining within Bank's Risk Appetite.
• Play a key role in credit approval process and follow up on the implementation of credit files in line with the decision.
• Check the data quality of the credit request (in the systems and in the credit sheet).
• Follow up of the annual revision of customers (GEC) and ratings

Your skills:

• Credit & Financial Instruments expertise (T24 / Globe / Internal Rating Tools / RAROC application)
• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar position
• Fluent in English and French
• Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify potential risks, assess their impact, and recommend appropriate risk mitigation measures.
• Working either in the Front Office or in credit risk management within the banking industry.
• Expertise in : Credit, Legal, analytical skills, decision taking, Relationship Management
• A bachelor's or master's degree in finance or a related field and / or equivalent professional experience (minimum 2 years)
• Good understanding of credit activities.
• Good understanding of the corporates segment (SME Lux, Large Corp)
• Ability to maintain a balance between marketing and credit risk roles.
• Ability to identify credit opportunities and develop innovative solutions.
• Ability to interact with clients

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths. We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.
BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled.

jobs.title: Actuarial Associate (m/f)
jobs.description:
Actuarial Associate
Luxembourg

Line of Service Assurance
Industry/Sector Not Applicable
Specialism Assurance
Management Level Associate
Job Description & Summary

Meet your future team

You will join PwC Luxembourg's Actuarial Services team, part of our broader advisory practice supporting insurance and reinsurance clients. You will work closely with actuaries, risk specialists and accountants on cross functional projects in a collaborative, hands on environment.

What your role will look like

As an Associate, you contribute to actuarial and regulatory projects that help insurers navigate complex requirements and make informed decisions. Your work supports both client delivery and internal collaboration, with exposure to a wide range of insurance topics and project types.

• Contribute to Solvency II assignments by supporting quantitative analyses, calculations and monitoring activities that inform risk and capital decisions
• Analyse regulatory and accounting frameworks (Solvency II, IFRS, Lux GAAP) and support the recalculation of technical provisions and experience studies
• Support multi disciplinary projects such as M&A and due diligence engagements, risk and capital modelling, IFRS 17 implementation and actuarial outsourcing
• Participate in insurance and reinsurance set up or restructuring projects, including feasibility studies and portfolio transfers
• Collaborate with senior team members to translate technical outputs into clear insights for clients and internal stakeholders
Your growth and opportunities
You will progressively take ownership of workstreams while expanding your technical actuarial and regulatory expertise. The role offers broad exposure to insurance advisory topics and close coaching from experienced professionals, enabling you to grow in responsibility and confidence over time.

The skills you bring

• University degree with a specialisation in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or quantitative finance
• Initial professional experience in actuarial or insurance related work (internships or full time)
• Modelling skills with R or Python at a working knowledge level
• Solid understanding of insurance concepts and interest in regulatory and accounting topics
• English: fluent (C1)

Ways of working

• Analyse information logically and structure quantitative outputs to support sound conclusions
• Demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to continuously learn across actuarial, regulatory and insurance topics
• Work collaboratively with colleagues from different disciplines to deliver shared outcomes
• You act with integrity, handle confidential information with care, and uphold high ethical standards in every situation

Take your next step

Step into a role where your analytical skills contribute to meaningful client outcomes and your development is supported from day one. Build your actuarial expertise, work alongside experienced professionals, and help shape solutions in a changing insurance landscape. Grow here. Go further.

PwC Luxembourg (www.pwc.lu) is the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg with over 3,600 people employed from 90 different countries. PwC Luxembourg provides audit, tax and advisory services including management consulting, transaction, financing and regulatory advice. The firm provides advice to a wide variety of clients from local and middle market entrepreneurs to large multinational companies operating from Luxembourg and the Greater Region. The firm supports its clients in creating the value they are looking for by contributing to the smooth operation of the capital markets and providing advice through an industry-focused approach.

At PwC, we help clients build trust and reinvent so they can turn complexity into competitive advantage. We're a tech-forward, people-empowered network with more than 364,000 people in 136 countries and 137 territories. Across audit and assurance, tax and legal, deals and consulting, we help clients build, accelerate, and sustain momentum. Find out more at www.pwc.com and www.pwc.lu.

jobs.title: Vehicle technician (m/f)
jobs.description:
Job Summary

    As a Vehicle Technician, you will work within our production team and be responsible for mechanical modifications, upgrades and integration of specialist equipment for military‑specified vehicles
    The role involves hands‑on mechanical and electrical upgrades to systems for enhanced durability in challenging environments
    The role is critical in ensuring that vehicles operate safely and efficiently and involves working closely with engineers to deliver high‑quality conversions
    This role provides an opportunity to join a dynamic business with personal development possibilities

Key Responsibilities

Vehicle Mechanical Installations

    Performing mechanical modifications to military type vehicles
    Installing mechanical fittings and specialist systems
    Suspension upgrades
    Wheel upgrades
    Use of power tools, hand tools and specialised equipment such as workshop machinery and two‑post lifters
    Ensuring compatibility of integrated systems and performing functional testing after installation
    Modifying interiors and exteriors to accommodate military equipment or increased payload

Diagnostic, Testing & Quality Assurance

    Performing diagnostics on mechanical systems
    Conducting functionality tests after installation of new systems
    Inspecting completed systems to ensure compliance with quality systems
    Staying updated with latest technology in the sector and developments in vehicle electronics

Technical Documentation

    Reading and interpreting wiring diagrams, schematics and conversion build sheets
    Maintaining accurate records of installations, materials used and modifications

Safety & Compliance

    Following technical safety standards and workplace safety standards in line with ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001
    Adhering to all regulatory and company guidelines

Skills & Qualifications

    Qualified to Motor Service & Maintenance Technician Level 3 or Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
    Ability to read and interpret technical drawings
    Strong fault‑finding skills and diagnostics
    Experience working on 4x4 vehicles or commercial fleet modifications
    Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality and continuous improvement
    Excellent communication skills
    English language (spoken and some written) desirable

Preferred

    Experience with military, defence or specialised vehicle conversions
    Familiarity with modern vehicle electronic systems
    Willingness to travel to the UK production facility

What we offer

    Competitive salary and benefits (salary negotiable)
    Travel / Car Allowance (negotiable)
    26 days holiday, plus statutory and extended holidays for long‑serving employees
    Corporate workwear
    On‑site parking
    Exposure to advanced defence technologies and programs
    Opportunity for professional development in a strategic industry
    Collaborative and security‑focused workplace

jobs.title: ODGOJITELJ/ICA PREDŠKOLSKE DJECE
jobs.description:
DJEČJI VRTIĆ „VRTULJAK MARČANA“ Marčana 166A, 52206 Marčana KLASA: 112-01/26-01/02 URBROJ: 2163-26-05-54-28-26-01 Marčana, 29. rujna 2026. Na temelju članka. 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (“Narodne novine” broj 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19,57/22. i 101/23), te članka 43. Statuta Dječjeg vrtića „Vrtuljak Marčana“ i Odluke Upravnog vijeća od 13. srpnja 2026. godine Upravno vijeće, raspisuje NATJE Č A J za prijem radnika na radno mjesto odgojitelj/ica - 4 izvršitelja: 2 izvršitelja na određeno puno radno vrijeme do 31. kolovoza 2027. 1 izvršitelj na određeno puno radno vrijeme – zamjena za porodiljni dopust 1 izvršitelj na određeno puno radno vrijeme do 31. kolovoza 2027. u Područnom odjeljenju Rakalj. Kandidati moraju zadovoljiti sljedeće uvjete: 1. uvjeti za odgojitelja sukladno čl. 24. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 22/26) mora imatiodgovarajuću vrstu i razinu obrazovanja , te utvrđenu zdravstvenu sposobnost za obavljanje poslova odgojitelja, 2. dokaz o nepostojanju zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa sukladno članku 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25, 22/26). Uz vlastoručno potpisanu pisanu zamolbu kandidati su dužni priložiti sljedeću dokumentaciju, u preslici:
  • životopis,
  • presliku dokaza o stručnoj spremi,
  • elektronički zapis HZMO-a,
  • uvjerenje o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti radnika (prilikom eventualnog zaposlenja kandidata poslodavac utvrđuje zdravstvenu sposobnost radnika),
  • uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi postupak za kazneno djelo navedeno u čl. 25. Zakona, ne starije od dana objave natječaja,
  • uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi postupak za prekršaj naveden u čl. 25. Zakona, ne starije od dana objave natječaja,
  • potvrda Centra za socijalnu skrb (prema mjestu stanovanja) da kandidatu nisu izrečene mjere iz članka 25. Zakona, ne starija od dana objave natječaja,
  • potvrdu nadležnog suda da kandidatu nije izrečena mjera za zaštitu osobnih prava i dobrobiti djeteta iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 22/26) ne starije od dana objave natječaja.
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • presliku rodnog lista.
U skladu sa Zakonom o ravnopravnosti spolova na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe obaju spolova koje ispunjavaju propisane uvjete. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju na temelju posebnog zakona, u prijavi su dužni pozvati se na to pravo te dostaviti dokaze o priznavanju posebnog statusa, te dokaz o načinu prestanka radnog odnosa kod prethodnog poslodavca. Kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21), članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21) te članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), dužan se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Da bi kandidat ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, osoba iz članka 102. stavaka 1. – 3. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21) koji u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja te ovisno o kategoriji koja se poziva na prednost pri zapošljavanju priložiti sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843 https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos. Da bi kandidat ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, osoba iz članka 48. stavaka 1. – 2. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21) koji u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja te ovisno o kategoriji koja se poziva na prednost pri zapošljavanju priložiti sve potrebne dokaze koji su dostupni. poveznici ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843 https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Dokazi o invaliditetu smatraju se javnim ispravama na temelju kojih se osoba može upisati u očevidnika zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom iz članka 13. navedenog Zakona. Prijave s traženom dokumentacijom, u zatvorenoj omotnici s naznakom “ ZA NATJEČAJ-ODGOJITELJ/ICA, potrebno je dostaviti poštom na adresu Dječji vrtić „Vrtuljak Marčana“, Marčana 166A, 52206 Marčana. Nepotpune i/ili nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Na natječaj se pod ravnopravnim uvjetima mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola sukladno članku 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/08. i 69/17). Prijave dostaviti poštom u roku od 8 dana od dana objave natječaja. Natječaj je objavljen 30. srpnja 2026. i traje do 08. kolovoza 2026. godine.
