jobs.title: Range Keeper
jobs.description:
LOCATION: Burwash Training Ranges

The Range keeper reports to the Project Manager and will provide Shooting Range services for the Military Outdoor Training Ranges located Burwash Ontario.

You must be suitably physically sound and adaptable enough to do moderate lifting and to walk over rough terrain, have experience/knowledge in the operation of shooting ranges, have a general property maintenance background and be able to operate small-medium sized machinery/tools such as tractors with various attachments (i.e. farm tractor, lawn mower, aerator, front-end bucket, snow blower) power hand mowers, trimmers, walk behind snow blower, plow truck, power saws and hand tools including but not limited to shovels, hammers, saws, rakes, telephones.

You will be required to work on a flexible schedule on weekdays, weekends and evenings according to range reservations/ schedules as presented by the Company Office.

You must be a self-starter, demonstrate a good work ethic and provide superior customer service. You will need to display good communication in the English Language as well as inter-personal and organizational skills. Within your duties you will be expected to interface with DND/Police/civilian range users as well as assigned subcontractors.

Key Responsibilities

Your duties include

Scheduling

  • Repair targets/backings 1080 fig. 11 targets/backings and 1080 targets/backings for fig 12 at Winona Range as well as replacement of 24 figure 11 target frames and 48 target frames for figure 12.
  • Repairs include removing and replacing the paper target figures.
  • Provide flexible hours to accommodate the march in/ march out process which includes occasional evening/weekend activity
  • Oversee in and out inspections.
  • Regularly inspect all range property and infrastructure reporting work order needs to the Company office as required and conducting dayâto-day operation and maintenance as required
  • With exercise directors (OIC Exercise) conduct in/out inspections ensuring the ranges and buildings are properly returned as found by the users and March in/out forms are signed by the Exercise representative
  • Reporting, recording all incidents, damages, causes and vandalism (including graffiti in the Butts)
  • Report malfunctioning installed equipment including kitchen and laundry equipment
  • Get Project Manager authority before calling in subcontractors;
  • Ensuring First Aid Fire Fighting equipment/supplies are maintained and replenished.

Maintain Ranges/infrastructure

  • Walk the perimeter fence lines ensuring the fences are kept in good repair and growth is cut back to an acceptable level
  • Complete all grass cutting and snow removal and ice control operations with equipment provided iaw the performance standards provided by the Regional Manager
  • Prune trees, shrubs and plants as required for neat appearance and maintenance.
  • Build/Repair target frames ensuring sufficient are on-hand at all times replacing

Facilitiesâ Housekeeping

  • Conduct janitorial services in all range buildings.
  • Conduct routine repairs paying particular attention to occupant safety, protection of occupants and property against further damage
  • Provide janitorial supplies as required to assist Range visitors;
  • Institute suitable waste disposal and materials recycling;
  • Take appropriate measures for the control of pests both indoors and outdoors;
  • Pick up litter and garbage as required.

GENERAL REQUIREMNTS

  • Must have a valid Ontario driverâs license and be prepared to operate Company vehicles/equipment safely in the performance of their duties
  • Must work flexible hours according to Range reservations;
  • Must be prepared to wear and respond to calls
  • Will be required to pass a security clearance and adhere to the Company Code of ethics, Code of conduct and confidentiality agreements;

The expected salary range for this role is determined in accordance with the union collective agreement

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
About SuperPlane

SuperPlane is an open source software factory engine: the system that lets AI agents build, test, and ship code while engineers focus on design and decisions. This is going to be how all software gets built, and we're building the engine underneath it.

The Role

We are hiring a product engineer to join the team and own meaningful projects end to end.

This is a remote role. We currently work across GMT+2 to GMT-3 and welcome candidates in that range.

At SuperPlane, we don't split engineering into frontend and backend. Everyone is a well-rounded builder who moves across the stack, makes product and technical calls, asks for help when needed, and delivers features from start to finish. You might spend one day building an API endpoint or workflow engine improvement, and the next day polishing a React surface that users touch every day.

We're looking for someone at a mid-level to senior level: you've shipped real products, you can work independently, and you're ready to grow fast in a high-trust, high-pace environment. You don't need to have done everything before, but you need to learn quickly and take ownership of what you build.


What We Are Looking For

  • You are genuinely full-stack.

  • Your workflow is AI-driven and you know how to stay fast without getting sloppy.

  • You have strong backend experience in a systems-oriented language. While we use Go, we don't expect you to be an expert already, just to ramp up fast.

  • You have solid systems judgment. APIs, data models, reliability, and trade-offs matter to you.

  • You're comfortable with TypeScript and React -- the modern frontend stack.

  • You are comfortable with cloud-native tooling and modern software delivery.

  • You want ownership, not a narrow lane.

  • You want an early-stage company where the pace is high, the standards are high, and the upside is big.


How To Apply

We care more about proof of work than polished applications, and we want to see how you show up in open source.

Before you apply, submit at least one pull request to superplanehq/superplane. It can be small and it does not need to be merged.

When you apply, send your GitHub username and a link to your pull request. We verify both, and applications missing either field will not move forward.


Why You'll Love Working at SuperPlane

  • Build a frontier product used by engineers across the globe.

  • Meaningful equity and real ownership.

  • Small team, fast feedback loops.

  • Remote role that lets you focus and create.

jobs.title: Personlig assistent 70-75%, tillträde senast under september
jobs.description:
Är du en pålitlig och lojal person som tycker om att ha ett varierat schema, ca 6-7 dagpass & 3-4 vakna nattpass per månad. Har du även någon form av erfarenhet inom vård-och omsorg, kan var både från arbetslivet som privatlivet? Kanske du är ny utbildad eller student? Då tycker vi att du ska läsa vidare!

Det är svårt för mig att sammanfatta tjänsten som min personliga assistent och allt vad den innebär. Detta eftersom insatsen personlig assistans är personlig och utgår från individuella förutsättningar och behov. Samtidigt är mitt liv lika mångsidigt som ditt vad gäller känslor, intressen och aktiviteter. För att ändå ge dig några ledtrådar varierar mina intressen beroende på årstid. Jag tycker om allt ifrån att bada i min pool, laga mat & löpning med min Marathon-rullstol till museer, konserter och gymmet för att ge dig några ledtrådar. Även om det som sagt är svårt att sammanfatta så är här en förklaring till vem jag letar efter…

En tjänst som personlig assistent är varierande men hos mig kan du tänka att din roll översiktligt tar avstamp i dessa tre delar;

1. Du hjälper mig med alla grundläggande behov med stor känsla för integritet och respekt.

2. Du är mitt fysiska stöd vilket innebär att det är en fördel för dig om du själv är mån om din hälsa och tycker om att träna på fritiden.

3. Du är min motor i vardagen och har tillsammans med mig och din kollega ansvar för att planera aktiviteter och följa rutiner.

Dessa tre delar av din yrkesroll ska genomsyras av att du är snäll, empatisk och kommunikativ eftersom det är så samarbetet fungerar bäst. Jag själv är ca 25 år, mitt team är ungt, alla är ca 20–30 år.

Jag vill leva ett så aktivt och socialt liv som möjligt, även om jag inte kan springa på mina ben så rullar jag fram i loppen jag deltar i. Det är viktigt att du är aktiv och delar mina intressen. Jag vill ha ett så aktivt liv som möjligt utifrån min livssituation! Mitt liv kan beskrivas som en berg- och dalbana- vissa dagar orkar jag mycket, andra dagar är jag i stort behov av vila och rekreation. Min epilepsi är komplex och du får lära dig allt du behöver veta kunskapsmässigt under introduktionen, det är inte ett krav men meriterade om du har erfarenhet av insatsen personlig assistans. Du behöver dock ha god förståelse för vad din yrkesroll innebär.

Flexibilitet är viktigt för att kunna anpassa dagarna utifrån mina behov. Mina assistenter kommer alltid utvilade, tålmodiga och bjuder på sig själva oavsett vilka förutsättningar eller hinder jag stöter på i vardagen. Jag söker dig som tänker likadant och inte betraktar mig som din patient. Jag kräver hög arbetsmoral vilket för dig som söker innebär att du är pålitlig och behandlar mig, dina kollegor samt ditt yrke med respekt. Du är även lugn och förstår att din insats är livsavgörande för mig, förståelsen för relationsbyggande och variation i min tillvaro skapar bäst förutsättningar för oss båda. Personlig assistans innebär att leva ett meningsfullt liv med självbestämmande vilket du bidrar med genom interaktion.

Yrkesrollen personlig assistent innebär att hjälpa en annan människa att leva sitt liv, det innebär bland annat att kunna lämna egna känslor och åsikter utanför arbetet, att vara intresserad av att lära sig nya kommunikationssätt och samtidigt ha förståelse för att jag, precis som du, har ett känsloregister som varierar. Jag vill att du är lika engagerad oavsett vad jag vill göra eller behöver. Dela gärna med dig av dina intressen och häng med på mina positiv och glad!

Vi sätter stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. Att utveckla en relation går inte över en natt så jag letar efter dig som verkligen vill göra det bästa för mig genom att lära känna mig och förstår att långsiktighet är nyckeln till framgång. Tidigare erfarenhet är inte ett krav även om det givetvis är meriterande, oavsett vilket är förståelsen för yrkesrollen det som väger tyngst. Att kunna arbeta strukturerat och organiserat är väsentligt för att skapa trygghet och förutsägbarhet för mig, dessutom värdesätter jag dig som är initiativrik och kan arbeta kreativt motiverande tillsammans med mig.

Här nedan följer några praktiska förutsättningar för tjänsten:

·     Tillträde enligt överenskommelse, dock senast under september.

Du börjar med ett intro.schema för att sedan erbjudas ett eget schema. Jag är beviljad assistans dygnet runt, du arbetar aldrig 24h-pass men det är viktigt att veta att du är vaken under natten. Du har god förståelse och insikt i vad det innebär att vända på dygnet och kunna sova på dagen, för att komma pigg och utvilad till mig oavsett arbetstid. Har du inte tidigare erfarenhet av nattjobb är du givetvis också välkommen att söka, kom bara ihåg att ett nattjobb inte innebär att ditt dygn får 24h.

·     Arbetspassen hos mig kan vara heldagar 08.00-20.00, fm 5–7 h och em 5–6 h. De vakna nattpassen är 12 timmar, 20.00–08.00.

·     Introduktionen börjar alltid med dagspass hos mig. På så vis lär vi känna varandra ordentligt och du lär dig så mycket som möjligt om mitt liv. Det är även trevligt och viktigt att du lär känna mina andra kompisar (assistenter) för att alla ska kunna samarbeta.

·     Eventuella önskemål vill jag att du specificerar redan i din ansökan, tack!

·     Jag kan tyvärr inte anställa pälsdjursallergiker eller tobaksanvändare (innefattar även substitut som vitt snus och e-cigaretter).

·     Att behärska svenska obehindrat i tal och skrift är ett krav, även simkunnighet.

Känner du att du stämmer in på det som förväntas? Då tror jag att du har god chans att bli en kompis i mitt team så länge du är 18 år fyllda. Vänligen observera att endast fullständig ansökan kommer beaktas!

Din ansökan ska innehålla följande;

1. Personligt brev- berätta bl a varför du vill jobba som personlig assistent och vad som gör dig till en lämplig kandidat

2. CV- uppdaterat och komplett. Foto på dig själv inkluderas givetvis här.

3. Goda referenser & registerutdrag krävs och kommer att efterfrågas!

Observera att tjänsten kommer tillsättas så fort vi hittat rätt kandidat, vilket således kan bli innan sista ansökningsdag. Kollektivavtal via Fremia erbjuds.

OBS! Jag avböjer vänligen men bestämt reklam eller ansökningar via rekryteringsföretag.

jobs.title: Kvinnosamordnare
jobs.description:
Kvinnosamordnare sökes till Kvinnojouren Frideborg Mölndal/Härryda

Om oss

Kvinnojouren Frideborg är en ideell förening som arbetar för att motverka mäns våld mot kvinnor, tjejer och barn. Verksamheten riktar sig i första hand till invånare i Mölndals stad och Härryda kommun.

Vi erbjuder stöd till kvinnor som är eller har varit utsatta för våld och arbetar samtidigt för att öka kunskapen om mäns våld, förtryck och sexuella övergrepp mot kvinnor och barn samt våldets konsekvenser. Genom stöd, samverkan och opinionsbildning verkar vi för ett jämställt samhälle där kvinnor och barn kan leva fria från våld.

Kvinnojouren Frideborg är en feministisk, ideell, partipolitiskt och religiöst obunden förening ansluten till Roks. Vårt mål är att alla kvinnor och barn ska kunna leva ett liv fritt från våld i ett jämställt samhälle.

Om tjänsten

Vi söker nu en kvinnosamordnare till vår verksamhet.

Hos oss blir du en del av en liten och engagerad arbetsplats där flexibilitet, delaktighet och samarbete är viktiga delar av vardagen. Verksamheten har idag två anställda som tillsammans ansvarar för det dagliga arbetet. Styrelsen är arbetsgivare och har utsett ett arbetsutskott som har löpande kontakt med de anställda. Utöver de anställda finns engagerade ideella jourkvinnor.

Arbetet är varierat och består huvudsakligen av stöd till kvinnor som är eller har varit utsatta för våld. Därutöver ingår förebyggande arbete, utbildningsinsatser, samverkan och opinionsbildning.

Det finns goda möjligheter att vara med och utveckla verksamheten utifrån nya behov och samhällsutmaningar.

Arbetsuppgifter

Arbetet kan bland annat omfatta:

    Enskilda stödsamtal och gruppverksamhet för kvinnor.
    Praktiskt och rådgivande stöd före, under eller efter uppbrott från en våldsam relation.
    Stöd i kontakter med exempelvis polis, vård, socialtjänst, familjerätt och andra myndigheter.
    Samverkan med organisationer, myndigheter och andra samhällsaktörer.
    Planering och genomförande av föreläsningar, utbildningar och informationsinsatser.
    Deltagande i projekt, nätverk och utvecklingsarbete.
    Opinionsbildande arbete kring mäns våld mot kvinnor och barn.

Om dig

Vi söker dig som har adekvat utbildning inom socialt arbete eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig.

Du har flerårig erfarenhet av socialt arbete och god kunskap om mäns våld mot kvinnor och barn, våldets konsekvenser samt erfarenhet av stödarbete med våldsutsatta kvinnor, både enskilt och i grupp.

Du delar vår feministiska värdegrund och har kunskap om mäns våld mot kvinnor ur ett könsmaktsperspektiv.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av arbete inom ideell sektor eller föreningsverksamhet.

Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av:

    Enskilda stödsamtal.
    Gruppverksamhet.
    Samverkan med myndigheter och andra aktörer.
    Att hålla utbildningar, föreläsningar eller presentationer.

Personliga egenskaper

Arbetet kräver att du har personlig mognad, integritet och ett professionellt förhållningssätt.

Du arbetar självständigt, tar egna initiativ och har samtidigt god samarbetsförmåga. Du är flexibel, lyhörd och har förmåga att anpassa ditt arbete utifrån verksamhetens och de stödsökandes behov.

Du trivs i en liten verksamhet där samarbete, ansvarstagande och öppen kommunikation är viktiga delar av vardagen. Du har förmåga att hantera förändringar och oförutsedda situationer på ett konstruktivt sätt och bidrar till ett lösningsfokuserat arbetssätt.

Du uttrycker dig väl i tal och skrift och känner dig bekväm med att både ge och ta emot återkoppling och feedback som en naturlig del av samarbetet.

Anställning

Tjänsten avser heltid med tillträde den 1 september 2026 eller enligt överenskommelse.

Vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning.

Arbetstiden är i huvudsak förlagd dagtid, men viss kvälls- och helgtjänstgöring förekommer.

Vid anställning begärs utdrag ur Polisens belastnings- och misstankeregister.

Vi erbjuder processhandledning och friskvårdsersättning.

Ansökan

Sista ansökningsdag: 21 augusti 2026.

Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Ansökan med CV och personligt brev skickas till styrelsen@frideborg.se.

jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
jobs.description:
About Swedish Nutra

Swedish Nutra is a Malmö-based family company and one of the Nordics’ leading manufacturers of premium liquid vitamins and nutritional supplements. We offer private label/white label production and are the makers of the Swedish Collagen and Swedish Nutra brands, sold in over 37 countries worldwide. We’re a fast-growing business with global distribution, a warm and international team, and an enterprising environment where people get real room to develop and grow.

About the role

We are seeking a Chief Operating Officer (COO) to take over the day-to-day leadership of Swedish Nutra. This is a pivotal role designed to free our founder-CEO to focus on growth, while you build and lead the operational engine that will scale our business. You will be the number-one on-site point of contact for the entire team, working full-time from our Malmö headquarters.

What you'll own

As COO, you will be responsible for the full company P&L and all approximately 30 staff, leading through the management layer. Your mandate will grow in defined phases, ultimately encompassing all day-to-day responsibilities currently held by the CEO. This includes:

    Day-to-day leadership of the company: Full P&L ownership and leadership of all staff through the management team.
    The management team: Building and leading the Production Manager, Head of Sales, and Marketing Manager (searches currently in motion), and completing the team with key-account and e-commerce hires. Final say on management-level appointments remains with the owners.
    Production: Setting targets and holding the Production Manager accountable for output, quality, supply, and cost.
    The technical spine: Ensuring quality assurance and regulatory compliance across all export markets, maintaining GMP/HACCP certification, overseeing the product development pipeline, and managing inventory and supply end-to-end through a monthly S&OP rhythm.
    The commercial engine: Guiding the Head of Sales and Marketing Manager to execute the retail and DTC agenda set with the CEO, including expanding from exclusive-distributor coverage to include direct retail relationships.
    DTC and marketplace channels: Overseeing Amazon EU/UK through an accountable Amazon specialist, and the US Amazon/Shopify/DTC business, with investment pace agreed with the CEO.
    Systems and process: Transforming ad-hoc, founder-held execution into documented, repeatable processes and stage-appropriate tooling, and extracting institutional knowledge into the organization through SOPs.
    The people function during ramp-up: Managing performance, development, and hiring below management level, with in-house recruitment support, until a dedicated HR lead is justified.
    The automation agenda: Supporting automation across the business, ensuring new processes across every department are designed to be automation-ready.
    The operating rhythm: Establishing KPIs, budgets, forecasting, cash-flow discipline, running weekly management meetings, and providing monthly reporting to the owners.

What we're looking for

We are seeking a proven general manager with real operational depth and a scale-up temperament. While few candidates will be equally strong across all areas, we prioritize in this order: proven general management, depth across quality, regulatory, product development, and supply, and hands-on commercial-growth experience. Running a factory is not required, as production has its own dedicated leader.

Non-negotiable requirements:

    Experience: 10+ years of experience, with genuine general management, including owning a full P&L (company, subsidiary, or business unit) and leading a team of managers. You are a leader of leaders, not a strong functional specialist stepping up for the first time.
    Operational Expertise: Real operating experience in a regulated product category (GMP, HACCP, pharma, food, nutraceutical/supplement, or comparable), spanning quality and regulatory, product development, and inventory/supply. You must be able to own these functions, carry quality and regulatory risk, and act as a credible sparring partner to the Production Manager.
    Scale-up Temperament: Comfortable building structure from thin processes in a founder-led company with approximately 200M SEK revenue.
    Commercial Literacy: Understands brand, channel economics, and trade terms well enough to direct a retail expansion.
    Motivation: Motivated by operational ownership; you want to run the day-to-day of a profitable company end-to-end and build the machine, not occupy a caretaker or chief-of-staff seat.
    Location: Full-time on-site in Malmö. This is not a hybrid or remote role. Candidates must be based in the Öresund region.
    Language: Fluent English is a requirement for this role (our working language; the team is international). Swedish is not required.

Strong preferences:

    FMCG background: consumer health, VMS/supplements, personal care, or functional food.
    Experience in liquid, food, or beverage manufacturing environments.
    Direct experience with European drug and health retail (dm, Rossmann, Holland & Barrett, Boots) and their buying processes.
    Existing relationships with target retail banners.
    AI-forward: has used AI and automation to build a leaner operation, or is visibly motivated to, and able to bring a team along with it.

Practical details

Apply by clicking the link and submitting your resume, including your cover letter in the same document (one file for CV and cover letter).

Start date: as soon as possible.

jobs.description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions.  



Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.



Role Summary

Would you like to work in an organization where health, work environment, and sustainable productivity are at the forefront? Scania Occupational Health Provider in Södertälje is now seeking an Occupational Nurse who wants to work both operationally and consultatively with our internal customers. As an Occupational Nurse, you will work in a consultative role with a strong customer and business focus. You will operate at the individual, group, and organizational levels and collaborate closely with other occupational health professionals.

Job Responsibilities

    Work consultatively with customers, providing occupational health expertise at individual, team, and organizational levels.
    Collaborate proactively with customers to identify and mitigate workplace risks while promoting a safe, healthy, and inclusive work environment.
    Support rehabilitation and return-to-work processes through clinical expertise and effective stakeholder management.
    Conduct occupational health consultations and assessments with employees.  
    Deliver high-quality support and advice through telephone and call centre services.  
    Participate in daytime emergency response activities and provide crisis intervention support during critical incidents.  
    Act as a trusted advisor to managers, offering guidance on occupational health and employee wellbeing matters.  
    Plan, develop, and deliver training sessions, workshops, and presentations related to occupational health.
    Conduct pre-employment medical assessments, health surveillance, and statutory medical examinations.
    Lead and contribute to internal projects focused on service development, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Who You Are

We are looking for a Registered Occupational Nurse or a Registered Nurse with experience in occupational health services who is passionate about promoting health, well-being, and preventive care in the workplace.

jobs.title: Circle K Århusvej i Randers søger en sælger på 20 timer
jobs.description:
Kære fremtidige kollega  

Først og fremmest, lad os starte med at sige, at et job som Sælger hos Circle K ikke er for alle. Men det er et job der passer til mange, og måske også dig?  

At arbejde som sælger på Circle K er ikke som ethvert sælgerjob. Os der arbejder her er vilde med det, og spørger du en af vores uundværlige sælgere om hvorfor, vil de bla nævne: Selvstændighed, fleksibilitet og ansvar.  

  

Vi leder efter en positiv teamplayer som:  

  

  • Har en sælger gemt I sig, motiveres af salg og kan levere en service lidt ud over det sædvanlige  

  • Kan bevare overblikket og humøret, når der kommer uforudsete udfordringer ind af døren, og formår at løse dem med sund fornuft. Også selvom der er lang kø  

  • Har en interesse for at tilberede mad. For vi elsker det! Og vi ser derfor gerne, at du har lyst til, at lave de lækreste sandwich og de bedste burgere.  

  • Forstår vigtigheden af, at vores kunder får den bedste oplevelse når de besøger os. Dette indebærer også at butikken, kundetoilet og forplads er ren og pæn.   

  • Du forstår betydningen af, at arbejde i et team, hvor alle er afhængige af- og stoler på, at hver løfter sit. Og til tider er villig til at give lidt ekstra.  

  

Hvad kan I tilbyde mig?  

  

Vi er en dynamisk, handlingsorienteret organisation, hvor vi arbejder sammen som ét team. Vi tager ikke os selv alt for højtideligt og engagerer os ikke i politik eller bureaukrati. Vi værdsætter diversitet og forskellige måder at tænke og arbejde på.  

Udover helt unikke udviklingsmuligheder, tilbyder vi et job med yderst attraktive fordele og personalegoder. Som en del af vores Circle K familie vil du bla få medarbejderrabat på brændstof, bilvask samt på mad og drikkevarer i vores butikker. Derudover tilbyder vi:  

  • En attraktiv pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring  

  • Fordelagtige lønninger og forskudttidstillæg 

  • Og ikke mindst, Danmarks bedste kollegaer  
     

Mange der i dag driver vores stationer eller arbejder på vores kontor, startede deres karriere som sælgere på stationen, måske var tanken bare at blive hos os et stykke tid, men det var begyndelsen på en lang karriere! Og for dig der har andre mål og drømme i din karriere, er Circle K et fantastisk sted til at få erfaring, der er værd at tage med sig videre i arbejdslivet. 

Så hvis du vil have et job, hvor du kan være med til at give vores kunder den bedste oplevelse, udvikle dig og blive en del af et fantastisk team på Circle K Randers, så er det nu du skal sende din ansøgning afsted.

Hvis du har nogen spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Store Manager Kathe Maria Sagatume på tlf nr.: 86133101

Antal timer:

Ca. 20 timer ugentligt. Vagterne ligger både på hverdage og i weekender, morgen, eftermiddag og aften. Arbejdstiden er placeret på tidspunkter, der gør stillingen uegnet som studiejob. Det er en forudsætning for at komme i betragtning til stillingen, at du er fyldt 18 år. 

Ansøgningsfrist og tiltrædelse: 

Løbende 

Som en del af rekrutteringsprocessen, indhenter vi referencer fra tidligere arbejdsgivere.

Hos os behøver du, hverken CV eller ansøgning for at søge job. Når du trykker på ”ansøg nu” kommer du til en portal, hvor du skal svare på nogle spørgsmål om forskellige arbejdssituationer, som samtidig giver dig et indblik i, hvordan det er at arbejde i Circle K.  

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Hos Circle K er der plads til alle og vi arbejder altid sammen som One team! Vi værdsætter diversitet og forskellige måder at tænke og arbejde på. Vi opfordrer derfor alle til at søge stillingen – uanset alder, køn, religion, handicap, etnisk baggrund etc.

jobs.title: Technical Shift Leader til Rush Aarhus
jobs.description:
Brænder du for sikkerhed og gode gæsteoplevelser? 

Hos Rush Trampolinpark søger vi en engageret og ansvarsbevidst Technical Shift Leader, som vil være med til at sikre en sikker, sjov og professionel oplevelse for vores gæster – samtidig med at du leder medarbejderne og den daglige drift på dine vagter. 

 

Som Technical Shift Leader bliver du en vigtig del af parkens lederteam. Du får ansvar for både sikkerhed, tekniske kontroller og den daglige drift. Du bliver en synlig rollemodel for teamet og er med til at sikre, at vi lever op til vores høje standarder for sikkerhed, service og kvalitet. 

 

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver 

  • Lede medarbejdere og sikre en velfungerende drift på dine vagter 

  • Sørge for at åbne og lukke parken

  • Gennemføre og dokumentere sikkerheds- og kvalitetskontroller 

  • Håndtere gæstefeedback og sikre høj service 

  • Deltage i parkens løbende udvikling og forbedringsarbejde 

  • Udføre mindre administrative opgaver 

 

Vi forestiller os, at du 

  • Er struktureret, proaktiv og tager ansvar 

  • Har teknisk forståelse og interesse for sikkerhed og vedligeholdelse (fx skifte trampolinduge og andre tekniske opgaver)

  • Kan bevare overblikket – også når der er travlt 

  • Trives i en aktiv hverdag med mange forskellige opgaver 

  • Brænder for at skabe gode oplevelser for vores gæster 

  • Forstår vigtigheden af procedurer, rutiner og dokumentation 

  • Du bliver ansat i et team af 3 andre unge fastansatte

 

Om Rush Aarhus 

Rush Trampolinpark er en del af ActiveOn, som er en førende spiller inden for aktivitets- og oplevelsesbranchen. Vores værdier er centreret om gæsteoplevelser og teamwork.  

Vi tilbyder 

En spændende lederrolle med stort ansvar for den daglige drift og sikkerhed. Vi er en arbejdsplads med et energisk og uformelt arbejdsmiljø, som har fokus på fællesskab, sikkerhed og gode gæster oplevelser.  

 

Praktisk information 

  • Stillingen er en fastansættelse på 37 timer 

  • Arbejdstiden ligger primært i parkens åbningstider 

  • Arbejde hver anden weekend 

  • Tiltrædelse efter aftale 

 

Mere information 

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen kontakt da Daglig Leder Maria Diedrichsen på telefon: +45 40 16 02 72 

 

Lyder det som noget for dig? 

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til maria@rushdanmark.dk hurtigst muligt. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat. 

 

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: End User Services Specialist (IAM)
jobs.description:
**We are looking for an experienced End User Service Specialist, IAM to join our IT organization in Helsinki.**

**In this role**, you will provide advanced technical expertise and senior support for Identity and Access Management / Identity Management services across identity lifecycle, access governance and authentication platforms.You will play a key role in strengthening the security, reliability and efficiency of IAM services by leading complex incident resolution, root cause analysis, service improvements and automation. You will work closely with business stakeholders, IT, cyber security teams and suppliers, translating IAM policies and standards into practical operational outcomes.

**Your role and responsibilities**

- Provide advanced technical expertise and 2nd/3rd level support for IAM / IDM services, including complex incidents, problem management and agreed on-call support

- Lead root cause analysis and continuous improvement across identity lifecycle, provisioning/de-provisioning, access requests, integrations and authentication services

- Translate security and IAM policies into operational controls for least privilege, segregation of duties, privileged access and access governance

- Own configuration, change, upgrade, testing, deployment and service validation activities for IAM applications, connectors, workflows, interfaces and data flows

- Drive standardization, automation and documentation of IAM / IDM processes and tools to improve security, reliability and efficiency

- Partner with cyber security, HR, business stakeholders, IT teams and suppliers to deliver secure, compliant and reliable identity services

- Support audit evidence, access reviews, risk remediation, reporting and end-user training related to IAM services

- Option for on-call if needed


**What we are looking for**

- B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Computer Science, IT or equivalent industry experience, with experience in IAM / IDM operations, senior support or application management

- Strong knowledge of identity lifecycle, access governance, least privilege, segregation of duties and privileged access management principles

- Good knowledge of directory and identity technologies such as Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, combined with hands-on experience in IAM / IDM platforms, connectors, workflows, APIs and data flows

- Scripting and query skills, for example PowerShell and SQL, for troubleshooting, reporting and automation

- Experience with ITSM processes, change/release/problem management, supplier coordination and clear communication in English; SAP or manufacturing experience is considered an advantage

jobs.title: Päivätoiminnan Ohjaajia, Taitola Tampere
jobs.description:
**Taitola hoivapalvelut Oy** järjestää päiväaikaista toimintaa kehitysvammaisille ja vammaisille. Toimimme tällä hetkellä Jyväskylässä, Äänekoskella, Tampereella, Helsingissä ja Joutsenossa.

Toiminnan tavoitteena on aitojen arjen taitojen tukeminen. Päiväaikaisessa toiminnassa harjoitellaan säännöllistä työn ja vapaa-ajan rytmittämistä ja käynnistetään yksilöllinen matka kohti tavoitteita ja unelmia. Toimintaamme ohjaa yksilöllinen suunnitelma, jossa huomioidaan yksilön vahvuudet, innostuksen kohteet ja kehittämistarpeet.

Tehtävänämme on tuottaa laadukasta sisältöä arkeen mm. liikunnan, taiteen, kädentaitojen sekä ilmaisutaitojen avulla. Palvelujen järjestämisessä noudatamme osallisuutta ja työllistymistä edistävän toiminnan laatukriteerejä. Asiakkaamme ohjautuvat meille hyvinvointialueen vammaispalvelun kautta.

**Etsimme Taitola Tampereen päiväaikaisen toiminnan yksikköön ohjaajia (2 paikkaa) toistaiseksi voimassaolevaan työsuhteeseen**

Työtä on tarjolla joustavasti **osa- ja kokoaikaisesti** elämäntilanteesi sekä asiakkaidemme tarpeiden mukaan. Toistaiseksi voimassa olevan työsuhteen lisäksi etsimme myös keikkalaisia lyhyisiin työsuhteisiin.

Työssäsi vahvistat asiakkaan omien valintojen tekemistä ja arjen taitoja. Asiakkaillamme on monia erilaisia tuen tarpeita. Työ sisältää ohjaustyön lisäksi myös perushoitoa. Toimintamme on yksilöllistä ja samaan aikaan yhteisöllistä, huomioiden asiakkaiden voimavarat, vireystilan ja vahvuudet. Työnkuvaasi kuuluu toiminnan suunnittelu ja kehittäminen yhdessä työryhmän ja asiakkaiden kanssa.

**Edellytämme sinulta:**

- vähintään sosiaali- ja/tai terveysalan perustutkintoa (esim. lähihoitaja)

- kokemusta työskentelystä paljon tukea tarvitsevien kehitysvammaisten ja autismikirjon henkilöiden kanssa

- valmiutta osallistua myös perushoitoon

- kokemusta ja kykyä toimia haastavissa ja yllättävissä tilanteissa

- erinomaisia tiimityötaitoja

- hyvää suomen kielen taitoa


Sinulla tulee olla tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukainen rokotussuoja ja ennen työn aloitusta tehty tuberkuloosiselvitys (55 §).

Tehtävässä edellytetään myös rikostaustaotteen esittämistä (laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta 741/2023, 28 §).

**Palkkaus:** Ohjaajan palkkaluokka 1.9.2026 alkaen G24D,2811,09 € - 3071,09€ / kk

**Näiden lisäksi arvostamme:**

\- monipuolista kokemusta vammaistyöstä

\- kehittämismyönteisyyttä ja positiivista työotetta

\- monipuolista osaamista mm. taiteen ja liikunnan alalta

\- voimassa olevan lääkehoidon koulutuksen (LOP + PKV + Laskut) suorittaminen katsotaan eduksi

\-MAPA tai AVEKKI-koulutusta

Taitolassa työtä tehdään iloisella otteella, ja arvomme näkyvät käytännön työssä. Ne ovat: **Aito asiakaslähtöisyys – Yksilöllisesti arvokas arki – Osallistava yhteisöllisyys – Ekologisuus**. **Miksi juuri meille töihin?**

Taitolassa saat:

\- monipuolista ohjaustyön kokemusta

\- toiminnallisen ja uusia toimintatapoja etsivän työympäristön

\- tilaisuuden kehittää päiväaikaista toimintaa ja omaa työskentelyä yhdessä työryhmän kanssa.

\- koulutusmyönteisen ilmapiirin

\- säännöllisen päivätyön

\- Muita vaihtuvia henkilöstöetuja

Jos haluat päästä toteuttamaan nykyaikaista päiväaikaista toimintaa ja osaamistasi aidosti arvostavassa työpaikassa, niin lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemus ansioluettelon (cv) kanssa taija.leivo@taitola.fi. Ilmoita hakemuksen **otsikossa "Hakemus, Ohjaaja, Taitola Tampere"**.

Haastattelut järjestetään ma 24.8 ja ti 25.8.

Tehtävässä aloitus syyskuussa tai sopimuksen mukaan. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa 10.8. alkaen yksikön johtaja Taija Leivo arkisin 9-15 välillä, p. 044 493 8493. 31.7.-7.8 arkisin 8-14.30 välillä palvelujohtaja Aija Iljinen 044 5101269

jobs.title: Platform Security Architect
jobs.description:
Outokumpu is looking for a **PlatformSecurity Architect** to plan, design, and improve security across our global IT platforms, including Compute & Networks, public cloud, and end user services.

In this role, you will help strengthen core security services and ensure that our platforms are secure, scalable, and aligned with business needs.

**Your responsibilities**

- Plan and design security across global IT platforms, public cloud, and end user services

- Develop endpoint protection strategy, roadmap, policies, and tuning

- Plan and design Privileged Access Management, PAM, services for both IT and OT environments

- Contribute to Azure and Microsoft 365 security hardening

- Support Windows and Linux security logging and log ingestion

- Act as technical incident commander for platform security incidents

- Rationalization and cost optimization for endpoint protection and PAM tools

- Work closely with IT, OT, security, and business stakeholders


**What we are looking for**

- Bachelors degree in computer science, information security, or equivalent experience

- Several years of experience in cyber security and platform security services at scale

- Strong knowledge of PAM and Entra ID for IT and OT environments

- Experience with Azure and Microsoft 365 security hardening

- Understanding of Windows/Linux security and log ingestion

- Knowledge of information security standards and compliance requirements

- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills in English

- Understanding of ITIL service management


**What we offer**

At Outokumpu, you will join an international environment where you can make a real impact on cyber security across global platforms. We offer meaningful work, skilled colleagues, opportunities to develop professionally, and a supportive culture.

We also offer a **hybrid working model**, giving you flexibility to combine office collaboration with remote work.

**For more information about the position**, please contact Security Lead, IT Platform: Dan Torckell **via phone during contact hours: 6 August, 9:00-10:00 OR 18 August 15:30-16:30 EET.** +358504336640

**Please submit your application by 30 August.**

**The selected candidate will be required to pass a security clearance vetting and health check (including drug tests) before commencing employment**

jobs.title: Asset Administrator
jobs.description:
ISS är ett av världens största tjänsteföretag och i år firar vi 80 år i Sverige! Med över 6500 medarbetare i landet, från norr till söder, levererar vi service som gör skillnad. Vi erbjuder våra kunder allt från städning till teknisk service, mat- och arbetsplatstjänster. Vi skapar arbetsplatser där människor trivs, företag växer och där hållbarhet är en självklarhet – socialt, miljömässigt och affärsmässigt. Våra medarbetare är hjärtat i det vi gör – och avgörande för att våra kunder ska känna sig trygga, sedda – och för att deras arbetsplatser ska blomstra.

At ISS, we are looking for an engaged and experienced Asset Administrator with strong skills in both English and Chinese, spoken and written, for a fixed-term parental leave cover starting in October 2026 and ending in April 2027. Do you want to help deliver high-quality service and play an important role in supporting asset and material management for our customer Huawei? Then we encourage you to apply for our Asset Administrator role at ISS’ customer site in Kista.

About the role

As an Asset Administrator, you will be responsible for supporting the customer’s asset and material management processes. The role is based onsite in Kista and may also involve administrative coordination connected to the customer’s offices in Lund and Gothenburg. You will help ensure that assets and materials are managed in line with company policies and routines, while also supporting office-related administration, events, and expatriate management. We place great importance on your ability to work independently, communicate clearly, and deliver high-quality work in a structured and service-minded way.

Your responsibilities will include, among other things:

    Managing assets and materials, including purchase, counting, storage, and scrap processes.
    Following company policies and regulations related to asset and material management.
    Cooperating with internal and external parties for asset and material counting, checking, and follow-up.
    Analyzing requirements and communicating with colleagues to manage different situations effectively.
    Supporting administrative requirements, such as admin regulations training and admin system operations.
    Providing expatriate management and support.
    Supporting daily office-related administration and problem-solving when needed.

The position is full-time and based onsite in Kista. This is a fixed-term parental leave cover, starting in October 2026 and ending in April 2027.

What we offer

You will work in a varied and important role where your contribution supports ISS’ service delivery and helps our customer achieve their goals. You will work closely with competent colleagues and be part of a workplace where we value collaboration, development, and high-quality service. ISS’ size and broad range of services provide strong development opportunities, both nationally and globally. Our focus is on taking care of and developing our employees, because we believe that “People make places”. ISS offers a wide range of training opportunities and talent development programs, all designed to help you stay engaged and grow in your career.

We place great importance on diversity and inclusion. At ISS, all people are valued equally and have the same rights and opportunities. Our employees reflect the diversity of society, which is both a competitive advantage and a valuable asset in our long-term sustainability efforts. Our inclusive corporate culture empowers our people, enhances creativity and productivity, and creates a more attractive workplace.

The core values that guide the way we work at ISS are unity, honesty, responsibility, entrepreneurship and quality. Therefore, it is important that you embrace a way of working and a mindset that align with these values.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for someone with previous experience from an administrative and service-oriented role. Experience from asset management, office administration, or working in an international company is considered an advantage. You have a strong focus on delivering high-quality work and are structured, detail-oriented, and well organized.

You have good organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to plan, prioritize, and execute tasks and smaller projects independently. Good MS Office skills, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook, are required. The ability to create high-quality internal formal documents is considered a plus. Fluent written and verbal communication skills in Chinese and English are essential, while Swedish language skills are an advantage.

As a person, you are service-minded, communicative, responsible, and proactive. You enjoy cooperating with different stakeholders and are comfortable acting as a professional representative of both ISS and the customer.

Do you have questions about the position?

If you have any questions, please contact the recruiting manager Rasmus Huldt: rasmus.huldt@se.issworld.com

Please note: We do not accept applications by email or post. Applications must be submitted through our recruitment system. Applications sent by email or post will be deleted without being processed.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Senior Engineer Material Development
jobs.description:
The Senior Engineer of Material Development will lead the evaluation, analysis, and optimization of Li battery cells and related materials. This role involves providing technical leadership, guiding junior engineers, and ensuring the successful execution of evaluation activities that support both R&D and commercial cell development. The position requires a deep understanding of material behaviour, electrochemical performance, and cell integration to drive continuous improvement in product performance and reliability.



Key Responsibilities

Overall areas of responsibilities and activities

Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to)

    Lead and oversee material and cell-level evaluation activities, including electrochemical performance testing, material characterization, and failure analysis.

    Develop and refine evaluation methodologies, standard test protocols, and data analysis frameworks to ensure consistency and technical rigor.

    Interpret complex analytical and electrochemical data to identify key performance drivers and recommend technical improvements.

    Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and assist in the prioritization and execution of project tasks.

    Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—cell design, process engineering, and quality assurance—to align evaluation results with design and manufacturing objectives.

    Manage multiple evaluation tasks or projects, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality results and documentation.

    Contribute to long-term strategy and roadmap development by identifying material or process-related risks and opportunities for improvement.

    Communicate findings effectively to management and R&D stakeholders through reports, reviews, and technical presentations.
    Stay updated on advancements in Li battery technology, materials science, and analytical techniques, and apply relevant insights to ongoing projects.

Requirements

Educational background and previous experience required for the role

Qualifications and Experience

    BSc or higher degrees in Chemical/Material/Electrical Engineering, and Chemistry.

    Extensive experience in Li battery evaluation, materials analysis, or related R&D areas.

    Preferably 5+ years industrial experience.

    Proven expertise in electrochemical analysis, material characterization, and data-driven problem solving.

    Strong leadership, mentoring, and communication skills with the ability to coordinate multi-functional teams.

    Capable of translating analytical findings into actionable engineering insights and project recommendations.

    High level of self-direction, accountability, and technical judgment in complex problem-solving scenarios.

Specific skills

    Advanced analytical capability in using EIS, GITT, GCPL, and high-precision cycling methods.

    Experience with material analysis tools (SEM/EDS, XPS, ICP, TGA/DSC).

    Ability to design experiments and establish evaluation protocols.

    Strong statistical and data interpretation skills for performance trend analysis.
    Skilled in using data visualization and statistical analysis software.

Personal success factors

    Strong ownership of tasks and ability to work independently.

    Proactive approach to identifying and solving technical issues.

    Clear and persuasive communication across functions.

    Commitment to mentoring and sharing technical knowledge.

    Balanced focus on both immediate problem-solving and process improvement.

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja kotihoitoon
jobs.description:
ETSIMME OULUN ALUEELLE LÄHIHOITAJAA KOTIHOITOON KEIKKATYÖHÖN

Kotihoito tarjoaa mahdollisuuden tehdä yksilöllistä ja merkityksellistä työtä, jossa asiakkaan hyvinvointi ja elämänlaatu ovat keskiössä. Pääset aloittamaan työssä heti tai sopimuksen mukaan.

MITÄ KOTIHOIDON TYÖ SISÄLTÄÄ?

Kotihoidossa työsi on monipuolista, itsenäistä ja ihmisläheistä. Työskentelet asiakkaiden omissa kodeissa ja tuet heitä toimimaan arjessa turvallisesti ja mahdollisimman omatoimisesti. Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat mm.:

* Perushoito ja asiakkaan päivittäinen avustaminen

* Lääkehoito (osaamisen ja lupien mukaisesti)

* Terveyden kokonaisvaltainen seuranta ja mittaukset

* Asiakkaan toimintakyvyn, hyvinvoinnin ja turvallisuuden tukeminen

Kotihoidossa jokainen työpäivä on erilainen. Pääset hyödyntämään ammattitaitoasi laaja-alaisesti ja tekemään työtä, jolla on todellista merkitystä asiakkaiden arjessa.

MITÄ TARJOAMME SINULLE?

* Merkityksellisen, arvostetun ja itsenäisen työn

* Mahdollisuuden työskennellä omalla tavallasi, asiakasta kunnioittaen

* Ammattitaitoisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön tueksesi

* Yksityisen sosiaalialan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan

MITÄ TOIVOMME SINULTA?

* Lähihoitajan tutkintoa ja voimassa olevia lupia

* Asiakaslähtöistä, vastuullista ja lämminhenkistä työotetta

* Kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja päätöksentekoon

* Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa

* Oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta, sillä liikut asiakaskohteiden välillä

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi! Haastattelemme jo hakuajan aikana.

Nähdään Alinassa!

----------------------------------------

Haluatko tietää lisää meistä? Löydät lisätietoa verkkosivuiltamme [https://alinahoivatiimi.fi/].

Alina on valtakunnallinen ketju, joka työllistää jo 350 alan ammattilaista. Paikallisia Alina-yrityksiä on jo yli 40 eri puolilla Suomea. Yhdeksän kymmenestä asiakkaastamme suosittelisi Alinaa tuttavilleen, ja työtyytyväisyytemme sai arvosanaksi 4,39/5 vuonna 2025.

Alina on osa Norlandiaa [https://norlandiacare.fi/], joka tarjoaa innovatiivisia ja monipuolisia hyvinvointi- ja terveyspalveluita kaikille vauvasta vaariin sekä nelijalkaisille ystävillemme. Suomessa Norlandian toimintoihin kuuluvat hoivakodit YHDESSÄ palvelukortteleissa, Tampereella sijaitseva potilashotelli, Norlandia Päiväkodit ja Aberia.

simon.kilimann@noordwind.eu

jobs.title: Doctoral Researcher, Strategic Business Development (H2Nexus Project)
jobs.description:
The University of Vaasa is an inspiring and international community where we work together for a sustainable and responsible future. We combine expertise in business and technology in a unique way, tackling current challenges with determination and collaboration. As part of the Nordic regions largest energy technology hub, we promote sustainable business, energy, and society. We educate future professionals who will create a fairer and more sustainable world.

The University of Vaasa is seeking a motivated and talented Doctoral Researcher to join the Research Council of Finland-funded H2NEXUS project.

The position is full-time and fixed-term (3 years), aligned with the duration of the H2NEXUS project. The preferred start date is September 2026 or as agreed. The position is located in the [School of Management](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/university/organisation-and-management/school-management) in the [Strategic Business Development](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/research/groups-and-focus-areas/strategic-business-development)research grouphttps://www.uwasa.fi/en/research/groups/public-policy-and-governance. The position is located in Vaasa.

About the Project

The H2Nexus project investigates the co-evolution of markets and energy ecosystems, with a particular focus on the emergence of the hydrogen economy in Finland. The project enables a comprehensive understanding of the systemic change through a dual approach: combining techno-economic modelling with a theoretical lens that views markets as designed and evolving coordination systems.

The project explores how institutional work and market practices shape the development and stabilization of key components such as business model innovation, pricing mechanisms, and ecosystem governance. A central research objective is to analyze the conditions and mechanisms that enable or hinder the transition from early-stage development to more mature and institutionalized stages.

Quantitative and qualitative analyses will be integrated into this research, particularly to analyze the impacts of new hydrogen markets and regulations on both the overall energy system and business cases in some hard-to-abate sectors, such as the production of steel, fertilizers, shipping fuels, and aviation fuels. The research will incorporate project-level and system-level models for hydrogen and its derivatives, aligned with market-shaping theory.

The project will produce new knowledge on the clean hydrogen market from market-ecosystem, business case, and energy system perspectives, as well as relevant new datasets, modelling methods, and blueprints. The results can be directly utilized in the scientific community, but also to improve decision-making in the public and private sectors.

Your Role

You will play a key role in the project team and actively participate in the implementation of different activities within the research project. The role emphasizes the ability to conduct high-quality research and interact with different national and international stakeholders. Your work will contribute directly to project deliverables and high-quality academic publications.

Key Responsibilities in the position:

- Contribute to the projects activities.
- Conduct independent and collaborative research on ecosystem emergence, market shaping, and business model innovation.
- Collaborate with an interdisciplinary group of universities, research organisations, manufacturers, retailers, and civil society organisations.
- Participate in data collection (e.g., interviews, workshops, case studies), analysis, and validation activities with industry stakeholders and policy makers.
- Lead and co-author high-quality scientific publications in international peer-reviewed journals.
- Support teaching or supervision tasks when applicable (according to university guidelines).
- Present research at academic conferences and project meetings.
- Produce a doctoral dissertation based on the research carried out within the project.

The position may also include other tasks to be agreed upon separately. All tasks are agreed in more detail in the Annual Work Plan. The annual working time is 1612 hours.

Requirements

A person who has completed a suitable higher university degree (see below) and is a doctoral student at the University of Vaasa can be selected for the position of Doctoral Researcher. We therefore expect the selected person to have the ability and motivation for doctoral studies and to complete a doctoral degree. The selected candidate needs to apply for doctoral studies through a separate application to the University of Vaasa's Graduate School | [Read more about doctoral education, application and eligibility for studies.](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/education/doctoral-education)

Required:

- Masters degree in a relevant field of business studies, such as management, industrial management, B2B management, or a related field.
- Strong proven interest in the research area of the project.
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
- Excellent communication skills in English.
- Motivation to produce high-quality research outputs.

Desirable:

- Experience with qualitative or mixed methods research.
- Experience working with industry stakeholders.
- Experience related to the project's context, whether it be energy or even hydrogen.

Read more about the selection process and language policies: [University of Vaasa (uwasa.fi)](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/open-positions/application-and-selection-process)

We offer

- A fully funded doctoral researcher position (3 years) aligned with a high-profile Research Council of Finland project.
- The selected applicant will be accepted into the University of Vaasas Doctoral Programme and will pursue their doctoral degree in Management after a separate application process.
- Opportunity to collaborate with leading experts across Europe.
- Training in doctoral research, methods, and professional skills.
- Access to industry cases, real-world data, and hands-on circular innovation activities.
- Supportive research environment within the University of Vaasas vibrant research community.

We promote the overall well-being of our employees at work by, among other things, offering fitness and cultural benefits, extensive occupational health care services, and versatile opportunities for continuous learning. F

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
nShift is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. We are headquartered in London and Oslo and have over 500 employees across offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Romania.

Our software is used by many of the world leading e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and 3PL shippers due to us having over 1000 carriers integrated into our platform, nearly 3 times more than our competitors!

If you buy goods online, there is a strong chance that nShift has powered that delivery, so come and join us as we shape the future of shipping, one frictionless journey at a time.

About the role We’re looking for a skilled and solution-driven Java Developer to join our Returns team. You’ll help build and evolve the heart of our post-purchase tools – allowing e-commerce websites to offer a smooth returns mechanism and help us ensure it runs reliably at scale. This is a hands-on role where you’ll be involved in everything from design and development to testing, deployment, and monitoring.

About you You’re a team player who thrives in collaborative environments but also enjoy working independently when needed. With a structured and solution-oriented mindset, you like solving complex challenges and producing clean, high-quality code. Communication, curiosity, and a positive attitude are key strengths you bring to your work.

Responsibilities

·      Design, develop, test, and release backend features for Returns in line with team and company guidelines.

·      Build and maintain integrations with e-commerce platforms (e.g. Shopify, Magento, Centra) — including webhooks, authentication, and data imports.

·      Contribute to architecture and platform decisions (security frameworks, GDPR, architecture, monitoring, CI/CD tools).

·      Write clean, testable, and reusable code that is scalable and cost-efficient.

·      Work with modern practices such as code reviews, automated testing, and continuous integration/delivery.

·      Be an active member of an autonomous team, helping shape both the product and how we work.

·      Stay up to date with new technologies and proactively suggest improvements for performance and scalability.

Required professional experience

We are looking for both junior and senior backend engineers with experience in most of the following technologies:

·      Java

·      Spring Boot and the Spring ecosystem (Spring Data JPA / Hibernate)

·      PostgreSQL, including schema migration tooling (Liquibase or Flyway)

·      AWS (S3, SES, and related services)

·      CI/CD knowledge such as Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines, Docker, etc.

·      Monitoring tools such as ELK stack or equivalent

·      Testing: unit testing (JUnit, Mockito), integration testing against mocked external services (WireMock, REST Assured), and performance testing (e.g. JMeter)

Nice to have:

·      Designing and versioning public REST APIs (OpenAPI / Swagger)

·      Redis and caching strategies

·      E-commerce or post-purchase domain experience

For senior candidates, we additionally value experience working in a large, long-lived codebase — carving out and building modern services alongside a monolith, and driving modernization without disrupting a system that merchants rely on every day.

What we’re looking for in you

·      Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to deliver clean and scalable code.

·      Service-minded with a positive, proactive attitude.

·      Comfortable working independently as well as in a collaborative agile team.

·      Fluent in written and spoken English.

Why join us?

At nShift, you’ll work on a platform used globally to handle millions of deliveries, solving complex technical challenges with real-world impact. We value knowledge sharing, autonomy, and continuous learning, offering plenty of opportunities to grow your skills while contributing to meaningful projects.

jobs.title: Pædagog og afdelingsleder
jobs.employer: S/I Solhjem, Rudolf Steiner Vuggestue og Børnehave
jobs.description:
GENOPSLAG

 

Solhjem søger pædagog og afdelingsleder

 

Pr. 1. september 2026 søger vi en pædagog og afdelingsleder til vores Børnehavehus. Stillingen er på 37 timer, heraf 10 timer afsat til ledelsesopgaver. Børnehavehuset er den største af Solhjems afdelinger og består af tre børnegrupper på hver omkring 20 børn. Der er et tæt samarbejde grupperne imellem.

 

Som afdelingsleder har du ansvaret for det pædagogiske arbejde i afdelingen samt for praktisk koordinering og personaleledelse. Du indgår desuden i Solhjems ledelsesteam sammen med 3 øvrige afdelingsledere og Solhjems leder. Ledelsesteamet har faste ugentlige møder.

Til daglig er du tilknyttet én af børnegrupperne som pædagog og indgår dér i et tæt samarbejde med børnegruppens anden pædagog samt en pædagogisk medhjælper.

 

Solhjem er et Rudolf Steiner dagtilbud, hvor vi har børn i alderen 1 – 6 år. Vi har 4 forskellige afdelinger: Børnehavehuset, Vuggestuen, den fuldintegrerede afdeling Vildrosen samt vores skovbørnehave Brumbasserne. Sammenlagt har vi plads til 146 børn, når vi er flest. Solhjem ligger ved skov og strand med Rudolf Steiner Skolen som nærmeste nabo.

I vores pædagogiske praksis lægger vi vægt på at skabe en tryg og genkendelig hverdag for alle børn. Vi arbejder ud fra en oplevelsesorienteret og kunstnerisk tilgang til pædagogikken, og vi værdsætter livet udenfor på alle årstider.  
Vi er et engageret kollegialt fællesskab med højt til loftet og begejstring for det pædagogiske arbejde. Vi er optaget af faglig udveksling og udvikling, som vi glæder os til at dele med vores nye afdelingsleder i Børnehavehuset.

 

I ansættelsen prioriterer vi kandidater med følgende kompetencer:

  • Du har erfaring indenfor målgruppen 3 – 6 år

  • Du har erfaring med ledelse af pædagogisk praksis

  • Du har erfaring med eller interesse for steinerpædagogik

  • Du har kommunikative kompetencer både skriftligt og mundtligt

  • Du har et godt overblik og sans for praktisk koordinering

  • Du har erfaring med administrative opgaver (skemalægning, vikardækning, korrespondancer mv.)

  • Du har lyst til og forudsætninger for at indgå i Solhjems pædagogiske ledelse

 


Se i øvrigt vores hjemmeside: www.solhjem-aarhus.dk

For yderligere oplysninger: Tina Lauritsen, leder, på tlf. 26 19 82 95.

 

Send din ansøgning på mail til post@solhjem-aarhus.dk.

Ansøgningsfrist d. 3. august 2026 kl. 12. Tiltrædelse 1. september eller snarest derefter.

Vi afholder 1. samtalerunde i uge 32, 2. samtalerunde i uge 33.

jobs.title: Project Controls Manager
jobs.description:
Project Controls Manager

The European Spallation Source (ESS) will soon be the world’s most powerful source of neutrons, providing researchers with unique opportunities to explore the structure of materials at the atomic level. Neutron scattering at ESS will address critical questions in physics, chemistry, geology, materials science and life science.

We are now looking for a Project Controls Manager to oversee the operational and development project scope at ESS.  



About the role:

The Project Controls Manager (PCM) plays a critical role in ensuring the best use of the human and financial resources for the ESS organisation. They are responsible for establishing and maintaining the systems, processes, and governance needed to plan, monitor, and control organisational performance and the ESS programme. The role provides leadership across planning and scheduling, cost control, risk management, change control, and reporting to support informed decision-making and successful delivery. Working closely with project managers, technical leads, finance, procurement, operations, and other stakeholders, the PCM will have a central overview of both the operational and development project scope.

This is a permanent role based at ESS campus in Lund, Sweden.  



Day-to-day, you will:

    Supervise a team managing cost control, planning, risk, change control and reporting functions.  
    Lead the development, maintenance, and governance of integrated schedules using Primavera P6. This includes long term strategic planning, shutdown planning and development project planning.  
    Establish baseline schedules, progress measurement methods, and schedule update routines to support accurate forecasting and performance tracking.  
    Establish yearly budgets, cost reports, forecasts, and performance metrics.  
    Monitor actual cost and commitments against budget and forecast, identifying trends, variances, and corrective actions.  
    Implement and maintain project risk management processes, including risk identification (threats and opportunities), assessment, mitigation planning, and monitoring.  
    Manage project change control processes to ensure that scope, schedule, cost, and risk impacts are properly assessed, approved, and recorded.  
    Prepare and issue regular project controls reports, dashboards, and management summaries for key stakeholders.  
    Support decision-making through scenario analysis, performance insight, and timely escalation of issues and risks.  
    Ensure alignment and consistency between planning, cost, risk, and reporting data across the project controls function.  
    Collaborate with project managers, work package owners, finance, procurement, and contractors to maintain robust project controls.  
    Contribute to continuous improvement of project controls standards, tools, templates, and governance.



About you:

    University degree in engineering, science, project management, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
    Proven experience in project controls within large-scale technical, scientific, infrastructure, industrial, or engineering environments.
    Proven experience leading and supervising multidisciplinary teams across planning, cost control, risk, change control, and reporting functions.
    Experience establishing and managing project budgets, forecasts, cost reporting, and performance metrics.
    Solid understanding of project governance, risk management, change control, and project lifecycle management principles.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends, assess risks, and support decision-making.
    Demonstrated ability to take initiative, and drive actions in a complex stakeholder environment.
    Proven ability to lead, motivate, and supervise teams while fostering collaboration and accountability.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing reports and presenting information to diverse stakeholders.
    Ability to work effectively in an international, multidisciplinary environment with multiple technical and operational interfaces.



To apply:

Working at ESS gives you the opportunity to contribute to the future discoveries within neutron science at a stunning, brand-new workplace filled with innovative minds and brilliant people from across the globe. We offer market competitive, individualised compensation which is differentiated according to role, responsibilities, individual skills, abilities and achievements as well as monthly pension contributions on top of your salary.

If you see yourself in what we’re looking for, please provide your CV and motivation letter in English by clicking on “Apply” and following the instructions. Please be aware that we can only accept direct applications made via the ESS website.

For further information regarding the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Specialist Louise Jönegård at louise.jonegard@ess.eu.  

For trade union information, please contact Unionen representative Nerusha Naicker on mailto:erusha.Naicker@ess.eu or SACO/Swedish Association of Graduate Engineers representative Marc Kickulies at mailto:marc.kickulies@ess.eu

Eepeellä teemme ihan tavallisia töitä. Tavallisuus on voima, joka erottaa meidät muista. Meillä työ ei ole vain peruspesti, mutta samalla se on juuri sitä. Tavallinen työ on sitä, mitä pitääkin olla – tehokasta, arvokasta ja tärkeää. Ihan tavallisen työn lisäksi, meillä on epätavallisen hyvät edut ja poikkeuksellisen mahtavat työkaverit.

jobs.title: Myyjä, Sale Karjalohja
jobs.description:
Primary location:
LOHJA

Etsimme nyt vakituista MYYJÄÄ Karjalohjan Saleen! Tehtävä on osa-aikainen, 20 h/vko.Myyjän työ sopii sinulle, joka innostut asiakaspalvelusta ja tekemisen meiningistä. Siitä on tietysti hyötyä, jos olet työskennellyt vastaavissa tehtävissä jo aiemmin, mutta se ei ole välttämätöntä – me perehdytämme kyllä! Voit tutustua Salemme tunnelmaansomessa, ja saatatpa bongata tulevien työkavereiden kasvojakin!

🛒Salen myyjänä teet ihan tavallisia töitä:työpäiväsi täyttyvät asiakaskohtaamisista, kassatyöstä, hyllytyksestä sekä hävikin ja saatavuuden hallinnasta. Tavallisuus ei kuitenkaan tarkoita tylsää tai merkityksetöntä – päinvastoin! Meille tavallista on asiakkaiden hurmaaminen leveällä hymyllä ja reippaalla työotteella.

🌟Toivomme, että pidät asiakkaiden kohtaamisesta, tiimityöskentelystä, fyysisestä työstä ja reippaasta työtahdista. Edellytämme 18 vuoden ikää ja mahdollisuutta työskennellä vaihtelevissa aamu- päivä- ja iltavuoroissa n. klo 7–21 välillä.

Haluamme vastaavasti tarjota sinulle
·💚Ihan tavallisia töitä, mutta erityisen hyvät henkilöstöedut! Miltä kuulostaisi -25 % alennus S-ryhmän ravintoloista? Tai -15 % alennus käyttötavaroista mm. Prismoista ja Sokokselta? Suomen parhaimmiksikin kutsutuista henkilöstöeduista voit lukea esimakuatäältä.
·💸Kaupan työehtosopimuksen mukaista palkkaa koulutuksesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella. Tuntipalkkasi tulee sijoittumaan välille 11,16–14,93 €/h. Ja lisät päälle!
·💰Mahdollisuuden vuosittaiseen tulospalkkioon.
·💎Arvokasta kokemusta asiakaspalvelusta, myynnistä ja tiimityöstä. Näitä taitoja tarvitaan lähes jokaisessa työpaikassa, joten tilaisuus kerryttää kokemusta kannattaa käyttää hyödyksi.
·🛒Jos kaipaat enemmän viikkotyötunteja, voit halutessasi tehdä lisätöitä joko kotimyymälässäsi tai SSO:n muissa toimipisteissä. Samalla kerrytät eurojen lisäksi osaamista ja saat uusia työkavereita.
·🤩Harvinaisen hyvät työkaverit! 88 % työntekijöistämme suosittelee SSO:ta työnantajana. Karjalohjalla sinua odottaa 6 hengen tiimi valmiina hommiin kanssasi!
💎Työn ja vapaa-ajan sujuvamman yhteensovittamisen vaikuttamalla itse omiin työvuoroihisi. Sale Karjalohjalla kuten yhä useammassaSSO:ntoimipisteessä, otetaan lokakuussa käyttöönyhteisöllisen työvuorosuunnittelu.Uudessa mallissa työntekijät voivat valita itselleen sopivia työvuoroja sovittujen pelisääntöjen mukaisesti.

💚Me SSO:ssa olemme sitoutuneet työskentelemään monimuotoisen ja syrjimättömän työympäristön puolesta, jossa kunnioitetaan ja arvostetaan kaikkien työntekijöidemme ainutlaatuisia taustoja, taitoja ja näkemyksiä.

Lisätiedot ja hakeminen
Työsuhteen tyyppi: vakituinen
Työaika: osa-aikainen 20 h/vko
Työt alkavat: syyskuussa sopimuksen mukaan
Huomaathan, että haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuajalla, ja valintapäätökset tehdään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

📞Lisätietoja tehtävistä antaa arkisin klo 8–16 myymäläpäällikkö Anne-Mari Kujala joko puhelimitse 044320 5796 tai sähköpostitseanne-mari.kujala@sok.fi.

Työnantajakuvaus
Me SSO:ssa arvostamme ihan tavallisia töitä, mutta vielä enemmän arvostamme niitä epätavallisen upeita ihmisiä töiden takana. Uskomme, että ihmiset ratkaisevat onnistumisen. Myyjä, tarjoilija, asiantuntija ja tuhat muuta – me kaikki teemme yhdessä kotiseudustamme parempaa paikkaa elää. Siksi meidät valittiinkin yhdeksi Suomen Innostavimmista työpaikoista vuonna 2025. Työllistämme noin 1200 ammattilaista neljällä eri toimialalla, 80 eri toimipaikassa läntisellä Uudellamaalla ja Salon seudulla. Lue lisää ihan tavallisista töistä ja epätavallisen hyvistä eduista osoitteessasso.fi/toihinmeille.

jobs.title: Senior quantitative analyst within credit risk and capital
jobs.description:
Do you want to make a real impact by applying your analytical expertise to shape the future of risk-adjusted financial steering?

In Swedbank you have the opportunity to:

    

Use your senior expertise in credit risk and/or capital management to address complex challenges and make a real impact in the business-critical area of risk-adjusted financial steering.

    

Lead and take ownership of activities related to development of new models and methods for capital allocation and risk-adjusted profitability management in the Swedish corporate banking business.

    

Leverage large-scale, complex datasets to perform quantitative analysis and derive actionable insights, strengthen model performance and enhance steering capabilities.

    

Drive change initiatives within the capital domain, ensuring effective collaboration with colleagues across the business area Corporate & Institutions and Swedbank’s central group functions (Risk, Treasury and Finance).

What is needed in this role:

    

A degree in engineering, mathematics, statistics, economics or a related quantitative field.

    

5+ years of experience from analytical roles within credit risk, modelling (IRB/IFRS 9), ICAAP, stress testing or capital management.

    

Strong analytical skills combined with a genuine interest in business, and motivation to use data, models and insights to strengthen decision-making where risk, return and business value meet.

    

You enjoy working with complex topics, take ownership of your deliveries and have a strong sense of quality and responsibility.

    

You are eager to learn and committed to developing both your technical expertise and your business understanding.

    

As a person, you are collaborative, solution-oriented and transparent. You contribute positively to the team, communicate clearly with different stakeholders and are comfortable challenging assumptions when needed.

With us, you can experience:

    

Personal and professional growth through self-leadership and continuous development.

    

Meaningful work that positively impacts our workplace, our customers, and society.

    

An open and collaborative culture that encourages cross-functional teamwork and provides networking opportunities.

    

A supportive and inclusive environment that promotes a balanced and sustainable work-life, with flexible working conditions when suitable for the role.

    

Benefits such as our share based reward program Eken, company pension plan, employee offer for banking products, health insurance.

"Join our team and...

You’ll join a supportive and collaborative team that values both high-quality work and a positive team culture. We are a highly engaged and driven analytical team working together to enable long-term, sustainable profitability in the Swedish corporate banking business. Our focus is on delivering solutions that strengthen the business by improving risk-adjusted decision-making, capital efficiency and competitiveness." Elin Rapp, your future manager

We look forward to receiving your application by 31.08.2026.

Location: Stockholm, Malmskillnadsgatan

We may begin the selection during the application period, so we welcome your application as soon as possible.

We would like to let you know that a background check and a drug test may be a part of the process for this role.

jobs.title: Køkkenassistent, kok, delikatesseslagter eller lignende med sans for gode råvarer og smagfulde retter søges
jobs.description:
Vi tilbyder:
Et spændende job på en efterskole, hvor du får en udfordrende og afvekslende arbejdsdag. For at lykkes i jobbet, skal du kunne samarbejde, trives med en travl hverdag, hvor skolens elever hjælper til i køkkenet. Vi vægter, at madlavningen er baseret på friske og delvist økologiske råvarer, samt at mest mulig mad er produceret fra bunden.  På Blåkilde Efterskole arbejder vi på at gøre skolens drift mere bæredygtig - også i køkkenet ;-)

 

Om dig:

Du finder glæde i at udfordre elevernes smagsløg med nærende og spændende mad. Du finder energi i et dynamisk arbejdsmiljø, hvor arbejdsdagen er præget af variation, højt tempo, god musik og dejlige efterskoleelever. For en del elever er det nyt at hjælpe til i køkkenet og de har brug for ekstra hjælp, og derfor skal du være tålmodig og indstillet på at sige tingene flere gange.

 

Personlige og faglige kompetencer:

·     Du motiveres af din nysgerrighed på råvarer og vil gerne tænke nyt

·     Du nyder at lave maden helt fra bunden og går op i smagfulde retter

·     Du er holdspiller, da du bliver en del af et team på 4 ansatte i køkkenet

·     Du er imødekommende og kan lide at arbejde med unge mennesker

·     Du kan arbejde selvstændigt, effektivt og fokuseret

·     Du kan håndtere pres og har et godt overblik

·     Du er fleksibel, da arbejdstiden varierer

Ansættelse: fra 1. oktober 2026 på ca. 32 timer/uge, fordelt over dag-, aften- og weekendvagter.
Ansøgningsfrist: 19. august kl. 12.00. Samtaler forventes afviklet i uge 35.
Løn og pension: Efter uddannelse og erhvervserfaring.
Ansøgningen mailes til Anette Siersbæk ass@blaakilde-efterskole.dk

Yderlige oplysninger fås ved køkkenleder Anette Siersbæk 22127869 eller forstander Jens Christian Kirk 22550654.
