jobs.title: Nanny Camp Hill
jobs.description:
Full-time Nanny, Camp Hill (40-hours), Commence ASAP!

Hours: MondayâFriday, approx. 40hrs per week (6amâ2pm) | Permanent Full-Time (4-day week may be considered for the right candidate)

Salary: From $70,000 + super + entitlements

Minis: Two boys, 4 & 2, with a baby girl due in November

Commence: ASAP

About Our Clients

This warm and vibrant Camp Hill family are looking for an easy going and friendly Nanny to become a valued part of their home. Dad is a busy business owner, while Mum is a stay-at-home mum preparing to welcome their third mini later this year. They value integrity, accountability and kindness, and have created a positive, respectful home where open communication and mutual appreciation are at the heart of family life.

Their boys are active, curious and full of laughter, enjoying swimming lessons, music, park adventures and playing with monster trucks. The family embraces a healthy lifestyle with limited screen time and loves outdoor play and learning through everyday experiences.

Duties

  • Sole charge of the minis when required
  • Planning fun, engaging outings and activities
  • Taking the minis to swimming, music and other social activities
  • Preparing healthy meals for the minis
  • Light household duties including kitchen tidying, dishes, rubbish and general wipe-downs
  • Driving the minis to activities using the family vehicle
  • Supporting the smooth running of the household during busy mornings


The perfect fit

You're reliable, adaptable and personable, with a genuine passion for supporting young families. You are known to be a nanny who is respectful and not overbearing and follows family routine whilst being confident working independently while respecting the family's routines and parenting style.

All you need is minimum 3-yrs professional childcare and or nanny experience, a valid Blue Card, police check, first aid/CPR certification and a current driver's licence. Most importantly, you'll be someone who builds trust naturally, communicates openly and enjoys creating a calm, fun and nurturing environment where children can thrive.

What's in it for you?

  • Become a genuinely valued and trusted member of a warm family
  • A supportive, respectful workplace where you'll be appreciated
  • Long-term, permanent employment providing stability and consistency
  • A nanny car for your job
  • Competitive salary plus superannuation and full entitlements
  • Opportunity to build meaningful relationships with three wonderful children as the family grows


If you have always dreamed about becoming a professional nanny with a natural gift bonding with children, we'd love to hear from you!

Apply Now

Hit Apply, or send your updated resume and introduction outlining why you'd be the perfect fit to hello@miniconnections.com.au. Shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

jobs.description:
Společnost EURONA s.r.o., hledá do týmu kolegu či kolegyni, které baví kombinace dat, kreativy a viditelných výsledků. Hledá člověka, který chce být součástí týmu přímo na pracovišti a vyhovuje mu každodenní spolupráce v kanceláři. Tato pozice není určena pro práci formou home office ani remote spolupráce, a to ani částečně.

Jedná se o pracovní poměr na dobu určitou s možností prodloužení na dobu neurčitou, pružná pracovní doba. Nástup možný ihned.
Pozice je vhodná i pro absolventy/absolventky.

Co Vás u nás čeká: správa a rozvoj firemních profilů na sociálních sítích (Facebook, Instagram) a firemního webu; plánování, tvorba a publikace obsahu včetně Reels, videí, fotografií a textů; vyhodnocování výkonnosti kampaní a příspěvků, práce s daty a návrhy na zlepšení; spolupráce na tvorbě a realizaci marketingové a obsahové strategie; samostatné vedení svěřených projektů a odpovědnost za jejich včasné dokončení; tvorba marketingových textů, korektury tiskovin, obalů a etiket produktů; správa produktového obsahu na webu, zadávání novinek, akcí a dalších marketingových aktivit.

Co od Vás očekáváme: zkušenosti nebo orientaci v online marketingu a sociálních sítích; analytické myšlení a schopnost pracovat s daty a vyhodnocovat výsledky; cit pro obsah, vizuální komunikaci a moderní trendy na sociálních sítích; spolehlivost, aktivitu a chuť přicházet s vlastními nápady; schopnost efektivně spolupracovat v týmu a být součástí každodenního dění ve firmě; možnost a ochotu vykonávat práci každodenně na pracovišti zaměstnavatele (pozice neumožňuje home office ani práci na dálku).

Co Vám nabízíme: zajímavou a různorodou práci s možností vidět konkrétní výsledky své práce; stabilní zázemí prosperující české společnosti; práci v přátelském a neformálním kolektivu; prostor pro vlastní iniciativu, nápady a profesní rozvoj; motivační finanční ohodnocení; příspěvek na stravování a penzijní nebo životní pojištění.

jobs.title: Regional General Manager Airports
jobs.description:
Why WestJet

Since our story took off in 1996, WestJet has strived to enrich the lives of everyone in our world; a career with us is no exception. Weâre proud to be one of Canadaâs most admired and respected corporate cultures and continuously aim for the highest standards of service and success.

Join us, this is where your career story takes off.

This position is eligible for remote work, within Canada, under our mobile workforce program.

Regional General Manager, Airports

As the Regional General Manager, you will provide strategic leadership and direction to deliver safe operations while driving excellence in operational performance and guest service through our contracted service partners across the designated region. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Airports, you will lead a team of Regional Managers and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to maintain regulatory compliance, foster positive relationships, and ensure a consistent, high-quality guest experience across all airport touchpoints within the region.

This role requires an experienced leader who holds service partners accountable for delivering WestJet's operational and service standards while balancing the needs of our guests, our partners, and our business. You will coach and support service partners in developing and executing airport action plans that address performance gaps, strengthen safety, and improve the guest experience.

The Regional General Manager will provide strategic oversight of airport operations across the region by identifying emerging risks, monitoring operational performance, and ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's standards and priorities. Through strong partnerships with service providers and airport authorities, you will drive continuous improvement, enhance operational resilience, and ensure our airports consistently deliver safe, reliable operations and an exceptional guest experience.

Key Deliverables Include

  • Foster a Safety Above All culture with Regional Managers by ensuring service partners achieve safety targets, monitoring performance trends, and addressing operational risks.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Regional Managers to deliver operational performance, guest satisfaction, employee engagement, and financial results.
  • Provide strategic oversight of airport operations, ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's operational and guest standards and priorities.
  • Deliver regional operational performance by achieving operational, guest experience, and financial objectives while driving continuous improvement through station action plans.
  • Provide governance through audits, operational reviews, and performance assessments to ensure adherence to standards, identify risks, and drive corrective actions.
  • Analyze operational performance and safety data to identify trends and risks, inform operational decision making, prioritize resources, and strengthen oversight across the region.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for Regional Managers, providing leadership and decision support for complex operational, guest, commercial, safety, and irregular operations.
  • Partner with the Strategic Procurement team to develop service partner strategies, support partner selection, and ensure service partners deliver safe, high-performing, and cost-effective operations.
  • Build and maintain executive relationships with airport authorities, service partner leadership, government agencies, bargaining agents, and other key stakeholders.
  • Lead regional operational planning to ensure airports are resourced and operationally ready for seasonal demand, network growth, start-ups, restarts, service partner transitions, station closures, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Champion innovation and continuous improvement by leveraging data and implementing initiatives that enhance operational performance, the guest experience, employee engagement, and financial results.
  • Participate as a member of the Airports Leadership Team to establish departmental priorities, contribute to strategic direction, and lead the development and execution of departmental initiatives.

Experience And Qualifications

  • 3+ years Airports leadership experience required
  • Business leadership experience with a significant level of internal and external dependencies and relationships.
  • Possess strong business acumen to deliver departmental plans including budget.
  • Proven ability to multitask & handle changing priorities.
  • Confident in presenting materials and reports to the next 2 levels.
  • Post-secondary education with a business application an asset.
  • Ability to manage multiple leaders and locations simultaneously.
  • Proficient in PC based applications, Microsoft Project, Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Ability to travel & spend time away for significant periods of time.
  • Project management skills considered an asset.
  • Knowledge of International regulations and guidelines (for example - TSA/Civil Aviation, UK High Commission etc.) an asset.
  • Proven track record of effectively influencing leadership teams via handling partners and developing strong direct leadership teams.
  • IATA SGHA experience would be beneficial.

The Benefits Of Being a WestJetter

WestJet provides all WestJetters with a competitive total rewards package. On top of that, we offer:

  • A fun and friendly culture with colleagues who work together to win
  • Travel privileges for you and your family, effective from your start date
  • Savings and Benefit programs that are flexible to meet your specific needs

Think weâre a great fit? Apply now!

About WestJet Group Of Companies

WestJet took to the skies in 1996 with just over 200 employees and three aircraft operating service to five destinations. Since then, WestJet has pioneered low-cost travel in Canada, cutting airfares in half, and increasing the flying population in Canada by more than 50 per cent. Since the Sunwing Airlines integration in 2025, more than 15,000 WestJetters support nearly 200 aircraft and connect guests to our global network of more than 100 destinations across North America, Central America, the Caribbean, Europe and Asia. The WestJet Group is a major Canadian employer and includes WestJet Airlines, WestJet Encore and Sunwing Vacations Group. Weâre Canadaâs leading value airline and largest vacation provider, with a united purpose of providing affordable and accessible air and vacation travel to Canadians.

Our safety promise

At WestJet, the safety and security of our people and our guests is a core value and at the heart of what we do. Safety and security are shared responsibilities all team members are expected to use safe work practices to ensure their well-being and the safety of others. WestJet recognizes that the use of Alcohol and Drugs can adversely impact a safe work environment and the well-being of others including guests, suppliers and the public, as well as place WestJet's operations at risk. All roles that are identified as Safey-Sensitive are required to pass a Pre-Employment Alcohol and Drug Test as per WestJet'sâ¯Alcohol and Drug Policy.â¯

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We embrace what makes each of us unique, and what makes us uniquely WestJet. We welcome diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds so if you're passionate about this role, we encourage you to apply â even if you don't meet every qualification listed. WestJet is committed to inclusiveness, equity and accessibility throughout the selection process. If you require accommodation at any stage, please contact our Talent Acquisition team at talent@westjet.com.

We value the time and effort you put into your application. Our recruitment process is highly competitive and while every applicant will receive communication regarding their application status, only those selected to move forward will be contacted with next steps. jobs.title: Home and Office Cleaner
jobs.description:
Hyvinkään Kotisiivous Oy currently has approximately 180 regular cleaning customers per month, most of whom are private households in Hyvinkää and the surrounding areas. About 10 of these are business customers, in addition to a few stairwell cleaning sites. During the summer season, additional work mainly consists of cleaning windows and balcony glazing.

Workdays usually begin in the morning at the office, from where employees travel to the cleaning sites using the companys vans, and return to the same location at the end of the workday. For this reason, a valid driving licence and good driving skills for operating a van are required. Cleaning work at the sites is carried out mainly using the companys own cleaning products and equipment.

The companys current working languages are English and Finnish. These languages are also used as the customer service languages in the office, depending on the cleaners level of Finnish language skills. The job of a cleaner requires good physical endurance as well as strong mental resilience, as the expectations of several different customers must be met every day. The job requirements are introduced during a three-week training period, after which the employee continues working together with a more experienced cleaning pair.

Company can arrange a housing benefit in the center of Hyvinkää if needed.

jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Replit is seeking a Senior Business Development Manager to lead and scale our outbound sales development team as we expand our go-to-market efforts. This role will oversee a team of BDRs (Business Development Representatives) proactively targeting and engaging high-potential accounts to build a robust pipeline for our Account Executives.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on outbound prospecting experience and proven leadership skills, a strong understanding of the modern GTM technology, previous experience in creating systems and orchestrating technology to support an efficient & scalable 0->1 outbound workflow, and previous experience collaborating tightly with marketing and sales ops to build highly-targeted account lists and multi-channel outreach sequences. Experience & interest in vibe coding and/or technical experience is highly valued.

This position is critical to our go-to-market strategy, responsible for defining our outbound playbook, identifying key target personas, hiring top-tier talent, coaching team members, and ensuring persistent, high-quality outreach & pipeline generation across all segments from SMB to Enterprise. You'll establish the foundation for scalable revenue growth while architecting a personalized first-touch experience that sets the tone for their Replit journey.

We believe this role offers a distinctive opportunity for proven sales development professionals who excel in both strategic account targeting and team leadership, with a passion for technology and AI. You'll leverage your expertise to build a world-class BDR organization that effectively cuts through the noise to communicate Replit's value proposition: a world where anyone can create software using natural language.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL…

 - Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of Business Development Representatives

 - Develop and implement BDR processes, playbooks, and best practices for cold and warm-outbound channels

 - Coach and mentor BDRs on qualification methodology, objection handling, and pipeline generation techniques

 - Partner with sales leadership to provide feedback on territory assignments, quotas, performance metrics, lead handoff processes

 - Evangelize a future where anyone can create software in natural language, ensuring your team can articulate this vision compellingly

 - Collaborate with marketing and operations to optimize lead routing, provide feedback on campaign effectiveness, and improve lead quality & conversion

 - Analyze team performance data and implement strategies to improve conversion rates and meeting quality

 - Recruit, hire, and onboard new SDR/BDR team members as the organization scales

 - Maintain accountability for team quota attainment and individual BDR development

 - Work closely with Account Executives and AE leaders to ensure smooth handoffs and tight feedback loops

 - Uphold CRM hygiene and reporting accuracy across the SDR organization

 - Stay current on industry trends and competitive landscape to inform team strategy




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 5+ years of sales development experience with at least 3 years in a leadership or management role, preferably some with a technical ICP

 - Proven track record of building and scaling BDR teams, preferably in a high-growth environment

 - Strong individual contributor background with deep understanding of both inbound & outbound prospecting, demand gen strategies, and industry best practices

 - Excellent coaching and mentoring abilities with experience developing junior sales talent

 - Data-driven approach to performance management and process optimization

 - Outstanding written and verbal communication skills

 - Experience with CRM systems and sales tools (e.g., Hubspot/SFDC, LinkedIn, ZoomInfo, Clay, SmartLead, Outreach, Default, etc)

 - Ability to recruit, interview, and assess SDR candidates effectively

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with marketing and sales teams

 - Passion for technology and ability to quickly learn and teach complex technical concepts

 - Experience with or strong interest in AI and machine learning is a plus




NICE TO HAVE:

 - You're an active Replit user

 - You've worked at an early-stage startup or in developer tools

 - Experience building inbound SDR programs from 0-1 and/or scaling from early stage

 - Basic understanding of software development or coding concepts

 - Experience with multi-channel prospecting (email, phone, social)

 - Degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent practical experience)




TOOLS + TECH STACK FOR THIS ROLE

 - Replit

 - Hubspot CRM (Salesforce coming soon)

 - ZoomInfo

 - Outreach

 - Gong

 - Chorus

 - Clay

 - SmartLead

 - Nooks

 - Default

 - LinkedIn Sales Navigator

 - Hashboard, Hex
   
   


THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF

 - You're not based in the Salt Lake City area and/or willing to relocate

 - You have no interest in understanding the software development lifecycle or learning basic coding concepts

 - You're not passionate about AI

 - You prefer individual contributor work over people management and team building

 - You're uncomfortable with a fast-paced startup environment where priorities may shift quickly



This is a full-time hybrid role and has an in-office requirement.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Environment Specialist (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description des tâches:
The Supply Chain Environmental Specialist supports the development and delivery of Vodafone's environmental strategy across supply chain categories and markets. The role focuses on category-level climate transition planning, supplier engagement, emissions reduction, and capability building within procurement, ensuring purchased goods and services align with Vodafone's 2030 reduction milestones and 2040 Net Zero ambition.
The role sits within Vodafone Procure & Connect (VP&C) in Luxembourg and reports into Vodafone Group's Sustainable Business Team, which sets global sustainability strategy and partners with business units to drive delivery. This is a growing and high-impact area, offering the opportunity to work with sustainability and supply chain experts while engaging a wide range of stakeholders across markets and functions. The role requires a self-driven individual with strong communication and programme management skills, comfortable creating new ways of working.

1. Category climate transition strategies
Support the development of category-specific climate transition plans aligned to Net Zero 2040.
Conduct baseline assessments to identify emissions hotspots, risks, opportunities, and KPIs.
Embed environmental criteria into category planning to support long-term decarbonization.
2. Procurement collaboration & decision-making support
Support the implementation of sustainable procurement processes, including environmental requirements and contract terms.
Partner with category managers to embed carbon reduction targets, environmental KPIs, and climate-aligned supplier selection.
Provide climate data, insights, and analysis to support responsible sourcing decisions.
Support ESG assessments within RFQs, guiding suppliers and integrating results into scoring models.
3. Supplier engagement & performance management
Manage supplier performance against ESG contractual commitments and KPIs.
Drive supplier alignment with Vodafone's environmental targets, reporting, and transition pathways.
Issue and track supplier improvement plans, escalating risks where required.
Participate in supplier reviews to support credible decarbonization and improved environmental performance.
4. Capability building for procurement teams
Deliver training, tools, and guidance to strengthen environmental capability across procurement.
Develop templates, guidance, and onboarding materials covering KPIs, carbon methodologies, and assessments.
Facilitate workshops and learning sessions to embed sustainability into BAU procurement activities.
5. Environmental data, reporting & governance
Support consolidation and validation of supplier climate data for category strategies, CSRD, and internal reporting.
Maintain category-level environmental KPIs and provide progress updates to leadership.
Provide accurate and timely supply chain environmental data to Group Finance.
Who you are
•    A bachelor's degree in Logistics, Materials and Supply Chain Management
•    At least 4 years of experience in Supply Chain
•    Strong project management, analytical skills and comfort working with data.
•    Ability to communicate effectively with suppliers and internal stakeholders, including procurement and finance teams.
•    Proactive, collaborative, and detail oriented approach to problem solving and ability to work independently.
•    Foundational knowledge of procurement processes, category strategies and supplier engagement.
•    Passion for environmental sustainability, climate transition, Scope 3 emissions, and circularity.

Études:
Niveau d'étude demandé egal Bachelor (Bac +3)
Métier / domaine de formation:
Logistics, Materials and Supply Chain Management

jobs.title: Cytogeneticist (m/f)
jobs.description:
Cytogeneticist (m/f) Ref°49800

TYPE DE CONTRAT : CDI - temps plein

The Laboratoire national de santé (Luxembourg public institution) is recruiting a Cytogeneticist  (m/f)  for a full time (40 h/week) role and permanent  contract at the National Center of Genetics in the Hematooncogenetics-Cytogenetics Service.

ABOUT THE LABORATOIRE NATIONAL DE SANTE

The LNS is a major player in Luxembourg's healthcare sector, serving the country's patients, doctors and hospitals. Under the supervision of the Ministry of Health and Social Security, the LNS is a multidisciplinary public institution organized around six medical departments, two of which are designated as national diagnostic centers for human genetics and pathology respectively.

The LNS employs around 400 highly qualified staff with diverse backgrounds. The main purpose of the LNS is to develop analytical activities and scientific expertise relating to the prevention, diagnosis and monitoring of human diseases; to act as a national control or reference laboratory; and to carry out forensic missions. The LNS also collaborates with the University of Luxembourg and other biomedical research institutions, both nationally and internationally, on research and teaching activities.

In particular, in the field of diagnostics, the LNS covers the following fields of application: medical biology, microbiology, forensic medicine, environmental medicine, morphological and molecular pathology, and clinical genetics, as well as sequencing for rare diseases, oncology and pathogens.

About NATIONAL CENTER OF GENETICS

The NCG at the LNS has approximately 45 employees and is subdivided into three services:

1) Clinical Genetics Service, 2) Hemato-Oncogenetics-Cytogenetics Service, 3) Molecular Genetics Service

The Hemato-Oncogenetics and Cytogenetics team is involved in pre- and postnatal diagnosis (constitutional chromosomal aberrations) and hematooncogenetic diagnosis (acquired aberrations) of patients with hematological neoplasia.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated cytogeneticist to join our dynamic team in the Hematooncogenetics-Cytogenetics service. These tasks await you here:

- Supervise and manage a team of laboratory technicians and scientists in cytogenetics.
- Direct the daily operations of the cytogenetic laboratory
- Develop, validate and implement new procedures and techniques
- Interpret and communicate genetic results to physicians and others health professionals.
- Keep up to date with the latest developments and advances in the field
- Ensure compliance with all relevant regulations and guidelines
- Actively participate in the training of medical students, residents and colleagues.
- Participate in the Center's translational research activities.
- Collaborate closely with the other services of the NCG (clinical genetics, molecular genetics and hemato-oncogenetics) and with external partners, in particular healthcare professionals, in order to provide comprehensive patient care and diagnostics of point.
- Represent the NCG at internal and external meetings and conferences as well as in national public health programs and working groups (e.g. the National Rare Disease Program).

Qualifications:

- Medical Doctor certified in medical genetics/cytogenetics, or equivalent
- Eligible to obtain an authorization to practice as a doctor in Luxembourg (Mandatory)

(http://www.sante.public.lu/fr/formulaires/professions/auteuration-exercise-profession-health/index.html)

- At least 5 years of experience in a cytogenetics laboratory (prenatal and postnatal)

- Strong knowledge of (molecular) cytogenetic techniques, including Karyotyping and FISH
- Strong leadership and team management skills
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Strong organizational and problem-solving skills
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
- Work experience in accredited medical laboratory (ISO 15189) is an advantage.
- Strong IT skills, including proficiency in laboratory IT systems (LIMS).
- Advanced English knowledge in spoken and written is required, knowledge of German or French are an advantage

If you meet the above profile and wish to apply, please submit your application (CV and covering letter) via our website. Your application will be treated confidentially.

At the final stages of the recruitment process, the successful candidate will be asked to provide supporting documentation such as, copies of diplomas and certificates of employment. An official criminal record (bulletin no.3) will also be required for consultation purpose.

jobs.description:
Head of International Markets

Permanent contract

At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction - we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our private banking business.

What you will do:

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer Luxembourg, you will define and execute the Bank's international business development and market corridor strategy in Asia, the Middle East, the UK and the US. Working closely with the Business Head and Relationship Managers, you will drive disciplined delivery of Net New Money (NNM) and revenue, while safeguarding segment and book purity and ensuring a consistently strong client experience. You will promote HSBC Private Bank Luxembourg as the Booking Centre of choice for HSBC PB's international clients, seeking diversification in Continental Europe. As a senior member within the Luxembourg Front Office management team, you will also be accountable for governance and risk management processes and provide supervisory oversight of business activities.

In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Own retention and growth of a Luxembourg-based private banking portfolio sourced from key international markets (Asia, Middle East, UK and US).
• Drive deepening across investments, lending and deposits (where applicable), reducing attrition and ensuring appropriate booking governance and book purity for corridor-sourced relationships.
• Run disciplined sales management, including opportunity qualification, pricing/returns focus, and activity standards.
• Establish corridor-to-PBLU portfolio routines (pipeline, attrition watchlist, top-client plans, rebooking/booking exception management).
• Define, refresh and execute the International Markets strategy in close partnership with the Business Heads, including priority client segments, target industries, and value propositions.
• Build and execute PBLU awareness and adoption plan through structured engagement programmes (education series, immersion and exchange visits, regular follow-ups) to deepen understanding of PBLU's platform, offering and capabilities across other HSBC Private Bank booking centres and relevant HSBC lines of business.
• Deliver market financial targets (revenue, margin, profitability, cost-to-serve where applicable), monitor performance drivers (mix, pricing, attrition, productivity), and ensure transparent forecasting by high-quality management information.

You should apply if you have:

• Extensive experience in Private Banking Relationship Management and senior client-facing roles.
• Positive track record in business development and risk management.
• Strong, up-to-date understanding of the market landscape, peer product offering and industry innovation.
• Experience working with clients and teams across Asia, MENA, the UK and the US.
• Demonstrated ability to shape market strategy and multi-year business plans, including footprint/capability design and target setting.
• Strong commercial execution skills, including pipeline management, conversion discipline, pricing/returns focus.
• Strong stakeholder management skills across products, operations, risk, compliance and multiple geographies.
• Fluent English (written and spoken).

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.

What you'll get in return:

The pay range for this role is EUR 155,700 - 233,600.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

If you're looking for a career where you will be respected as an individual and valued for the contributions you make, please visit our career page, and discover how diversity drives our success.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Please note that every selected candidate will have to provide us with a valid criminal record check in due time.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. For any GDPR request, please send it to: lux.data.privacy@hsbc.com

For further information on building your career at HSBC, please visit: www.hsbc.com/careers

jobs.description:

Work Hours 40.0 Hours per Week
Expected Start Date: 01/07/2027

Job Level: Monolevel
Job (internal): Assistant Professor
Role Type: Open Position
Functions: Associate / Assistant Professor
Expertise: Professors



About the FSTM
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in.
Within the FSTM, the Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences (DHML) coordinates all teaching programmes in life in sciences, medicine, nursing, radiology and midwifery. The department's research combines basic and translational, molecular and computational approaches, with a particular focus on cancer biology, while also encompassing clinical research in human health and disease.
The DHML cooperates with the national health care centers and leading international biomedical research institutions. As medicine and health are strategic priorities for the University of Luxembourg, the department is actively expanding its education and research activities in these fields, providing exceptional opportunities for medical and biomedical initiatives.

Your role
The position focuses on innovative, interdisciplinary teaching in public health at the bachelor's level and within health-related specialization programmes. The recruited professor will establish teaching and expertise in areas such as epidemiology, health systems, disease prevention, and health policy.
The successful candidate will lead the development and coordination of public health teaching activities across the University's programmes in medicine, nursing sciences, and midwifery. The role includes the implementation of a state-of-the-art public health curriculum, incorporating advanced educational tools such as digital learning platforms, data-driven health simulations, case-based learning, and interactive policy analysis. Working closely with faculty members and clinical partners, the successful candidate will ensure an integrated and cohesive learning experience for students.

Research Portfolio
The candidate is expected to have an internationally recognised research profile and to bring a coherent research programme in public health. The candidate will develop and lead an ambitious research agenda in areas such as population health, primary care, prevention, health systems, epidemiology, health inequalities, data driven health sciences, and digital health.

Policy and Practice Integration
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in public health research and/or practice, with a commitment to integrating real-world perspectives into education. This will enhance the practical application of public health principles in healthcare and policy contexts. The possibility of maintaining collaborative activities with national health authorities or international organizations may be considered, depending on the candidate's profile and institutional partnerships.

For further information about the role, please contact: Serge Haan, Head of DHML, Email: serge.haan@uni.lu


Your profile
• MD/PhD or PhD in Public Health, Epidemiology, Health Systems, or a closely related field. An MD is considered an asset
• Extensive experience in public health research and/or practice, ideally with a strong track record in population health, primary care, health policy, or health systems analysis
• Substantial teaching experience in public health, epidemiology, or health sciences at undergraduate and/or postgraduate levels, preferably within medical, nursing, or life sciences programs
• Proven commitment to interdisciplinary and innovative teaching, particularly in integrating public health with medicine, life sciences, and nursing

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

• Names, contact information and current position of 3 referees who can, upon request, provide an assessment of the application. Please indicate their relationship to you
We encourage early application. Applications are only accepted online through the HR system. The position will be unposted on 24th September 2026, after which no further applications can be submitted. Applications will be handled in strict confidence.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.

Good technical understanding of Supplier's manufacturing, assembly, logistic processes - be able to evaluate sound of a process even without having a deep technical knowledge. Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and define corrective action.
Ability to apply an analytical, process-oriented approach to solving problems across a variety of situations and activities.
Ownership, accountability, and confidence to take decisions. Be able to ability to work in ambiguity.
Strong project and change management skills.
Hands-on data collection and analysis skills, with a high attention to detail
Ability to work in a fast-changing environment with a willingness to change, flexibility and learning agility.
Excellent problem-solving skills and tenacity to drive the resolution to conclusion.
Understanding of lean principles to enhance quality process design and operations.
Understands the need and benefit of Quality Assurance
Understanding of ISO Quality Management System requirements & business/industry standards
Excellent written and spoken command of English and German, additional languages are a plus.
Audit capabilities, Audit skill & knowledge, good relationship skills
Good understanding of Husky's product design, standards, and manufacturing technologies for a wide range of product types; process engineering can be generic/agnostic of product.
Travel required at Supplier (25%)

jobs.title: Electronics Production Technician
jobs.description:
Work tasks: The role
As an Electronics Production Technician, you will support the assembly, inspection, testing and rework of electronic components and printed circuit boards used in our products and development systems. You will work closely with our engineering team, following technical documentation and testing procedures, identifying faults and recording results accurately. Your work will help ensure that our electronic assemblies meet the required quality and performance standards. This role is suitable for someone with a vocational background or practical experience in electronics who enjoys precise, hands-on work and wants to develop their skills in an advanced engineering environment. Key responsibilities • Assemble electronic components, printed circuit boards and related systems • Inspect incoming PCB assemblies, components and solder joints visually and under a microscope • Perform soldering, cleaning, handling and rework of PCB assemblies • Carry out electrical measurements and functional testing using standard test equipment and dedicated test rigs • Identify faults, perform initial troubleshooting and escalate complex issues to engineers • Read and follow electronic schematics, datasheets, assembly instructions and testing procedures • Prepare cables, connectors and electronic connections • Record inspection, testing and rework results accurately • Maintain the traceability of components and completed work • Monitor electronic component and consumable inventory and communicate replenishment needs • Provide practical feedback and suggest improvements to assembly, testing and work procedures

We offer: What we offer
• A monthly gross salary of €2394–€3724 depending on your experience and skills • Hands-on work with advanced space and optical communication technology • Close cooperation with electronics, embedded software and mechanical engineers • The opportunity to help establish and improve assembly and testing processes as the company grows • Varied work across electronics assembly, inspection, testing, troubleshooting and production support • A small international team where your contribution has a visible impact on the final product Occasional remote work for suitable tasks may be agreed with the hiring manager. The role follows standard business hours in Estonia, with reasonable flexibility in daily starting and finishing times by agreement with the hiring manager.

Other requirements: What we are looking for
Required experience • Vocational education in electronics or equivalent practical experience • Practical experience with electronics assembly and PCB handling • Ability to read electronic schematics, component datasheets and technical instructions • Soldering and PCB rework skills • Ability to use standard electronic test equipment, including multimeters, oscilloscopes and laboratory power supplies • Ability to identify electronic components and understand their markings and package information • Basic fault-finding and troubleshooting skills • A careful, methodical and quality-focused approach • Ability to follow procedures and document work accurately • English at B2 level or above • Willingness to learn new equipment, processes and techniques We welcome applications from both experienced technicians and strong junior candidates with relevant practical skills and a solid foundation in electronics. Nice to have • Experience with surface-mount and through-hole soldering • Experience using hot-air rework equipment • Experience with FBGA rework or reballing • Experience operating pick-and-place or reflow equipment • Experience testing PCB assemblies using dedicated test rigs • Familiarity with IPC workmanship standards or relevant IPC certification • Experience maintaining production, testing or traceability records • Experience with component inventory and production consumables • Previous experience in electronics production, prototyping or a laboratory environment

Option to work from home: No

jobs.title: Lastbilchauffør søges til faste ture med få stops – Høj løn! (Udgangspunkt: Fredericia)
jobs.description:
Post Fyn ApS søger lige nu dygtige lastbilchauffører til vores afdeling i Fredericia.

Som chauffør hos os får du en hverdag præget af faste ture med få stops. Du kender dine ruter, og vi prioriterer et roligt arbejdsmiljø uden stressende bytrafik eller konstante nye leveringsadresser. Det giver dig mulighed for at fokusere på sikker kørsel og overblik.

Du møder ind i Fredericia og kører ud på dine fastlagte ture. Arbejdstiden er fuldtid (5 dage om ugen) med ca. 10 timers effektiv arbejdstid om dagen, planlagt med fornuftige køreplaner og respekt for pauser.

 

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har et gyldigt CE-kørekort.

  • Har erfaring med kørsel med trækker og trailer.

  • Kan kommunikere på enten dansk eller engelsk – både mundtligt og skriftligt (nødvendigt for sikkerhed og kundekontakt).

  • Er ansvarsbevidst, punktlig og kan arbejde selvstændigt.

  • Sætter pris på klare rammer, faste rutiner og et velorganiseret arbejde.

Vi tilbyder

  • Høj løn – vi belønner din erfaring og indsats.

  • Faste ture – du ved, hvad du skal, og hvor du skal hen.

  • Få stops – ingen stressende jagt på mange små adresser.

  • Udgangspunkt fra vores depot i Fredericia.

  • Et stærkt team med fokus på trivsel, godt samarbejde og ordentlige forhold.

  • Et internationalt miljø, hvor vi værdsætter mangfoldighed.

Ansøgning

Er du den stabile og erfarne chauffør, vi mangler i teamet i Fredericia? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV allerede i dag. Vi ser gerne ansøgninger på både dansk og engelsk.

Send din ansøgning til: driftsleder@postfyn.dk Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at ringe til os på 81 81 81 19.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Post Fyn ApS – Professionel transportløsning med personlig touch.

**************************************************************************************************************

Truck Driver Wanted for Fixed Routes with Few Stops – High Salary! (Base: Fredericia)

Post Fyn ApS is currently looking for skilled truck drivers for our department in Fredericia.

As a driver with us, you will experience a workday characterized by fixed routes with few stops. You know your routes, and we prioritize a calm working environment without stressful city traffic or constantly changing delivery addresses. This allows you to focus on safe driving and maintaining an overview.

You will report to our location in Fredericia and drive your predetermined routes. This is a full-time position (5 days a week) with approximately 10 effective working hours per day, planned with sensible schedules and respect for rest breaks.

We expect that you:

  • Hold a valid CE driver’s license

  • Have experience driving with a tractor and trailer

  • Can communicate in either Danish or English – both verbally and in writing (necessary for safety and customer contact)

  • Are responsible, punctual, and able to work independently

  • Appreciate clear frameworks, fixed routines, and well-organized work

We offer:

  • High salary – we reward your experience and effort

  • Fixed routes – you know what you need to do and where you need to go

  • Few stops – no stressful rush to many small addresses

  • Base location at our depot in Fredericia

  • A strong team focused on well-being, good collaboration, and proper working conditions

  • An international environment where we value diversity

Application
Are you the stable and experienced driver we are looking for in our Fredericia team? Then send your application and CV today. We welcome applications in both Danish and English.

Send your application to: driftsleder@postfyn.dk
If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to call us at 81 81 81 19.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Business Development Intern
jobs.description:
About This Role

We’re looking for an Account Manager Intern (4–6 months) who wants to learn modern B2B sales from the inside. The title for this position could also be "Sales Development Representative."

This internship is centered around outbound sales and meeting generation. You will help create pipeline for our senior Account Executives through cold calling, LinkedIn outreach, and email.

From day one, you will be exposed to real sales conversations, real prospects, and real revenue targets.

You’ll start by supporting the sales team and booking meetings, gradually move into joining and learning from sales calls, and eventually run your own meetings and close deals.

This role is ideal if you want hands-on experience in B2B SaaS sales, outbound prospecting, and pipeline management, while working closely with experienced Account Executives.

What You’ll Actually Do

Generate meetings for the sales team through outbound outreach.

You will:

Outbound Prospecting

    Conduct cold calls to decision-makers at target companies.
    Send personalized LinkedIn messages and connection requests.
    Run targeted email outreach sequences.
    Follow up consistently to convert prospects into booked meetings.

Meeting Generation

    Book meetings for senior Account Executives.
    Ensure meetings are well-qualified and relevant.
    Maintain your pipeline and activities in HubSpot.

Sales Learning & Shadowing

    Join meetings run by senior Account Executives.
    Observe how discovery, demos, and closing conversations work.
    Listen to recorded sales calls and provide feedback.

Your end goal: generate a steady flow of meetings and eventually close your own deals.

Your Learning & Onboarding Journey

We follow a structured ramp-up process to help you develop quickly.

Who You Are

Must-haves

    Currently studying or recently graduated in business, sales, marketing, or a related field
    Curious about B2B sales and SaaS
    Comfortable speaking with new people
    Highly motivated and resilient
    Structured and able to manage your own activity
    Strong communication skills in English and Swedish

Nice-to-haves

    Experience in sales, outreach, or customer-facing roles
    Experience with tools like HubSpot or any other CRM system
    Interest in cold calling and outbound sales
    Interest in B2B SaaS and modern GTM strategies

What You’ll Get

At Hey Sid, you won’t just observe sales, you’ll actually do it.

You’ll learn how modern SaaS sales works while contributing directly to pipeline and revenue.

We offer:

    Hands-on experience in B2B SaaS sales
    Direct coaching from experienced Account Executives
    Exposure to real sales meetings and deals
    Access to modern sales and AI tools
    A fast-paced startup environment with steep learning
    The opportunity to transition into a full-time Account Manager role

About Sid

Founded in 2024, Hey Sid is a next-generation, person-targeted advertising platform that helps B2B companies reach decision-makers with precision. We bring together audience identification, creativity, and campaign management into one streamlined flow, ensuring that every ad dollar reaches the right person.

As a young and fast-growing company, we're building an ambitious team that values ownership, creativity, and results. Joining us means the opportunity to have a real impact on both the business and your career growth.

jobs.title: Geotechnical supervisor, Kiruna
jobs.description:
Position Summary

As a Geotechnical Supervisor at Palsatech Sweden, you will be responsible for managing and coordinating daily operations within our Palsacenters, ensuring the efficient delivery of core handling, sample preparation, storage, and support services for mineral exploration and mining projects.

The role combines operational leadership, personnel management, health and safety responsibility, quality control, and customer collaboration and taking part into the actual work. You will lead a team of geotechnicians and serve as the key link between geologists, customers, project stakeholders, and company management.

Your mission is to ensure that all work is carried out safely, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards while maintaining a productive and well-organized working environment.

Key Responsibilities

Operations Management

    Plan, coordinate, and supervise daily activities within the Palsacenter while actively contributing to core handling, sample preparation, and other geotechnical operations.
    Ensure efficient workflow for sample handling, core processing, storage, and related services.
    Allocate personnel, equipment, and work tasks according to project priorities and customer requirements.
    Monitor productivity, quality, and operational performance.
    Ensure projects and customer deliverables are completed accurately and on schedule.
    Maintain facilities, equipment, and work areas in a safe and organized condition.
    Support continuous improvement of operational processes and workflows.

Personnel Management

    Direct management responsibility for geotechnicians and operational personnel.
    Recruit, onboard, train, and develop employees.
    Conduct performance reviews and development discussions.
    Foster a positive, collaborative, and high-performing team culture.
    Provide daily guidance and support to employees.
    Ensure staffing levels and workforce planning align with operational needs.
    Promote skill development and knowledge sharing within the team.

Health, Safety & Environment (HSE)

    Take overall responsibility for workplace safety within the Palsacenter.
    Promote and maintain a strong safety culture across all operations.
    Conduct risk assessments, safety inspections, and toolbox meetings.
    Investigate incidents, near misses, and non-conformities and implement corrective actions.
    Ensure employees have the necessary training, certifications, and personal protective equipment (PPE).
    Ensure compliance with company procedures and applicable regulations.
    Drive continuous improvement in safety, environmental, and quality performance.

Qualifications

Required

    Experience in a supervisory or leadership role within mining, mineral exploration, geology services, logistics, warehousing, production, or a related field.
    Experience managing personnel and coordinating daily operations.
    Organizational and planning skills.
    Good understanding of workplace health and safety practices.
    Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
    Excellent communication and leadership abilities.
    Proficiency in Microsoft Office and operational planning systems.
    Valid driver's license (Category B).
    English, both written and spoken – good/excellent.

Preferred

    Experience working with drill core handling, sample preparation, geological materials, or mining-related operations.
    Technical education or vocational background in geology, mining, engineering, logistics, or a related discipline.
    Experience supervising operational teams in industrial or technical environments.
    Formal health and safety training.
    Experience with quality management systems and process improvement.
    Knowledge of exploration and mining industry workflows.
    Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

Personal Attributes

We are looking for a confident and hands-on leader who enjoys combining operational management with people leadership.

The ideal candidate is:

    A strong communicator and team builder.
    Safety-focused and accountable.
    Structured, organized, and dependable.
    Solution-oriented and proactive.
    Comfortable working in a practical and operational environment.
    Customer-focused and service-minded.
    Able to motivate and develop team members.
    Capable of making decisions and prioritizing effectively under changing conditions.

Success Factors

The successful candidate will:

    Maintain an excellent safety record within the Palsacenter.
    Ensure all customer work is delivered on time and to the required quality standards.
    Build and retain a motivated and capable geotechnical team.
    Maintain efficient workflows and resource utilization.
    Deliver high levels of customer satisfaction.
    Drive continuous improvement in operational performance and quality.
    Contribute to the continued growth and success of Palsatech Sweden.

jobs.description:
Editorâs Note: The following piece, by the late, great Herman Holtz, was to appear as part of Hermanâs âHindsights & Insightsâ column. It is part of our collection of âclassicsââarticles that stand the test of time no matter how many technologies come and go. Published with permission.

It seems, from what I read every day on the TECHWR-L list, that it isnât at all easy for most people to break into a beginning tech writing job. Of course, that kind of Catch 22âyou need a job to get the experience you need to qualify for the jobâis far from unknown, especially in the high-tech working world. Itâs why prospective employers want to see clips and other evidence that you can write reasonably well, whether it is technical or not, before they will consider you.

I was a tech writer long before I wrote my first book, although I had to jump through some difficult hoops to land my first tech writing job (a series of six tests on technology); however, a great deal of my work later, especially my consulting jobs, came about as a result of my books and the reputation they bestowed on me. Being published between covers brings you respect almost as quickly and surely as becoming known as a millionaire business owner does. Even now, it happens. A reader who owns a small business in Baltimore hired me recently to do some consulting with him, after reading one of my books published a few years ago. The gentleman had read several books on the subject of proposal writing and contracting, and he decided that my book reflected the kind of thinking he needed, although it was one of my most slender volumes.

It is really not that difficult to turn out your first book if you select a subject that you are reasonably familiar with (and so can research efficiently) and plan ahead with a solid and well-thought-out outline. Remember that what you write does not have to be a thick tome. My books have generally run to about 275 to 500 pages, but I have also written my share of books that printed out to fewer than 200 pages.

There Are Many Ways To Get Ideas For Books, And The More You Concentrate On The Need, The More New Ideas You Will Get. Here Are Just a Few Tips

Start reading the periodicals that deal with the subject Probably they will be trade journals and may touch only lightly on the subject, but that is fine. But, how much is there to say about the subject? Is it useful detailâthat is, does a lightly-covered detail justify a book of its own? The book of mine I referred to here is a small book that presents sharply-focused abstracts on what I think to be the most important topics about proposal writingâa subject on which I have written more than one large, detailed book. The little book referred to here is virtually the opposite of expanding an article or two into a book.

Browse libraries and book stores for current books on the subject Would you go about writing a book on the subject entirely differently? Would it be a better book? How? Why? Read books that devote a chapter to the subject. How about developing that chapter into a full book of its own?

Think about what that information might mean to readers and to which readers Will it help someone start or improve their business? Improve their position in some way? Make it easier to learn a given subject?

Think about the need for the information Is the subject a very popular one? Is it on how to be a better golfer, for example? Hard to lose with any good book on golf. The same for many other subjects. There is never an end to new books about the Civil War, even if you call it The War Between the States. But if you want your first book (I hope that it will be only your first) to help your business career, it is best to choose a serious business subject or other how-to book.

Finally, remember that you donât have to write the book in a day. Do a few pages each day, and you will be surprised at how soon you have a book.

jobs.title: This IS Your Dream Job
jobs.description:
Here are two questions to ask yourself: 1) when are you most content? (Not âhappyâ per se, since happy moments are fleeting. 2) Does contentment ever happen for you during the workday?

The average American worker spends 2080 hours per year on paid work. Over 30 years, that adds up to 62,400 hours. Thatâs a LOT of time to spend doing something you donât like doing.

Research also shows that people will change careers at least 7 times during their lifetime. However, career changes arenât always drastic â you can change the focus of your daily work activity without changing jobs. Sometimes incremental shiftsâsmall changes in what you do and how you do itâare the best and most satisfying way to land that dream job

The key is to concentrate on ways to shift paid job duties into activities that give you that feeling of contentment.

Grab a Sheet Of Paper And a Pencilâor Open Up Your Favorite Word Processor And Work Through The Following Steps To Come Up With Your Own Action Plan To Realize Your Dream Job

STEP 1: Think about your current job â make a list of the tasks that comprise your job. Highlight the ones you most enjoy performing in your job. Note the ones you canât stand

STEP 2: Make a list of activities youâve done in the past that you are most proud of, and that you got the most satisfaction from. These can come from previous jobs, volunteer activities, school work, or hobbies. If you loved laying out the college newspaper, but hated the organizational aspects such as chasing people down to get their content in on time, then that tells you something about the types of activities that work for you.

STEP 3: Envision your ideal job â and list the tasks that it would encompass. What basic skills involved in your ideal job could start working on today? This could be something simple â if your ideal job is to be in charge of all written communication for your organization, an area you could start working on immediately is your writing skills. Even if your current writing skills are pretty good, there is always room to work towards a higher level of achievement.

STEP 4: Now take the list of tasks and activities from steps 1 & 2 above, along with the list of skills from step 3, and group them into functions related to your job that you could concentrate on. (For example, if you are a financial analyst, but you find the grind of financial reports tedious, but you love creating charts and graphs and putting together presentations that visually demonstrate trends â your tasks and activities list could include âcreating graphs & chartsâ, and one skill that could be on your list is âEnhance MS Excel charting & graphing skillsâ.

STEP 5: Conduct some research into the training available out there that would help you to enhance the skills you outlined in step 3. This could involve a number of options â anything from volunteering with an organization in a capacity where you could practice your skills, to taking webinars, intensive workshops, certificate programs, or working toward a degree.

STEP 6: Using the information you gathered in step 5 above, get started with the training program(s) that will meet your individual needs. Remember that you can start small and fine-tune your training plan as you go along. You can also mix and match various training components â it doesnât have to be a straight path, as long as it gets you to where you want to go. Get involved with online forums and interest groups that will help you learn more about the latest techniques in your area of interest. As you spend more time learning and practicing, your skills will improve.

Never underestimate the value of volunteering without asking for additional compensationâ¦your boss and superiors will be impressed that you are interested enough to take on a project without asking for something in return. Showcase your best efforts by volunteering to work on projects that will give you a chance to demonstrate your expertise.

Land Mines to Avoid

Being your own worst enemy â downplaying your talents wonât get you noticed or into consideration for that great new project. Toot your own horn and let others know that you are good at xyz (in the example above, creating charts and graphs). Just as important, offer to help others with that task â soon you will become the resident expert, the one that others turn to for help and advice on this topic

Being finished with learning â remember learning doesnât stop because you have that framed diploma. Keep taking courses, attending seminars and staying in touch with others in your field so that you stay at the leading edge of knowledge and practice in your area of interest

Getting stuck in a rut â Sometimes it seems easier to lay low and just plod along. But you canât stay still â keep looking for new opportunities to apply your talents and showcase them in new and interesting ways.

Decide what you like (and what you donât), do your homework, work hard at new opportunities and advertise the resultsâbefore you know it, youâll be living your dream job.

Contributor: Julie Clarke, Vancouver Island University (www.pr.viu.ca/techcomm)

jobs.title: Animal Care Manager
jobs.description:
The Beluga Operating Company ehf is seeking an animal care manager.

What you'll bring to the team
Lead the Future of Beluga Whale Conservation
Imagine waking up each day knowing your work is helping shape the future of one of the world's most unique marine conservation projects.



At the SEA LIFE TRUST Beluga Whale Sanctuary, you'll lead an experienced team dedicated to providing world-class care for Little Grey and Little White, our resident belugas, while also overseeing the welfare of rescued puffins and our aquarium collection.



This is far more than an animal care management role. It's an opportunity to combine exceptional leadership, animal welfare expertise and conservation passion at the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.

If you're an inspiring leader with extensive experience working with cetaceans or large marine mammals, we'd love to hear from you.



As our Animal Care Manager (Curator), you'll lead all aspects of animal care, welfare and husbandry across the sanctuary.



Working closely with the General Manager and the wider SEA LIFE TRUST and Merlin Entertainments teams, you'll ensure our animals receive exceptional care while supporting scientific research, conservation, education and unforgettable guest experiences.



You'll lead, coach and develop a passionate team of animal care professionals whilst ensuring the highest standards of welfare, safety and operational excellence.

What You'll Be Doing
Leading World-Class Animal Care
Lead the care, health and welfare of our resident beluga whales, puffins and aquarium animals.
Oversee animal husbandry, enrichment, operant conditioning and behavioural management.
Ensure excellent standards across all animal habitats and life support systems.
Drive continual improvements in animal welfare and husbandry practices.
Leading and Developing People
Inspire, coach and develop a highly skilled animal care team.
Create a culture of collaboration, continuous learning and professional development.
Provide leadership during day-to-day operations and emergency response situations.
Ensure clear performance expectations and high professional standards.
Conservation & Collaboration
Work alongside veterinarians, conservation partners, researchers and animal welfare specialists.
Provide expert advice to the SEA LIFE TRUST, Merlin Entertainments and external stakeholders on cetacean care.
Support ongoing conservation programmes and future sanctuary developments.
Operational Excellence
Manage departmental budgets, veterinary services and critical animal care resources.
Ensure compliance with animal welfare legislation, licensing requirements and health & safety standards.
Oversee record keeping, husbandry documentation and life support operations.
Participate in the animal care call-out rota.
Inspiring Others
Help bring conservation to life by engaging with guests, media and local communities.
Support educational programmes and public awareness initiatives.
Act as an ambassador for the SEA LIFE TRUST and our conservation mission.
Qualifications & Experience
We're looking for someone who combines exceptional technical expertise with outstanding leadership.

You'll ideally have:

Essential
At least 10 years' experience working within a cetacean, aquarium or zoological environment, including significant leadership experience.
Extensive knowledge of marine mammal behaviour, training and welfare.
Proven experience leading and developing professional animal care teams.
Strong understanding of operant conditioning, enrichment and husbandry.
Excellent communication and decision-making skills.
Strong swimming ability and confidence working in open water.
Ability to work from boats and in challenging marine environments.
Fluent English.
Ability to obtain the legal right to live and work in Iceland.
Desirable
Degree in Zoology, Biology or a related discipline.
Experience with Life Support Systems (LSS).
Drysuit or cold-water diving qualifications.
PADI Rescue Diver (or higher).
Veterinary technical experience.
Bird rehabilitation experience.
First Aid qualification.
Experience handling cetaceans in open-water environments.
Benefits
This isn't just another animal care leadership role.



You'll be joining one of the world's most recognised marine conservation charities and helping shape the future of marine mammal welfare.



You'll have the opportunity to:

Lead the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.
Work with internationally respected animal welfare experts.
Influence global conservation and welfare standards.
Develop and mentor an exceptional animal care team.
Make a genuine difference to the lives of marine animals every single day.
Live and work in the stunning natural surroundings of Iceland.
About the SEA LIFE TRUST
The SEA LIFE TRUST is a global marine conservation charity dedicated to protecting the world's oceans and marine wildlife through conservation, education and campaigning.



Our Beluga Whale Sanctuary in Iceland provides a safe, natural environment for formerly captive beluga whales while inspiring millions of people to care for our oceans.



Together, we're creating a future where marine life can thrive.



If you're an experienced animal care leader who shares our passion for conservation, welfare and exceptional animal care, we'd love to hear from you.


Apply today and help shape the future of marine conservation.
