jobs.title: Open applications for Chief Engineer
jobs.employer: THE QRILL COMPANY AS AVD ÅLESUND
jobs.description:
Aker QRILL Company is a world leader in the sustainable production of krill-based products. We are dedicated to enhancing the nutritional value of feed for aquaculture and livestock and contributing to a more sustainable global food system. Our business has experienced consistent growth within the Aker BioMarine organization. In 2024 we were spun out as a stand-alone entity, and we remain a reputable company in the maritime industry known for a focus on operational excellence. Working with us means you appreciate diversity, are highly skilled within your field and can cope with unexpected situations. You enjoy a fast pace, tolerate quick decisions and continuously ongoing changes. You are a true team player who “chips in” when the situation requires so.

We are now looking for a Chief Engineer who will work on board our vessels in Antarctica

As the Chief Engineer, you will oversee all technical operations within our organization. You will be responsible for leading the engine department, managing projects, and ensuring the efficient operation and maintenance of our equipment and facilities. The ideal candidate will have a strong background as Chief Engineer, exceptional leadership skills, and a proven track record of success in similar roles. Chief Engineer is overall responsible and in charge of all technical installations onboard the vessel, and all R&M and ordering of spare parts for these components as well as responsible for, and being sure costs are held at or below budget.

Other responsibilities will be:

  • Lead and manage the engine department, providing guidance, mentoring, and support to achieve project goals and objectives.

  • Oversee the design, development, and implementation of engineering projects, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.

  • Manage the maintenance and repair of equipment and infrastructure, optimizing efficiency and minimizing downtime.

  • Collaborate with other departments to support company objectives and initiatives.

  • Develop and implement strategies to improve operational performance and reduce costs.

  • Ensure compliance with safety regulations and promote a culture of safety within the engine department.

Your profile

Are you the Chief Engineer we’re looking for?

The right candidate has experience from, preferably, other shipping or fishing companies. You are structured and systematic yet flexible and responsive. You have a positive, can-do attitude and manage to roll up your sleeves with the motivation to respond in a 24/7/365 operation.

Qualifications:

  • Engineer Officer Class 1, CoC M1.

  • Medical Certificate

  • Safety Course for officers

  • At least 5 years of experience in role as Chief Engineer.

  • Strong leadership and management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate a team.

  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and analytical skills.

  • Proficient in project management software and tools.

  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry best practices.

  • Effective communication skills, both verbal and written.


Location: Vessel/Antarctica


Application and contact information

Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? Please don't hesitate to apply as we will be contacting candidates on an ongoing basis. 

Please send your application letter and CV in either English or Norwegian via the application link.


About Aker QRILL Company:

We develop ingredients for use in the aquaculture and animal feed markets, as well as deliver raw materials for production of human health supplements. Our value chain stretches from our vessels and sustainable krill harvesting operations in Antarctica, through our logistics hub in Montevideo, and all the way to customers around the world.

The Company operates a fleet of five vessels, including two cargo vessel and three fishing vessels, leading krill fishing within the Antarctic region. The three fishing vessels operate on the fishing grounds year-round, except for one month in October, which is dedicated to maintenance and repairs while the cargo vessel transports products and crew to and from the fishing grounds throughout the year.

Our offices are located in Fornebu and Ålesund, with the logistics base and product warehouse in Montevideo, Uruguay. We are about 500 employees globally, of which about 430 work on board our krill vessels in Antarctica. We are a diverse company with more than 25 nationalities, spread across all time zones and most continents. Together, we form an international, high performing, diverse and fun work environment.

Working with us means you appreciate diversity, are highly skilled within your field and can cope with unexpected situations. You enjoy a fast pace, tolerate quick decisions and continuously ongoing changes. You are a true team player who “chips in” when the situation requires so.

QRILL™ Aqua is a functional feed ingredient for shrimp, marine fish, and salmonids, increasing productivity in aquaculture - through improved growth, health and quality.

QRILL™ Pet is a functional ingredient for pet nutrition with documented health benefits for companion animals. Proven in numerous studies to benefit pet health, the omega-3s help maintain the health of the heart, kidneys, liver, joints, brain, eyes, skin and coat.

Why should you be part of our team?

You can expect hard work and a lot of fun and challenges. In return we promise you will be part of an exciting journey. If you show initiative and desire for more responsibility, we will give it to you and support you along the way. We strongly believe that our team of people want to do their best. All in the spirit of being the leading company in our industry and always striving to raise the bar.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We are the world’s leading krill company, delivering premium ingredients for human and animal nutrition. Aker QRILL Company is an Antarctic krill-harvesting company dedicated to improving health across species. We develop krill-based ingredients for nutraceutical, aquaculture, and animal feed applications, backed by rigorous science and research into krill’s benefits. Sustainability is at the core of our operations, rooted in world-class standards.

Primary location:
KRISTIINANKAUPUNKI

MYYJÄ S-market KristiinankaupunkiIhan tavallisia töitä merellisessä pikkukaupungissa.
Kristiinankaupunki tunnetaan viehättävästä puutalokaupungistaan, merellisestä tunnelmastaan ja kiireettömästä elämäntyylistään. Täällä työ ja vapaa-aika kulkevat luontevasti rinnakkain.

S-market Kristiinankaupungissa etsimme nyt myyjää vakituiseen työsuhteeseen, jossa työtunteja on vähintään 20 tuntia viikossa. Työsuhde alkaa joustavasti niin pian kuin mahdollista. Myyjän työ koostuu monipuolisista kaupan tehtävistä: asiakaspalvelusta, kassatyöstä, hyllytyksestä, kuorman purusta ja esillepanojen rakentamisesta. Meillä tehdään ihan tavallisia töitä epätavallisen mukavassa työporukassa.

Eepeellä uskomme, että tavallinen työ voi olla parhaimmillaan todella merkityksellistä, kun ympärillä on hyvät työkaverit, toimiva arki ja mahdollisuus kehittyä. Meillä et jää yksin. Kristiinankaupungin S-marketissa työtä tehdään yhdessä, autetaan työkaveria kiireessä ja iloitaan onnistumisista porukalla. Päivät ovat vaihtelevia, ja työssä pääset kohtaamaan ihmisiä sekä vaikuttamaan siihen, että asiakkaidemme arki sujuu mahdollisimman helposti ja mukavasti.

Odotamme sinulta:
Myyjän työssä tarvitaan positiivista asiakaspalveluasennetta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja reipasta oma-aloitteisuutta. Aikaisempi kokemus kaupanalan tehtävistä on plussaa, mutta positiivinen asenne ja aito halu tehdä asiakaspalvelutyötä ovat tehtävässä menestyäksesi kaikkein tärkeintä.

Erityisen hyvät henkilöstöedut! Miltä kuulostaisi -25 % alennus S-ryhmän ravintoloista? Tai henksuhintainen hotellihuone viikonlopuksi? Suomen parhaimmiksikin kutsutuista S-ryhmän ja Eepeen henkilöstöeduista voit lukea esimakuatäältä.

jobs.title: GTM Recruiter, EMEA
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Notion EMEA Recruiting team acts as trusted business partners who craft a thorough, inclusive, and curated interviewing experience. We believe hiring exceptional talent, at the right time, is the best path forward to achieve our company’s ambitious goals.

We’re looking for a Go-to-Market Recruiter to support our growth across key Go-to-Market (GTM) teams in EMEA, with an emphasis on Sales. In this role, you'll help shape our recruiting strategy, manage full-cycle hiring efforts, and ensure a delightful yet rigorous hiring process.

We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Serve as a trusted recruiting partner to leaders across the GTM org, owning the full recruiting lifecycle from sourcing through successful close

 - Design and implement creative sourcing strategies to attract diverse top talent across EMEA markets

 - Ensure scalable and structured hiring plans with consistent evaluation processes while creating thoughtful candidate experiences

 - Partner with cross-functional teams including Total Rewards, People Operations, and People Partners to drive holistic talent strategies

 - Leverage AI tools, to innovate recruiting processes and provide data-driven insights on market conditions

 - Champion and scale best practices while thoughtfully adapting for regional nuances




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in high-growth, technical, GTM functions

 - Proven track record of identifying, qualifying, and closing exceptional talent across various levels

 - Experience coaching and advising hiring managers through our recruiting process while keeping talent density as a priority

 - Ability to build diverse candidate pipelines and guide hiring managers in creating inclusive teams

 - Outstanding communication, attention to detail, and interpersonal skills with a commitment to delivering high-quality recruiting experiences

 - Ability to thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Passionate about leveraging technology and AI to transform recruiting processes

 - Fluency in an additional European language



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion

 - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the commercial opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals

 - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system

 - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 3+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working

 - Native level Japanese, business level English




NICE TO HAVES

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale

Kvalitetsbevidst og ansvarsfuld trykkerimedhjælper til Grafiket A/S i Kolding

Har du erfaring eller interesse for at arbejde indenfor grafisk produktion og søger du en ny arbejdsdag med moderne produktionsudstyr, kvalitet i fokus og gode kollegiale relationer? Så har du nu muligheden for at blive en del af en solid virksomhed med høj anciennitet, stærkt sammenhold og fokus på et godt arbejdsmiljø.

Som trykkerimedhjælper hos Grafiket i Kolding vil dine primære arbejdsopgaver omfatte:

  • Betjening og overvågning af en flexo skæremaskine i den daglige produktion.

  • Klargøring af materialer samt sikring af korrekt opsætning af maskinen.

  • Løbende kvalitetskontrol af emner og justering af produktionen efter behov.

  • Pakke- og emballeringsopgaver i forbindelse med de færdige produkter.

  • Supportopgaver relateret til flexo-produktionen, herunder hjælp til omstilling, klargøring og optimering af produktionsprocesser.

Vi forestiller os, at du har : 

  • Teknisk erfaring er ønskeligt, men ikke et krav, da maskinen er forholdsvis nem at betjene, og der vil være god oplæring.

  • Jobbet kræver en god fysik i forhold til at håndtere og pakke ruller med etiketter.

  • Det er vigtigt, at man har god kvalitets- og ordenssans.

  • Jobbet kræver godt overblik, og gerne erfaring med computer/IT.

  • Gerne fleksibel ift. varierende opgaver, og god til at holde sig selv i gang.

  • Pligtopfyldende og loyal.

  • Mødestabil og fleksibel ift. overarbejde.

  • Godt humør og god energi 

     

Vi tilbyder

  • Et godt job i en velfungerende organisation, hvor teamwork og medarbejder trivsel prioriteres. 
    Der er en flad struktur, velfungerende personaleforening og flere personalegoder. 

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder da vi gerne tilbyder en erhvervsuddannelsesaftale for rette person,     som er motiveret for at uddanne sig om grafisk tekniker hos os 

  • Virksomheden tilbyder ordnede ansættelsesforhold med pension, sundhedssikring og fritvalgskonto. Derudover er virksomheden omfattet af overenskomst , hvilket sikrer gode og trygge rammer omkring ansættelsen.

Praktiske oplysninger 

Stillingen er fuldtid. 

Ønskede arbejdstider vil være på daghold, men søger du enten aftenarbejde eller har interesse i at køre på flekshold, så er du også meget velkommen til at søge stillingen.

Daghold :  

Mandag til torsdag fra kl.  10.00-17.30 og fredage fra kl.  8.00-15.00. 

Aftenhold : 
Mandag til torsdag fra kl. 12.30-21.00 ( fredage fri)


Flekshold: Daghold/aftenhold
 


Ønsket tiltrædelse 1. september 2026. Der er tale om et try & hire forløb i 4 måneder med henblik på fastansættelse direkte hos Grafiket A/S umiddelbart efter try/hire ansættelsen.


Søg jobbet
Har ovenstående fanget din interesse, søger du stillingen ved at vedhæfte et opdateret cv og en motiveret ansøgning. Du kan også skrive en kort tekst om dig selv i ansøgningsteksten ovenfor. Temp-Team A/S varetager denne rekruttering og al henvendelse skal gå gennem Temp-Team.
Grundet GDPR modtager vi ikke cv og ansøgning via e-mail.

Temp-Team
Temp-Team A/S er et landsdækkende rekrutterings- og bemandingsbureau. Vi har mere end 45 års erfaring inden for rekrutteringer til faste jobs og vikarløsninger og dækker et bredt udsnit af brancher. Vi har fokus på høj kvalitet og tæt, personlig kontakt til både kandidater og kunder.

Vi er en del af JuhlerGroup – en international koncern.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Computational Nuclear Physics and Reactor Simulations
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in Computational Nuclear Physics and Reactor Simulations at the Department of Physics. The PhD Research Fellow will be part of the Norwegian Nuclear Research Centre (NNRC). 

NNRC is a cross-disciplinary collaboration between Norway’s leading institutions within nuclear physics and nuclear chemistry research: University of Oslo (UiO), Norwegian University of Life Sciences (NMBU), and Institute for Energy Technology (IFE). The Centre addresses major research questions within the nuclear field spanning topics from nuclear properties and medical isotope production to reactor simulations and environmental radiochemistry.

Starting date as soon as possible, preferably before December 1st, 2026.

The fellowship period is three years.

The position may include a fourth year, resulting in a total of 25% of the appointment being dedicated to other career-development activities, normally teaching and/or supervision. This is determined based on the department’s needs and the candidate’s qualifications.”

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo. 


Project description/work tasks

The Nuclear Physics group at UiO is involved in several research themes within the Norwegian Nuclear Research Centre (NNRC), from fundamental research within nuclear properties and nuclear fission, to more applied research within nuclear simulations and radionuclide production and speciation. This PhD Research Fellow will mostly contribute to nuclear simulations (reactor simulations).

The project will include reactor simulations of future reactor systems with a focus on systems relevant for Norway. The objective is to further develop and validate machine-learning surrogate models derived from high-fidelity multiphysics simulations of reactor transients and quantify how surrogate uncertainties propagate through system safety analysis of nuclear installations, using tools such as open simulations platforms.

This research will be part of a larger international collaboration and be a part of the Norwegian Nuclear Research Centre. The candidate is expected to contribute to and partake in activities organised by the Centre.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in physics or nuclear technology, with specialization in nuclear physics or reactor physics
  • Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • A solid background in scientific computing, for example Python

Candidates without a master’s degree have until 1 October 2026 to complete the final exam.

Desired qualifications:

The following qualifications are considered strongly desirable and will be used in the ranking of the candidates:

  • Experience with reactor simulations in for example OpenMC or system codes, like RE-LAP
  • Experience with data analysis techniques 
  • Experience using ML
  • Familiarity with data analysis tools such as ROOT
  • Knowledge of reactor physics and nuclear structure from master-level courses
  • Teaching experience

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 

All candidates and projects will have to undergo a check versus national export, sanctions and security regulations. Candidates may be excluded based on these checks. Primary checkpoints are the Export Control regulation, the Sanctions regulation, and the national security regulation.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently
  • Good communication skills
  • Ability to work in an international research environment

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We can offer you
  • A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter - statement of motivation and research interests
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications)
  • Copies of educational certificates, academic transcript of records and documentation of English proficiency if applicable
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".
Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The research at the Department covers a broad range of subfields within physics and technology: From space research to medical physics. A good proportion of the research is interdisciplinary, and conducted in close cooperation with collaborators in Norway and abroad. Education and teaching are other essential activities. We offer a broad range of courses, and the Department is involved in several study programmes at bachelor’s and master’s level. Some of the best lecturers in Norway are amongst our employees, and we are proud of our prizewinning teaching and learning environment. The Department has 200 employees, of which 50 are permanent scientific positions. On a yearly basis 20 students complete their Ph.D. and 50 finish their M.Sc. degree.

jobs.title: Sairaanhoitaja, Teeritien palvelukoti (kehitysvammaisten aikuisten asumispalvelut)
jobs.description:
Haemme **sairaanhoitajaa Teeritien palvelukotiin Lieksaan** määräaikaiseen (6 kk) työsuhteeseen.

**Tehtäväsi**

Yhtenä hetkenä huolehdit lääkehoidosta, toisena suunnittelet retkeä tai lähdet asukkaan kanssa kauppaan. Teeritien palvelukodissa sairaanhoitajan työ yhdistää sairaanhoidollisen osaamisen, ohjaustyön ja asukkaiden rinnalla kulkemisen.

Teeritie on koti 18 aikuiselle, jotka tarvitsevat jokapäiväisessä elämässään ohjausta, tukea ja huolenpitoa. Teeritiellä asuu esimerkiksi kehitysvammaisia ja autismikirjon henkilöitä, joiden tuen tarpeet vaihtelevat yksilöllisesti. Meillä koti on koti – asukkaidensa näköinen paikka, jossa jokaisen persoona, kiinnostuksen kohteet ja elämäntapa näkyvät. Rakennamme yhdessä merkityksellistä arkea, jonka perustana ovat osallisuus, turvallisuus ja kunnioittava kohtaaminen.

Sairaanhoitajana olet osa tiimiä, joka mahdollistaa asukkaiden oman näköisen elämän heidän toiveidensa, tarpeidensa ja valintojensa mukaisesti. Pääset hyödyntämään osaamistasi monipuolisesti ja tukemaan asukkaita kokonaisvaltaisesti terveydessä, hyvinvoinnissa ja päivittäisessä arjessa.

**Tehtäviisi kuuluu mm.:**

- lääkehoidon kokonaisvastuu ja lääkehoidon turvallisen toteutumisen varmistaminen


- pienet sairaanhoidolliset toimenpiteet


- asukkaiden hyvinvoinnin seuranta ja terveyden edistäminen


- yhteistyö läheisten, hyvinvointialueen ammattilaisten ja muun verkoston kanssa


- arjen suunnittelu ja toteuttaminen yhdessä tiimin ja asukkaiden kanssa; esimerkiksi liikkumista, leivontaa ja retkiä


- asukkaiden ohjaaminen ja auttaminen päivittäisissä askareissa, kuten kodinhoidossa, kaupassa asioinnissa ja ulkoilussa.


**Odotamme sinulta**

- sairaanhoitajan tutkintoa ja Valvira-rekisteröintiä


- voimassa olevia lääkelupia (LOVe, LOP+PKV)

jobs.title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project: The Molecular Endocrinology Department (KMEB), Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD scholarship
jobs.description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project:

The Molecular Endocrinology Department (KMEB), Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD scholarship for a highly motivated candidate interested in working at the intersection of cancer biology and endocrinology. The project aims to investigate stanniocalcin-2 (STC2) as a key mediator of adipose tissue–tumor crosstalk in obesity-related cancer.

The project is part of a larger collaborative research initiative, the Molecular Mechanisms Linking Obesity and Cancer (MMLOC) network, funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation. Though this grant, 2/3 of the PhD salary has been secured.

Employment is therefore conditional upon the successful enrolment of the candidate as a PhD student at the PhD School at Faculty of Health Sciences, and the awarding of a one-year Faculty Scholarship. 

 

Research environment

The PhD project will be anchored at KMEB, a research unit focused on clinical and translational endocrinology, under the supervision of Associate Professor Rikke Hjortebjerg and Professor Jan Frystyk. The project will be conducted in close collaboration with the laboratory of co-supervisor Professor Henrik Ditzel, Cancer and Inflammation Research Unit, Department of Molecular Medicine, SDU. 

The candidate will work across two complementary research groups with access to state-of-the-art research facilities. Together, the groups provide a multidisciplinary research environment with close integration of clinical and experimental research. The teams are internationally oriented and offer a supportive and inclusive research culture.

You can read more about KMEB here: https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/kmeb

 

Project description

Our research centers around the insulin-like growth factor (IGF) system, a key hormonal regulator in several diseases. The project focuses on stanniocalcin-2 (STC2), an IGF system member that is linked to poor outcomes in most obesity-related cancers but paradoxically predicts favorable prognosis in postmenopausal estrogen receptor-positive (ER+) breast cancer. 

The aim is to examine how STC2 effects are modulated by obesity and estrogen signaling and how it regulates IGF-2/insulin receptor pathways in the tumor–adipose microenvironment. To establish clinically relevant models, the candidate will generate patient-derived xenograft (PDX) mouse models with human tumor tissue and participate in establishing patient-derived organoids and 3D co-cultures. These systems will be interrogated using genetically engineered STC2 and PAPP-A variants and analyzed with advanced sequencing, spatial, and single-cell omics.

The PhD student will:

  • Establish and analyze PDX mouse models of ER+ breast cancer.

  • Sample and process tumor and tumor-adjacent/distant adipose tissue from breast cancer patients.

  • Assess STC2 activity, IGF-2 signaling, and tumor growth under estrogen-controlled conditions.

  • Help analyze molecular data generated through sequencing and omics-based approaches.

 

Qualifications

The applicant should possess the following qualifications:

  • A master’s degree (MSc or equivalent) in molecular biology, biomedicine, or related fields. 

  • Preferably prior experience with endocrinology or cancer research. 

  • An interest in working with animal models (mice) is a necessity.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

  • A motivated, independent, and quality-oriented approach to research, with enthusiasm for learning new scientific disciplines and methodologies.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:
Rikke Hjortebjerg

KMEB, Department of Clinical Research

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

E-mail: rhjortebjerg@health.sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• At letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)


Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. This also applies to reference letters.

 

Closing date September 1, 2026

Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order)

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Fuldtid - Vicevært? Flyttesynstekniker? Handy-person?
jobs.description:
Din titel er ikke afgørende for os. Bare du har hænderne skruet rigtig på og lysten til at blive en del af en virksomhed, hvor vi har tendens til at blive hængende på holdet i lang tid.

Da vi skal starte nye ejendomme op i og omkring Ålborg, så søger vi et team af nye viceværter. Vi forventer at vi skal bruge 1 på fuldtid og 2 på deltid.

Denne her stilling er fuldtid, med mulighed for fleksible arbejdstider, men vi hører gerne til dine forventninger og ser om vi kan få det til at gå op med resten af teamet.

Det er vigtigt at du i din ansøgning oplyser, at den stilling du søger er fuldtid.

Hvem er du og hvorfor passer du ind hos os?
Det går du fordi, du er:

Servicemindet - du nyder en hverdag, hvor din primære opgave er at sikre en god oplevelse for beborerne.

Handy - måske selvlært eller fordi du har en teknisk uddannelse, men du kan løse de fleste udbedringer i lejemålene og på ejendommene selv, som fx udskiftning af blandingsbatterier, kontrol af gulvvarmeanlæg, justering af skabslåger, mm. De ting du ikke har prøvet før, kan du gennemgå med en kollega, så du er godt klædt på til at klare det selv næste gang.

Struktureret og har styr på dine aftaler. Vi sætter stor værdi i at holde, hvad vi lover hinanden og vores kunder.

Motiveret af et fleksibelt arbejdsliv. Du bestemmer selv, om din arbejdsdag starter kl. 8 eller kl. 10 – bare opgaverne bliver løst med høj kvalitet og til tiden.

Hvem er vi og hvorfor er vi sjove at arbejde hos?
Vi er en professionel leverandør af ejendomsservice og vores kunder er udlejningsejendomme, ejerforeninger og lignende. Vi vækster og har netop vundet vores 3. gazelle. Det betyder, at der på sigt kan være mulighed for flere timer eller mere ansvar, hvis det er noget, du ønsker.

Vi har tillid til hinanden og opbakning fra vores chef.

Det betyder, at vi arbejder selvstændigt med vores egne opgaver og at vi altid kan spørge om hjælp, når vi har brug for det.

Vi er uformelle og møder hinanden og vores kunder i øjenhøjde. Samtidig tager vi naturligvis ansvar for vores opgaver og sikrer, at vi løser tingene godt.

Hvad er det så for nogle opgaver, som du kan være med til løse hos os?

Arbejdsopgaverne
•   Pasning og renholdelse af ejendomme
•   Udførelse af ind-/fraflytningssyn
•   Håndtering af lejerhenvendelser og udbedring af ting i lejemålene
•   Evt. pasning af mindre grønne områder, så som græsslåning
•   Andre viceværtsrelevante opgaver

Det med småt

Bil: Da stilling er fuldtid, stiller vi en firmabil til rådighed.

Vi tilbyder dig firmatelefon, tablet og et kollegialt fællesskab med høj trivsel.

Derudover kan du selv frem til en opstart, hvor du bliver klædt på af dine kolleger - som du også lærer at kende til de sociale arrangementer, som vi holder i løbet af året.

Du skal forvente at løse opgaver primært i og omkring Ålborg og Nørresundby. Da vi har kunder i hele Midtjylland, kan der også være behov for at hjælpe kolleger i nogle af de andre midtjyske byer. 

Opstart: Vi søger en profil til opstart i løbet af september, så vi er klar til at vi overtager pasningen af ejendommene til d. 1 oktober. Arbejdstiden i september kan dog være varierende.

Vi holder samtalerne løbende, så tøv ikke med at tage fat i os allerede i dag.

Vil du med?
Lyder det som noget for dig, så send dit CV til andreas@dalboege.com. Du er også meget velkommen til at skrive med eventuelle spørgsmål eller læse mere om os på dalbøgesejendomsservice.dk.

Vi inviterer løbende til samtaler og lukker stillingsopslaget, når vi har fundet det rette match.

OUR COMPANY
Eurostyle Systems is a GMD Group Branch providing design, development and production of innovative interior and exterior solutions for the automotive industry.
With 15 production plants and 4 technical centers, we are 3,200 employees in 11 countries, generating 440 million euros in turnover.
Since 1964, we have built a long, trustful relationship with our customers

OUR PLANT
At Eurostyle Systems Tech Center France, our team of 200 employees harmoniously combines the expertise of an advanced Tech Center with the operational robustess of central functions. Our Technical center teams are dedicated to research, development, and testing for all units in plastics and leather. Our central functions, the cornerstone for all our teams, demonstrate daily courage and adaptability. Eurostyle Systems Tech Center France is where innovation and efficiency converge to create excellence.

JOB / MISSIONS
Under the hierarchical responsibility of the SAP Manager, you will be responsible to structure and provide efficient SAP processes for Business managers (Branch, Plant, Technical Center) for Logistics.

Your main missions will be to:
- Manage Branch & sites SAP projects & new IS business features (from business case design - Go live - to integration testing) in cooperation with key-user, external partners, developers.
- Collects, analyses and validate functional needs - SAP to ensure functional & technical consistency between standards and local integration (Cyclade, Modulo,QUYNSIS, FACTORS,EXPENSYA.)
- Ensure succesful integration of SAP process (MM, WM, PP, SD, PS, Fi-CO) & applications within plants & Tech Center
- Ensure level 1 - level 2 support to business users (incl. Authorization profiles & access)
- Monitor SAP Systems functional errors and pilot implementation of new solutions
- Exchange and capitalize best practices for SAP processes maintenance
- Create end user documentation & perform training

PROFILE
You have several years' experience in SAP related to international business, especially on FI-CO modules fully integrated with other functional modules (PS, MM, PP, SD) and a strong technical experience on customizing & SAP tools. You are customer oriented, proactive and you know how to react quickly. You want to have the opportunity to diversify your skills on other SAP modules. Your English level is B2.

jobs.title: Kunnossapitoasentaja
jobs.description:
**Etsitkö työtä, jossa näkyy kädenjälkesi? Haemme sinua**

**Kunnossapitoasentaja**

**Lappeenrannan leipomolle vakituiseen työsuhteeseen**

Kunnossapitoasentajana työskentelet Lappeenrannan leipomon tuotantolaitteiden parissa monipuolisissa mekaanisissa asennus- ja kunnossapitotehtävissä. Olet osa tehtaan omaa seitsemän henkilön kunnossapitotiimiä. Tehtävät pitävät sisällään teollisen leipomon tuotantolinjojen teknistä ylläpitoa ja vianselvitystä, ennakkohuoltoja sekä muutos- ja perusparannustöitä. Työssä on vastuuta ja vapautta sopivassa suhteessa.

Työtä tehdään kolmessa vuorossa: aamuvuorossa klo 06–14, iltavuorossa klo 14–22 sekä yövuorossa klo 22–06. Tehtävä on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen (40 h/vko).

**Miksi Fazer Leipomot?**

Meillä kaikki alkaa ihmisistä. Olet osa kannustavaa ja lämminhenkistä työyhteisöä, jossa työkaverit jakavat osaamistaan ja oppivat toisiltaan. Vuosittain tekemämme henkilöstökyselyn mukaan kunnossapito-osasto koetaan reiluksi työyhteisöksi, jossa viihdytään hyvin. Kunnossapitoasentajana sinulle tarjoutuu mahdollisuus kasvattaa omaa osaamistasi mukavassa ja kannustavassa tiimissä. Työ on itsenäistä ja vaihtelevaa, eikä yksikään päivä ole samanlainen.

Me Fazerilla haluamme luoda monimuotoisuuden ja osallisuuden kulttuurin sekä tarjota tasavertaisen työyhteisön, jossa kaikkia työntekijöitä kunnioitetaan ja jossa työympäristö koetaan motivoivaksi ja turvalliseksi.

**Palkkaus**

Tehtävä kuuluu leipomoiden työntekijöitä koskeva työehtosopimuksen piiriin. Aloituspalkka tehtävässä on 2150 € – 3050 € / kk riippuen valitun henkilön koulutuksesta ja aiemmasta alan työkokemuksesta. Peruspalkan lisäksi maksamme erilaisia lisiä, esimerkiksi iltavuorolisää 1,91 € – 2,46 € / h ja yövuorolisää 13,99 € – 20,58 € / h.

Tehtävässä on mahdollisuus liiketoimintakohtaiseen tuotannon tulospalkkioon, jonka tavoitetaso on 74senttiä / h (rakenne ja ehdot määritellään vuosittain).

Tarjoamme lisäksi monipuolisia etuja, kuten esimerkiksialennuksia Fazerin tuotteista sekä etuja hyvinvointiin, kuten Epassin.

**Mitä toivomme sinun tuovan tiimiin?**

Sinulla on aikaisempaa kokemusta kunnossapidon työtehtävistä sekä tekniikan alan koulutus. Eduksi tehtävässä katsomme leipomokoneiden tuntemuksen, sähkö-/automaatio-osaamisen sekä mekaanisen kunnossapidon osaamisen. Lisäksi edellytämme valmiutta työskennellä vuorotyössä.

Kokemusta tärkeämpää meille on kuitenkin aktiivinen ja oma-aloitteinen työote sekä motivaatio uuden oppimiseen. Sinut tunnetaan mukavana työkaverina, ja nautit onnistumisista. Positiivinen asenteesi säilyy myös tiukoissa tilanteissa. Toimit johdonmukaisesti työturvallisuus edellä niin arjessa kuin kiire- ja painetilanteissakin.

**Hae nyt ja tule mukaan tiimiin, joka luo merkityksellisiä hetkiä**

Haku on auki 16.8. saakka. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa leipomon tekninen päällikkö Antti Juha numerosta 040 8443 522 arkisin klo 12–14.

_Ruokaelämyksiin keskittyvänä yrityksenä Fazer mahdollistaa jokaiselle päivän parhaista hetkistä nauttimisen. Missiomme, Ruokaa, jolla on merkitys, rakentuu vankalle, yli130-vuotiaalle perinnöllemme, kuluttajalähtöisyydelle ja innovaatioille kehittäessämme tulevaisuuden ruokaelämyksiä. Lähes 6 000 omistautuneen ammattilaisen voimin keskitymme kuluttajatuotteisiin ja suoraan kuluttajaliiketoimintaamme Pohjois-Euroopassa, minkä lisäksi tuotteitamme viedään yli 40 maahan. Fazer noudattaa liiketoiminnassaan eettisiä ohjeita, jotka pohjautuvat konsernin arvoihin ja YK:n Global Compact -aloitteen periaatteisiin. Fazer-konsernin liikevaihto vuonna 2025 oli 1,2 miljardia euroa._

jobs.title: Researcher bridging immunology, genomics and proteomics (academic-industry collaboration)
jobs.description:
About the position

Applicants are invited to apply for a two-year Researcher position (SKO 1109) in immuno-proteomics (hands-on biology). The position is based at the Department of Immunology, Division of Laboratory Medicine, Institute of Clinical Medicine, University of Oslo.

The position is available from July 2026 with a flexible start date between July and September 2026. It is a full-time role physically based at GSK Vaccines S.r.l. in Siena, Italy, within the MS Structural Biology, Ab Discovery and Immunology unit. Scientific advising and guidance will be provided by Dr. Greiff (Lab for Computational and Systems Immunology, greifflab.org).

The researcher will develop and establish an Ig-seq platform bridging immunoglobulin profiling, B-cell receptor (BCR) repertoire sequencing and serology.


More about the position

The proposed project aims to investigate the polyclonal humoral immune response to a model viral antigen in human samples from pre-exposed individuals. This research integrates advanced techniques, including antigen-specific B-cell sorting, B-cell receptor (BCR) sequencing, and LC-MS/MS-based identification of circulating antigen-specific antibodies. The goal is to link B-cell clonotypes to serum immunoglobulins and resolve functional proteoforms through an immunoproteogenomics approach. The project will involve developing de novo sequencing workflows for antigen-specific antibodies, building proteogenomic pipelines to assemble VH/VL sequences and identify clonotypes. Data will be integrated matching BCR repertoires of PBMCs, tonsil tissue, and matched sera from GSK human biological samples. Computational modeling and machine learning will be essential for antibody identification, epitope prioritization, and cross-cohort comparisons.

The project focuses on deconvoluting pathogen-specific humoral responses to a seasonal viral pathogen by combining paired BCR repertoire sequencing with antigen-resolved LC-MS/MS proteomics. The candidate's responsibilities will encompass the development and analysis of mass spectrometry methods for antibody isolation and characterization, as well as designing and validating multiparameter flow cytometry panels for antigen-specific B-cell and plasma cell identification and sorting. The role demands rigorous data stewardship, collaboration with immunology, proteomics, and bioinformatics teams, primarily at GSK Siena, and contributing to the dissemination of research findings.


Key Duties 
  • BCR library preparation and sequencing workflows,
  • Implementing bioinformatics pipelines for clonotyping, lineage tracing, and proteogenomic integration
  • Performing comparative analyses with published datasets.

 Qualifications

Qualification requirements

  • Appointment to the position of researcher in position code 1109 requires a doctoral degree in Proteomics
  • Hands-on experience with LC-MS/MS method development for proteins/antibodies, including sample prep, instrument setup, and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in Python/R and scientific computing, and reproducible research practices (Git, containers/workflows).
  • Ability to build and run bioinformatic pipelines (de novo peptide sequencing, spectral annotation, FDR control).
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
     

Desired qualifications

  • Expertise in immune receptor immunology (BCR/TCR) and repertoire analytics (clonotyping, lineage tracing, SHM, germline inference).
  • Experience with BCR repertoire analysis (Bulk and/or single cell)
  • Experience with advanced Flow Cytometry and Cell Sorting.
  • Structural biology/protein informatics relevant to antibody-antigen interactions and developability assessment.
  • Experience with complementary fragmentation methods (HCD/ETD/EThcD), intact/middle-down workflows, and disulfide/glycoform mapping.
  • High-performance/parallel computing; familiarity with ML frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow) and benchmarking.
  • Prior experience integrating proteomics and repertoire sequencing (immunoproteogenomics)
     

Personal skills
  • Collaborative, adaptable, and effective in an interdisciplinary, ambitious environment.
  • Independent, solution-oriented, and organised; strong scientific rigor and documentation practices
     

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

 

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A scientifically rich, interdisciplinary and international environment at GSK Siena with access to state-of-the-art proteomics and flow cytometry facilities.
  • Advising and mentorship by Prof. Victor Greiff; opportunities for collaboration across immunology, proteomics, and computational teams.
  • Professional development, training, and conference participation.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 640 000 to 760 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

 

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for the position".

jobs.title: Reactive Technologies: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location:Oulu, Tampere

Application deadline: 16.8.2026

Ready to revolutionize the energy sector? Join Reactive Technologies and drive safer, smarter, and more sustainable energy solutions.

Reactive Technologies is a leader in accurate grid measurement tools and the companys mission is to streamline and accelerate the energy sectors transition to zero-carbon energy.

The company is continuing to expand its services globally across multiple regions, and is therefore looking for a hands-on mid-level **DevOps Engineer** to strengthen the Service Support & DevOps team in Oulu, Finland. The team consists of three DevOps Engineers and three Service Support Specialists.

**What will you be doing?**

As a DevOps Engineer, you will design, build and maintain Reactive Technologies cloud infrastructure and deployment processes. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability, scalability and security of the services while supporting development teams in delivering high-quality solutions. You will work closely with software developers, test automation engineers and service support specialists to continuously improve the cloud platform, automation capabilities and operational processes. Your specific tasks will include:

- Developing, monitoring, maintaining and automating Reactives cloud infrastructure, processes and monitoring systems

- Participating in customer-specific service configuration and deployment activities

- Supporting developers and test automation engineers with cloud-related activities

- Managing and improving AWS environments across multiple regions

- Developing and maintaining Infrastructure-as-Code solutions

- Monitoring system health, performance and availability, as well as investigating and resolving operational issues and incidents

- Enhancing CI/CD and deployment automation pipelines

- Continuously improving automation, reliability, security and scalability across cloud services

- Investigating AI solutions to automate, simplify, and reduce DevOps-related workload


**What kind of person thrives in this role?**

You might be the candidate we are looking for if you have approximately 4 to 5 years of relevant DevOps experience and you are now motivated to contribute to the energy sectors transition to zero-carbon energy. You have strong problem-solving and analytical skills and you want to work at an international scale-up company that that offers opportunities to grow and learn beyond your current role.

We are looking for a positive team player who is willing to collaborate closely with different stakeholders, such as engineering and operations teams to support high-quality service delivery. You are a self-driven individual with the ability to work independently and have a mindset for continuous improvement.

**We hope you have the following:**

- Approximately 4-5 years of relevant experience in DevOps positions

- Experience developing and maintaining AWS cloud infrastructure

- Skills with Terraform, Linux administration, and Docker

- Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, InfluxDB (or other time-series databases), and monitoring & observability tools such as Grafana and/or Prometheus

- Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, scripting and automation (e.g. Python), and Git/GitLab-based development workflows

- Full professional working proficiency in English


**We consider as an asset:**

- AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS DevOps Engineer or similar certification

- Experience with cloud security and infrastructure hardening

- Experience with Kubernetes, ECS or container orchestration technologies

- Knowledge of modern monitoring, observability and reliability engineering practices

- Working proficiency in Finnish


**What Reactive Technologies can offer you:**

- A role in a growing company using cutting-edge technology to enable the global renewable energy transition

- A role, where your skills and insight are truly appreciated

- Opportunities for professional growth and to develop your skills

- A motivated and dynamic work community with flat and agile structure

- Private healthcare with extensive coverage health insurance

- Lunch, sport, culture, and bicycle benefit plus extra holidays according to your service years

- Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and share option scheme


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and permanent position and you will be employed directly by Reactive Technologies. The start time in this position is in September-October 2026. The companys office is located in Oulu, and ideally you could work from there (hybrid). However, we are also open for candidates from the Tampere region, as the company has team members working in Tampere. Please note that we expect you to already have a valid work permit in Finland.

**Ready to join Reactive Technologies mission?**

Please submit your CV and motivation letter (PDF, in English) by 16.8.2026 at the latest via aTalents application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/373333/create/.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email.

We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can familiarize yourself with Reactive Technologies here: https://www.reactive-technologies.com and you can read more about the companys newest funding round (in Finnish) here: _GreenTech-yhtiö Reactive Technologies päättää 31,4 miljoonan dollarin rahoituskierroksen._ For more information about the recruitment process contact aTalents Recruitment Consultant Veera Kokko (044 783 5666, veera.kokko@atalent.fi).

jobs.title: Senior Ecosystem Sales Manager, Japan
Köksmästare till Park Alandia Hotell
jobs.description:
Park Alandia Hotell är ett familjeägt hotell med fokus på laganda, arbetsglädje och service. I hotellet finns vår stilfulla nyrenoverade restaurang med bar och uteservering, konferens- och festvåning samt en härlig bastu- och poolavdelning. Skön livemusik spelas fredag-lördag året om och vår uteservering med ca 90 sittplatser har många soltimmar. Vi är cirka 25 medarbetare året runt och nästan 50 under sommarsäsongen.

Nu satsar vi vidare genom att bygga ett eget mikrobryggeri där vi ska brygga vårt eget öl. Är du köksmästare eller en erfaren kock redo att ta nästa steg? För oss är titeln mindre viktig, det viktigaste är att du vill vara med och utveckla vårt kök. Vi söker därför en engagerad och driven person som vill vara med och utveckla vårt matkoncept framåt. Vi erbjuder en spännande och utvecklande roll.

**Om tjänsten**

Som köksmästare har du det övergripande ansvaret för kökets dagliga drift, kvalitet och utveckling. Du arbetar både operativt i köket och strategiskt med koncept, ekonomi, personal och är en viktig del av företagets ledningsgrupp.

**Dina arbetsuppgifter**

Oavsett om du kommer in som köksmästare eller erfaren kock är du med och sätter nivå, tempo och kvalitet i köket. Du arbetar aktivt med matlagning, förberedelser och service, och är samtidigt med och utvecklar menyer och rätter tillsammans med teamet. Du ansvarar för att leda, planera och schemalägga arbetet i köket samt stötta och utveckla dina kollegor. Du har huvudansvar för: inköp, leverantörskontakter och kostnadskontroll med fokus på att skapa ett lönsamt och välfungerande kök.

Du är med och utvecklar rutiner och arbetssätt för att säkerställa ett effektivt flöde i köket och arbetar enligt gällande hygienkrav och egenkontroll. Tillsammans med restaurangchef och övriga teamet bidrar du till helheten och gästupplevelsen.

**Vi söker dig som**

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet från kök. Du har ett starkt driv och en god ekonomisk förståelse samtidigt som du är strukturerad, lösningsorienterad och flexibel. Du har ett stort intresse för mat, kvalitet och utveckling. Vidare är du kommunikativ och behärskar både svenska och engelska. Framför allt brinner du för att skapa en helhetsupplevelse av hög kvalitet.

**Kvalifikationskrav**

Erfarenhet av köksarbete är ett krav och har du erfarenhet från likvärdiga tjänster är det meriterande.

**Anställning**

Köksmästartjänsten är en fast heltidstjänst. Start enligt överenskommelse, så snart som möjligt.

Lön enligt överenskommelse.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Skicka CV och personligt brev till jobb@parkalandia.com ! Intervjuer kommer ske löpande.

Har du frågor kontakta restaurangchef Lizette Ericsson liz@parkalandia.com eller ring 018-14130.

jobs.description:
Haetaan itsenäistä, reipasta ja uuteen sopeutuvaa lähihoitajaa. Työhösi kuuluu lähihoitajan työtehtävät hoitoringissä, joka sijaitsee Reijolassa (työhönlähtöpaikka siellä hoitoringin vuoroissa) ja kotihoidossa Joensuussa. Noin puolet työajasta on kotihoitoa ja puolet hoitorinkiä. Voit hakea myös pienemmällä työajalla toista roolia esimerkiksi opintojen oheen jos pystyt päivisin tekemään vuoroja!

Kotihoidossa kierrämme asiakkaiden luona aamuvuorossa noin klo 6.30-14.30 ja iltavuorossa 13-21. Alle puolen tunnin käyntejä meillä ei ole olemassakaan. Työhön perehdytetään hyvin. Asiakkaina on ikääntyneiden lisäksi lapsiperheitä ja vammaistyötä. Hoitoringissä tulee olla osaamista kehitysvammatyöstä, peg-ravitsemuksesta ja avointa mieltä oppia muitakin hoitotoimenpiteitä. Avustaminen tapahtuu kotona, työtoiminnassa ja vapaa-ajan menoissa. Työhön perehdytetään hyvin.

Työyhteisömme on aivan ihana! Joustava ja toisiaan tukeva porukka, jolta saat tukea työhösi sitä tarvitessa.

Esimiehet ovat myös arkityössä läsnä. Lähiesimies arkisin 8-16 sinua varten ja päivystävä puhelimen päässä 24/7. Et jää yksin iltavuorossakaan jos neuvoa tarvitset.

Arvostamme sinua ja ammattitaitoasi, hyvinvointisi on meille tärkeää.

jobs.title: Ohjaaja (ammatillinen tukihenkilö, perhetyöntekijä)
jobs.description:
**Haemme ammatillisia tukihenkilöitä ja perhetyöntekijöitä tekemään merkityksellistä työtä lasten, nuorten ja perheiden tueksi Keski-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueella.**

Haluatko tehdä merkityksellistä työtä lasten, nuorten ja perheiden parissa ja samalla kuulua rennon, aidosti välittävän työyhteisön joukkoon? Me Tukiluotsilla etsimme kasvavaan joukkoomme sitoutuneita ja kokeneita tuntityöntekijöitä ammatillisen tukihenkilötoiminnan ja tehostetun perhetyön tehtäviin Keski-Uudenmaan alueelle. (Hyvinkää-Tuusula-Järvenpää-Nurmijärvi-Mäntsälä).

**Keitä me olemme?**

Tukiluotsi on vuonna 2024 perustettu kotimainen sosiaalialan yritys, joka tarjoaa yksilöllisiä ja vaikuttavia lastensuojelun avopalveluita. Toimimme lähellä asiakkaita ja yhteistyössä perheiden, verkostojen ja tilaajien kanssa. Meille on tärkeää tehdä työtä kohdaten asiakkaamme inhimillisesti, ammattitaitoisesti ja asiakaslähtöisesti. Toimitilamme sijaitsee Nurmijärvellä.

**Mitä työ pitää sisällään?**

**Ammatillinen tukihenkilötyö**

Ammatillisen tukihenkilön työssä kuljet 12-17-vuotiaan nuoren rinnalla hänen arjessaan ja autat häntä löytämään omia vahvuuksiaan ja suuntaa tulevaisuuteen. Työ on tavoitteellista ja suunnitelmallista, mutta samalla joustavaa ja nuoren yksilöllisistä tarpeista lähtevää, ja siihen voi sisältyä esimerkiksi harrastuksiin osallistumista, koulunkäynnin tukemista ja yhdessä tekemistä. Tukihenkilönä olet tärkeä turvallinen aikuinen, joka kuuntelee, keskustelee ja tarjoaa nuorelle myönteisiä kokemuksia arjen keskellä.

**Tehostettu perhetyö**

Tehostetussa perhetyössä työskentelet tiiviisti koko perheen kanssa heidän arjessaan ja tuet heitä löytämään uusia voimavaroja ja ratkaisuja. Työ on tavoitteellista ja muutokseen tähtäävää, mutta samalla inhimillistä ja perheen yksilöllisestä tilanteesta lähtevää. Käytännössä se voi tarkoittaa vanhemmuuden tukemista, arjen hallinnan vahvistamista ja perheen sisäisen vuorovaikutuksen kehittämistä. Olet rinnalla kulkeva ammattilainen, joka tarjoaa perheelle apua sekä pienissä arjen asioissa että haastavissa muutosvaiheissa. Työskentelyssä painottuu läheinen yhteistyö perheen verkostojen, kuten koulun, varhaiskasvatuksen ja muiden toimijoiden kanssa. Tärkeintä on, että perhe ei jää yksin vaan saa rinnalleen välittävän ja luotettavan ammattilaisen. Tehostettua perhetyötä tehdään työparin kanssa

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

- Vähintään 2 vuoden työkokemusta lastensuojelutyöstä

- Mahdollisuutta työskentelyyn iltapäivisin / iltapainotteisesti

- Mahdollisuus työskennellä vähintään 20 tuntia viikossa (tuntimäärää voi myös kasvattaa halutessaan)

- Sosiaali- tai terveysalan tutkintoa (esim. sosionomi AMK)

- Oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta (kilometrikorvaus 0,55 €/km)

- Hyvää suomen kielen taitoa (suullinen ja kirjallinen)

- Rikosrekisteriotteen esittäminen (lasten ja nuorten kanssa työskentelyä varten)

- Rekisteröintiä Valviran JulkiTerhikki/JulkiSuosikki-rekisteriin


**Luemme eduksi:**

- Kokemuksen avopalveluista- tai liikkuvasta tehtävästä työstä

- Kanta-verkkokoulujen suoritukset


**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

- Palkkaus yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:n mukaisesti, palkkaluokka G25e (+ ilta- ja viikonloppulisät sekä lomakorvaus)

- Kilometrikorvaukset työajoista

- Ennaltaehkäisevän työterveyden ja etälääkäripalvelut

- Perehdytyksen ja esihenkilön tuen, et jää yksin haastavissakaan tilanteissa

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa omiin työaikoihisi ja työn sisältöön

- Rennon ja välittömän työyhteisön, jossa huumori ja aitous kuuluvat arkeen


**Kiinnostuitko?**

Jos haluat olla mukana rakentamassa merkityksellistä ja vaikuttavaa työtä lasten ja perheiden parhaaksi, kuulemme sinusta mielellämme! Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana joten jätä hakemuksesi pian!

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si sähköpostitse osoitteeseen **rekrytointi@tukiluotsi.fi**

jobs.title: Consultant expérimenté, Managers et Senior Manager en Stratégie, Finance et Transformation ESG H/F
jobs.description:
Au sein des équipes « Finance durable et Risques ESG » d'EY France, votre rôle sera d'aider nos clients du secteur financier sur une large palette de missions dont :



Stratégie ESG et planification de la transition

Cadrage et mise en œuvre de plans stratégiques climat et de modèle d'affaire « durable »

Définition d'une stratégie de décarbonation et opérationnalisation du cycle de vie du crédit

Conception de plan de transition climatique ou lié à la biodiversité

Intégration des risques de ESG dans le cadre d'appétence pour les risques



Modèles opérationnels et Gouvernance ESG

Définition et mise en œuvre de modèles opérationnels cibles ESG pour les métiers et les fonctions transverses et régaliennes

Conception et déploiement d'un cadre de gouvernance ESG (rôles et responsabilités des lignes de défense, comitologie, processus d'escalade.) ou d'un cadre de gestion des risques climatiques et ESG (gouvernance, identification, mesure, contrôle, suivi.)

Accompagner les entreprises dans leur passage société à mission (définition de la raison d'être et des engagements, déclinaison opérationnelle, sécurisation du dispositif de reporting .)



Opérationnalisation de l'ESG dans le pilotage stratégique et financier

Analyse et prise en considération de la sensibilité des différentes dimensions ESG au sein des différentes composantes de planification financière et de gestion de la solvabilité

Evaluation des différents impacts des composantes ESG au sein de la gestion ALM (écoulement, modélisation, tarification, gestion.)



Intégration de l'ESG dans les processus métiers

Opérationnalisation de méthodologie d'évaluation de l'empreinte carbone, de score ESG, de score de transition ou de risque physique (avis client, chargé d'affaire.)

Refonte et adaptation des processus front-to-back-to-risk (processus, gouvernance, données, SI)



Données ESG

Liste de l'ensemble des cas d'usage (métiers, réglementaire, risques.) et construction de la cartographie des données ESG (externes, internes.)

Définition du dictionnaire de données ESG, sourcing des données et du processus de collecte

Identification des impacts sur les processus opérationnels front to back et sur le SI

Analyse de couverture et de qualité des providers externes de données ESG (CDP, Bloomberg, Vigeo, Sustainalytics , Refinitiv.)





Gestion de programme de transformation ESG

Projets de transformation ESG et plans d'optimisation des processus, des organisations et des outils

Conduite et pilotage des projets de transformation métiers et fonctions





Vous évoluerez au sein d'un département dédié aux problématiques du secteur financier, alliant forte expertise, esprit d'initiative, adaptabilité et qualités relationnelles, notamment dans un contexte de contacts permanents ave nos clients.

jobs.title: CFD Software Developer (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
CFD Software Engineer (f/m/d)
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the
world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative
global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a
large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together
while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages
creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our
business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.
Position Overview
Are you a passionate Software Engineer who enjoys working at
the intersection of numerical methods, high-performance computing, and
real-world engineering applications? We are searching for a talented CFD
Software Engineer to join our solver development team for Simcenter Ultrafluid (formerly Altair ultraFluidX, https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/) ), a small, dynamic, and agile team delivering world-class CFD software to
industries including automotive, heavy industry, and consumer electronics.
Simcenter Ultrafluid features a native GPU-based
implementation of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), allowing users to run
fully transient, high-fidelity aerodynamics and aeroacoustics simulations
overnight on a single compute server. The solver is designed to handle complex
geometries and demanding industrial use cases, delivering high-fidelity,
predictive simulations of real engineering processes, including turbulent
flows, thermal transport, and complex geometry handling.
If you are seeking a role where you can contribute directly
to solver development, algorithm implementation, and GPU acceleration, while
translating cutting-edge academic research in numerical methods into a
high-performance, easy-to-use software product, and collaborating closely with
the whole development team on the advancement of the code and its capabilities,
then we'd love to hear from you!
Responsibilities

- Contribute
to the code development of Simcenter Ultrafluid as part of the agile
development team
- Specify,
implement, test, and document new high-quality features of the solver in
close collaboration with the other team members

jobs.title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
jobs.description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

jobs.description:
KOK SØGES TIL COULOIR // AMAGER STRAND

Couloir er et lille, ambitiøst og personligt spisested tæt på Amager Strand. Vi laver mad med udgangspunkt i det nordiske køkken – med et legende og uformelt twist – og vi lægger vægt på smag, stemning og sammenhold.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra a la carte-køkkener og kan arbejde selvstændigt

  • Trives i et køkken, hvor tempo og detaljer går hånd i hånd

  • Har lyst til at være med til at udvikle menuen og dagligdagen

  • Er en holdspiller og bidrager positivt til stemningen i huset

Vi tilbyder:

  • Gode arbejdstider med fokus på work-life balance

  • Et køkken hvor idéer og smag prioriteres over dogmer

  • Et lille team med høj faglighed og en uformel tone

  • Mulighed for ansvar og medindflydelse

Stillingen er fuldtid og ønskes besat snarest muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette.

Lyder det som noget for dig – eller kender du nogen, vi bør tale med – så send en ansøgning til kasper@couloir.dk eller kig forbi og sig hej.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

SIA "SkyLand" (Reģ. nr. 43603038379), kura pamatdarbība ir saistīta ar grants un smilts karjeru izstrādi, aicina darbā Ekskavatora vadītāju patstāvīgam darbam karjeros, dīķu rakšanā un citos objektos. Meklējam atsaucīgu un atbildīgu kolēģi, kuram ir izpratne par tehniku un darbu specifiku.

No Tevis sagaidām:

  • Augstāko atbildību pret uzticēto tehniku un sekošanu līdzi tās tehniskajam stāvoklim;
  • Spēju patstāvīgi organizēt savu darbu un sapratni par darba drošību objektā;
  • Remontspēju – primāras iemaņas veikt vienkāršus traktortehnikas remontdarbus un apkopes;
  • Bez kaitīgiem ieradumiem.

Darba pienākumi:

  • Vadīt ekskavatoru un citu uzņēmuma rīcībā esošo trakortehniku;
  • Veikt zemes darbus, dīķu rakšanu un darbu karjeros;
  • Veikt tehnikas ikdienas apskati un nepieciešamos uzturēšanas darbus.

Prasības:

  • Vēlama iepriekšēja darba pieredze ar ekskavatoru;
  • Obligāta TR2 traktortehnikas vadītāja apliecība;
  • B kategorijas vadītāja apliecība;
  • CE kategorijas vadītāja apliecība tiks uzskatīta par priekšrocību;
  • Vēlams privātais autotransports nokļūšanai uz objektiem.

Mēs piedāvājam:

  • Atalgojumu no 1200 līdz 2000 EUR bruto, ņemot vērā pieredzi un iemaņas;
  • Darbu stabilā uzņēmumā un profesionālu kolektīvu;
  • Darba apģērbu un nepieciešamo aprīkojumu.

Darba vieta: Karjeri (Svētes pagasts, Jelgavas novads) un dažādi objekti (uzņēmuma juridiskā adrese: Jelgava, Pētera iela 6).
